mesh-social.summary: Mesh social layer as of 2026-09-17: the server (MeshHub DO, workers/ost-api/src/mesh/hub.js) is complete and DO-backed (no KV on the hot path; the KV identity.js/signal.js code is dead because MESH_HUB is bound in wrangler.toml:40-41 and index.js:42-49 always routes to the DO). MSG_PREFIX/MSG_TTL_MS/SEEN_PREFIX/SEEN_TTL_MS/MAX_INBOX/FRIEND_PREFIX are now defined (hub.js:17-24) — VERIFIED. But the client NEVER calls /msg/send, /msg/inbox, /friend/*, /presence, or /directory (grep of docs/ shows only identity/announce, identity/lookup, signal/send, signal/inbox, feed/*). The so-called "offline relay" (mesh.js:893-908) rides the 5-minute in-memory signal inbox (hub.js:11,366-372), not the 7-day mailbox, and tells the user "peer will receive next time they're online" — a fabricated success. Contact is P2P-only with a directory lookup + STUN-only WebRTC; there is no presence at all; the local outbox is in-memory and is discarded on chat switch; the callee stops listening for offers after 5 minutes. Request budget is the critical failure against the founder's 100 req/user/day directive: mesh.js and veil.js each re-announce every 45s (~3,840 req/day per open tab) plus a 1.5s RTC poll loop, a 7s→60s relay poll, and a 15s feed poll — the mesh alone is ~40x over budget per user and is the kind of traffic that trips the 1027 cap for the whole app. One live XSS: hub validAddr only checks prefix+length (hub.js:48-50), and mesh.js:1004 injects the unescaped sender address into innerHTML via _setStatus (mesh.js:606-608). mesh-group-markets.js cannot find the pavilion (checks globals that nothing sets, :145-151) so Social OSTC markets never leave the device and every device is "creator". Money paths (pay/donate/arena send) all go through OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst → /wallet/cosign 'peer-transfer' where the user's wallet signs the transfer and the pool only pays the fee — custody is sound; the feed's donate bookkeeping and post authorship are unauthenticated.

components.name: MeshHub Durable Object (server truth for directory, signaling, mailbox, friends, presence, feed)
components.role: Single global DO instance (index.js:15 idFromName('mesh-v1')). Routes at hub.js:78-163. announce with TOFU by-value bundle comparison :263-317; lookup :319-336; directory list :338-358; signal send/inbox in-memory Map, 5-min TTL, 128/inbox :360-405; msgSend/msgInbox 7-day DO-storage mailbox with block enforcement :407-422,:487-502; friend request/respond/list :425-485; presence ping/query :504-520; feed post/recent/react/reply/donate/clear :170-261. No auth on any route except feed/clear (MESH_ADMIN_KEY, fail-closed :159). No rate limiting anywhere on /mesh/*.

components.name: Mesh router + dead KV fallbacks
components.role: index.js (mesh) :39-49 forwards every /mesh/* request to the DO when MESH_HUB exists; the KV code paths :51-81 and signal.js/identity.js run only if the binding is absent — dead in production. Worker entry index.js:3203-3205 has no gate, limiter or auth before handleMeshRequest; the /health route list at index.js:3798-3802 documents only 5 of ~19 mesh routes.

components.name: MeshPavilion core (identity, directory, session crypto, chat history, relay, QR, calls, media)
components.role: Identity ECDH/ECDSA P-384 persisted extractable in localStorage (mesh.js:213-254); random address (:256-266); announce every 45s (:407-408); lookup w/ invite fallback (:683-693); connect (:695-711); chat history per peer in localStorage (:733-775); relay send via signal/send (:893-908) and adaptive relay poller (:910-966); relayed DM decrypt (:970-1017); QR show/scan with Copy/Connect result panel (:1027-1152); sendAppPayload bus for plugins (:1382-1404); _setStatus innerHTML sink (:606-608). mesh-rtc.js: STUN-only, 1.5s poll for 5 min budget (:16-17,:315-342), offer/answer/ice via signal/send (:344-355).

components.name: Veil presence companion
components.role: Loaded by lazy manifest for everyone (index.html:6360). Re-announces via pavilion._announceNow every 45s (:9,:161-167,:205-214) — a second announce loop on top of mesh.js's own. 'Mesh node active' pill = announce succeeded, not peer presence (:176).

components.name: Mesh Mobile (Feed/Chats/Pay/Play/Profile tabs)
components.role: Feed post/react/reply/donate/recent via /mesh/v1/feed/* (:225,:298,:316-317,:325,:344,:442); 15s feed poll while open (:574-577); Pay tab OSTC via OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst and SOL via OST_WALLET.sign (:405-426); scan-to-pay via OST_QR (:494-528); conversations list from pavilion._enumerateChats (:463-472). Escapes with esc() (:26) except single-quote.

components.name: Mesh Upgrade social panel (profile, contacts, saved texts, QR)
components.role: Contacts in localStorage ost.mesh.contacts.v2 (:9,:648-676); invite v2 carries bundle+profile (:229-241); importInviteText auto-connects (:729-750); contact 'Send OST' → OST_MESH_ARENA.sendOstTo (:794-815); own QR = address only, announces before showing (:894-916); profile.card exchange over sendAppPayload (:572-598). All peer strings escaped.

components.name: Mesh Social X (stories, groups, group chat modal)
components.role: Stories/groups/messages in localStorage; broadcastToMembers sends only to the single currently-connected peer (:769-793); handleIncoming on ost:mesh-payload (:797-836). Escapes peer strings (:23-27).

components.name: Mesh Group Markets (Social OSTC off-chain scoreboard)
components.role: Play-money tally in localStorage seeded 100 (:37-41,:79-107); broadcast/pavilion() looks for window.OST_MESH_PAVILION / window.MESH.pavilion which nothing sets (:145-151); selfAddress falls back to 'local' (:52-61). Receive path works via ost:mesh-payload (:627-690). Explicitly labeled not wallet OSTC (:5-12, :283, :443).

components.name: Mesh Play / Arena (fair games with real OSTC stakes, direct pay, requests, share)
components.role: depositStake → OST_RESCUE.userSendsOstToPool (:858-872); cashOutPot → OST_RESCUE.payoutOst with idempotencyKey (:874-890); directSendOst → OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst (:1381-1397); public sendOstTo/requestPayment/challenge (:1529-1560). All rendered peer strings escaped via escapeHtml (:41).

components.name: Casual games orchestrator + game modules
components.role: Invite/accept over sendAppPayloadReliable (:109-129); peer label escaped (:24-28,:259). Only chess.js:277 uses innerHTML (clears board, no peer data).

components.name: Location Pro + Link + QR reader + money rail
components.role: Location Pro renders peer name via textContent (:566) and trail HTML in a sandboxed iframe with escapeHtml/JSON.stringify (:200-229); mesh-link is pure navigation; OST_QR jsQR/BarcodeDetector (:79-139). devnet-rescue sendPeerOst (:328-333) → cosignSwap('peer-transfer') → wallet-payouts.js handleCosignBuild :315-321 builds ixTransferChecked signed by OWNER; pool only creates dest ATA and pays fee; per-wallet rate limit 30/10min (:269).

flows.name: Identity + directory registration (every page load, every user)
steps: mesh.js boots via lazy manifest (index.html:6360); loadOrCreateIdentity from localStorage ost_mesh_identity_v1 (mesh.js:213-254); getOrCreateAddress random 64-bit 'ost-mesh:xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx' (:256-266)
_initIdentity → _announceNow (3 retries, :639-657) → POST /mesh/v1/identity/announce {address,bundle,fingerprint} (:622-636)

hub.announce: TOFU — if an unexpired record exists with a different bundle → 409 identity_locked (hub.js:283-298); else storage.put id:<addr> with 7-day expiresAt (:300-316); put failure swallowed → stored:false but ok:true (:309-316)
setInterval re-announce every 45s (mesh.js:407-408) AND veil.js re-announces every 45s independently (veil.js:9,:205-214) → ~3,840 requests/day per open tab

_startRTC('callee',{passive:true}) → MeshRTC.listen → _pollLoop GET signal/inbox every 1.5s for 5 minutes then stops forever (mesh-rtc.js:16-17,:315-342) unless veil sees pc failed/closed (veil.js:153-159; a never-connected pc is 'new' so it is NOT re-armed)
weak_points: Duplicate announce loops; ~40x the 100 req/user/day budget on their own
Callee goes deaf after 5 minutes idle; offers posted to it expire in 5 min (hub.js:11) with no error to the caller
Rotate keys keeps the address (mesh.js:459-463 removes only STORAGE_ID) → 409 identity_locked for up to 7 days, shown only as 'offline'
stored:false ignored by client (mesh.js:632-635) → identity may exist only in DO memory

flows.name: Two users reach each other (A connects to B)
steps: B shares address: QR encodes address only (mesh.js:1049-1051; mesh-upgrade.js:942-946) or invite text with bundle (mesh.js:326-328; mesh-upgrade.js:229-241)

A: _connectToPeer → parsePeerInput (mesh.js:330-354) → _preparePeerSession (:719-741) → _fetchPeerBundle GET /mesh/v1/identity/lookup (:683-693); invite bundle used only if lookup throws; error collapsed to 'peer not found in directory'
importPeerBundle + deriveSessionKey ECDH→AES-256-GCM (mesh-crypto.js:60-85); peer stored as LAST_PEER_KEY (:731)
_startRTC('caller') → MeshRTC.call: createDataChannel, createOffer, wait ICE ≤2.2s (:291-304), POST signal/send {offer,call:{id,ts}} (mesh-rtc.js:124-154,:344-355); STUN only, no TURN (:11-14)

B (if its 5-min poll is still alive): _pollLoop picks offer → _handleSignal → emits 'peer' → mesh.js:1218-1223 _preparePeerSession(from) → lookup A's bundle → answer via signal/send (:276-289); ICE trickled via signal/send both ways
Data channel opens → _flushOutbox (mesh.js:1568-1578); text/media/location/calls/app payloads sealed per message (:1291-1301)
Failure path (NAT): state 'failed' → status says messages still send through relay (mesh.js:1235-1240); _sendText → _relayEnvelope → POST signal/send {type:'dm-relay',wire} (:893-908)
weak_points: Every step after key derivation depends on the single MeshHub DO; KV is NOT involved (hub uses DO storage), so KV exhaustion does not break mesh, but a 1027 account cap or DO unavailability kills lookup, signaling AND relay — total mesh outage with 'peer not found' as the only message
No cached directory: bundles are re-fetched on every connect; the only offline fallback is an invite string that happened to carry a bundle

Relay poller (mesh.js:915-926) drains the same inbox with no 'from' filter and discards non-dm-relay items → it can eat offers/answers/ICE meant for MeshRTC (hub inbox() removes matched records, hub.js:385-394)
Symmetric-NAT peers can never open a channel; files/calls/games are then impossible by design

flows.name: Offline DM (what actually happens vs what the UI says)
steps: _sendText renders the 'me' bubble and persists to history BEFORE knowing delivery (mesh.js:898-900)
_sendWire fails → wire pushed to in-memory this.outbox (:1517-1521) AND _relayEnvelope POSTs to /mesh/v1/signal/send (:893-908)
hub.signal stores in this.inboxes Map (memory only), SIGNAL_TTL_MS 5 min, 128 cap (hub.js:11-12,:360-372)
Client prints '✍️ Sent through offline relay — peer will receive next time they're online.' (:903-904)
Recipient receives only if the pavilion is OPEN and tab visible within 5 minutes (_startRelayPoller is started in open(), :587; paused while hidden :938) and the DO was not evicted
/mesh/v1/msg/send + /msg/inbox (7-day DO storage, hub.js:407-422,:487-502) are never called by any client file
weak_points: Success message is false for any peer not online within 5 minutes
Outbox is cleared on chat switch (mesh.js:864) and on session clear (:1104) and is lost on reload
No delivery receipt, no retry, no dedupe key beyond ts

flows.name: Money: pay / donate / arena send / fair-game stake (OSTC)
steps: Mesh Mobile Pay: doPay → OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst(to, amt,'mesh-pay') (mesh-mobile.js:415-419); SOL via OST_WALLET.sign(SystemProgram.transfer) (:420-425; sign = signAndSendTransaction app.js:6864)

Feed Donate: donatePost prompts amount, calls sendPeerOst(author, amt,'mesh-donate') where author = data-author = post.wallet from server (mesh-mobile.js:262-267,:305-320); on success optionally POSTs feed/donate + feed/reply
Contacts 'Send OST' → OST_MESH_ARENA.sendOstTo → directSendOst → sendPeerOst (mesh-upgrade.js:794-815; mesh-play.js:1381-1397,:1529-1541)

sendPeerOst → cosignSwap('peer-transfer') → POST /wallet/cosign builds [createDestATA(pool pays), transferChecked(ownerAta→destAta, signer=OWNER), memo] partially signed by pool (wallet-payouts.js:315-321,:326-337); user wallet signs; submit via /wallet/cosign/submit (devnet-rescue.js:311-316)

Fair games: depositStake → userSendsOstToPool (mesh-play.js:858-872); cashOutPot → payoutOst(wallet, stake*2, memo, idempotencyKey) (:874-890) — payout authority is PayoutGate (out of this subsystem's scope)
Group markets: Social OSTC is a localStorage tally, never on-chain (mesh-group-markets.js:79-107)
weak_points: Custody is correct (user signs the debit; pool only pays fee) but the donate target wallet comes from an unauthenticated feed post (hub.js:171)
feed/donate records any amount from anyone with no tx proof (hub.js:229-238)
cashOutPot pays stake*2 to the caller based purely on client-side game state — trust lives in PayoutGate, not here (flagged as scope boundary)

flows.name: Shared feed
steps: POST feed/post {wallet,name,text,img} — wallet is whatever the client says (hub.js:170-188; mesh-mobile.js:225)
GET feed/recent every open + every 15s while Feed tab visible (mesh-mobile.js:344,:574-577) + on Profile render (:442)
react/reply with body-supplied wallet (hub.js:214-226,:240-253)
feed/clear gated by MESH_ADMIN_KEY (hub.js:157-161)
weak_points: Identity spoofing (post as any wallet), no rate limit, 160KB data-URL images stored in the DO, 15s poll adds to the request budget

flows.name: Group chats + group markets (P2P fan-out)
steps: Group created locally; group.create sent only to the currently connected peer (mesh-social-x.js:769-793)
group.message likewise; other members only learn of the group if they happen to be the connected peer at the time
Group market create/stake/resolve → broadcast() → pavilion() returns null (mesh-group-markets.js:145-151) → nothing is sent
weak_points: No fan-out, no mailbox, no convergence; markets are single-device

defects.title: Mesh request volume is ~40x the 100 req/user/day budget (two 45s announce loops + three polls)
defects.evidence: mesh.js:407-408 setInterval(_announceNow, ANNOUNCE_REFRESH_MS=45_000). veil.js:205-214 setInterval(warmMeshPresence, VEIL_REFRESH_MS=45_000) which calls pavilion._announceNow (veil.js:163-164). veil.js is in the lazy manifest for all users (index.html:6360). mesh-rtc.js _pollLoop fetches signal/inbox every POLL_MS=1500 for POLL_BUDGET_MS=5min (~200 req) on every _startRTC. Relay poller FAST 7s/SLOW 60s while pavilion open (mesh.js:930-946). Feed poll every 15s while Feed tab open (mesh-mobile.js:574-577).
defects.failure_scenario: 1,000 DAU each leaving one tab open: announces alone = 1000 × 3,840 = 3.84M req/day; the free-plan 100k/day cap trips before breakfast and every endpoint (markets, payouts, wallet) returns 1027 for the rest of the day.

defects.title: 'Offline relay' uses the 5-minute in-memory signal inbox, not the 7-day mailbox, and reports delivery success
defects.evidence: _relayEnvelope POSTs to /mesh/v1/signal/send with payload.type='dm-relay' (mesh.js:896-903). hub.signal() pushes into this.inboxes (a Map, memory only), pruned at SIGNAL_TTL_MS=5min, capped at 128 (hub.js:366-371,:399-404). On res.ok the client prints 'Sent through offline relay — peer will receive next time they're online.' (mesh.js:903-904). No file in docs/ references /msg/send or /msg/inbox (grep).
defects.failure_scenario: B is offline for 6 minutes (or the DO instance is evicted). A sends 'meet at 5', sees a success line, and B never receives anything; A's history shows it as sent.

defects.title: Relay poller and RTC poller drain the same inbox; relay poller discards WebRTC signals
defects.evidence: _startRelayPoller fetches signal/inbox?to=me&since=cursor with NO from filter (mesh.js:915) and `continue`s on pl.type !== 'dm-relay' (:921). hub.inbox() removes every record with ts>minTs that matches (messages.push, not keep.push) (hub.js:385-394). MeshRTC._pollLoop reads the same inbox with its own cursor (mesh-rtc.js:320-322).
defects.failure_scenario: Pavilion open (relay poller active), peer sends an offer/ICE; the relay tick fires first, consumes and drops it; MeshRTC never sees it; connection silently never establishes. Timing-dependent — SUSPECTED in practice, VERIFIED in code.

defects.title: Callee stops listening after 5 minutes and is never re-armed; callers' offers expire silently
defects.evidence: _pollLoop loops only while Date.now()-start < POLL_BUDGET_MS (5 min). veil.rtcNeedsPassiveListen re-arms only when pc.connectionState is 'failed'/'closed' or dc 'closed'; a never-connected RTCPeerConnection stays 'new' and dc is null. Offers in the DO inbox expire at SIGNAL_TTL_MS=5min.
defects.failure_scenario: B opened the app 10 minutes ago and is idle. A connects: offer stored, A polls 5 minutes for an answer, B never fetches, offer evicted. A sees 'P2P connecting…' then nothing; 'Receive live' must be pressed manually by B, which nobody knows.

defects.title: XSS: unescaped sender address from the server inbox injected into innerHTML; server address validation is prefix+length only
defects.evidence: _handleRelayedDM: this._setStatus(`📬 New offline message from ${fromAddr}. Open Chats to view.`) (mesh.js:1004); _setStatus sets statusEl.innerHTML with msg unescaped (:606-608). fromAddr = item.from from /signal/inbox (:919-924) with no normalizeAddress. hub validAddr = startsWith('ost-mesh:') && length<=80 (hub.js:48-50) — no charset check, so 'ost-mesh:' (≤80 chars) passes announce, signal/send and lookup. The victim's public bundle is readable from the directory, so the attacker can seal a valid 'enc' wire the victim decrypts (:986-993) reaching line 1004.
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker announces a malicious address, sends one dm-relay to any victim address; when the victim's pavilion is open on any other chat, the status line executes attacker JS with access to localStorage (mesh private keys ost_mesh_identity_v1, contacts, chat history).

defects.title: Rotate keys locks the address out of the directory for 7 days (identity_locked) and is reported only as 'offline'
defects.evidence: Rotate handler removes STORAGE_ID only; STORAGE_ADDR persists (getOrCreateAddress :256-266). Re-announce with new bundle hits hub TOFU compare (bundle differs) → 409 'identity_locked' until the old record expires (ID_TTL_MS 7d, :10). _announceNow retries 3x then sets dirEl 'offline' and status 'Directory registration failed. Use Copy invite instead.' (:651-655).
defects.failure_scenario: User taps 'Rotate keys' (or clears site data on one browser but not the address… any bundle change). Everyone who looks them up derives a key against the OLD bundle; messages are undecryptable; the user is told the directory is offline.

defects.title: mesh-group-markets cannot find the pavilion → broadcast is a silent no-op and every device is creator 'local'
defects.evidence: pavilion() returns window.OST_MESH_PAVILION or window.MESH.pavilion, wrapped in try{}catch(e){} → null; grep of docs/ shows neither global is ever assigned (mesh.js exposes window.OST_MESH.pavilion, :1841-1846). broadcast(): `if (!p) return;`. selfAddress(): p null; OST_WALLET.address is a getter not a function (app.js:6852) so `typeof === 'function'` fails; 'ost.mesh.publicKey' is set nowhere → returns 'local'. isCreator = market.creator === me → 'local'==='local'.
defects.failure_scenario: Alice creates a market and stakes; nothing is sent; Bob never sees it. Any device that receives a market via another path can 'resolve' it because creator is always 'local'.

defects.title: Server mailbox, friend graph, presence and directory listing are dead: no client caller
defects.evidence: grep -rn 'msg/\|friend\|presence\|/directory' docs --include=*.js finds no fetch to these routes. friend-request/friend-accepted mailbox notices (hub.js:437-439,:449-451) have no client handler. SEEN_PREFIX is written only by msgSend/msgInbox/presencePing — all unused — so presenceQuery would always return online:false.
defects.failure_scenario: Every 'contact without P2P' feature the July fixes enabled is unreachable; users cannot friend, block or message anyone who is not online at the same moment.

defects.title: No peer presence exists; UI implies otherwise
defects.evidence: veil sets 'Mesh node active' when announce succeeds (own state only). mesh-upgrade loadContact says 'Tap Connect securely when they are online' with no online data. Contacts list has no presence field (mesh-upgrade.js:761-770). Directory records live 7 days (ID_TTL_MS), so a listing would show week-old identities as present.
defects.failure_scenario: User waits for a contact who left days ago; nothing in the UI can tell them.

defects.title: Outbox is in-memory only and silently discarded on chat switch/session clear after the message was shown as sent
defects.evidence: _openChat: `this.rtc = null; this.outbox = [];` (:863-864). _clearMessagingSession sets outbox=[] (:1104). _sendText renders the 'me' bubble and persists history before knowing delivery (:898-900); _sendWire pushes to outbox on failure (:1517-1521); nothing persists outbox across reloads.
defects.failure_scenario: Channel drops; user types three messages (bubbles appear), opens another chat, returns: the three messages exist in history as sent but were never delivered and never will be.

defects.title: _fetchPeerBundle collapses every failure (429, 409, 1027 cap, network) into 'peer not found in directory'
defects.evidence: catch(err){ if(fallback?.bundle) return fallback; throw new Error('peer not found in directory. Ask them to open Mesh and Copy invite…') } regardless of r.status.
defects.failure_scenario: Account hits the 1027 daily cap; every user is told their friend 'is not in the directory' and to re-share invites, hiding the real outage.

defects.title: Feed identity and donation totals are unauthenticated; no rate limit on /mesh/*
defects.evidence: feedPost/feedReact/feedReply take wallet from the body. feedDonate adds any amount to v.donated with no signature/tx proof. index.js passes /mesh/ straight to the DO with no limiter (contrast /ghost/chat :3133-3153). Donate button targets data-author = server post.wallet (mesh-mobile.js:262-267,:305).
defects.failure_scenario: Anyone can post/reply as any wallet (impersonation), inflate 'donated 1,000,000 OST' on any post, or spam 160KB images to fill DO storage and burn request budget.

defects.title: Group chats/stories fan out only to the single connected peer; no mailbox path
defects.evidence: broadcastToMembers sends only if p.peerAddr === addr, then again to whoever is connected; comment 'Members get group messages relayed when connected' (:344) is not implemented — there is no store-and-forward.
defects.failure_scenario: Three-member group: only the one peer currently connected ever sees a message; group state diverges permanently.

defects.title: msgInbox is drain-on-read with no client ack (at-most-once delivery) — wrong semantics for the target mailbox
defects.evidence: for each record: messages.push; if (drain !== '0') del.push(key); storage.delete(del) before the response is known to reach the client.
defects.failure_scenario: When a client is wired: response lost mid-flight (mobile radio) → 7-day mail deleted, never shown.

defects.title: announce swallows storage.put failure and returns ok:true (stored:false ignored by client)
defects.evidence: try{put}catch{stored=false}; return json({ok:true,…,stored}). Client checks only r.ok/data.ok.
defects.failure_scenario: DO storage failing: identity lives only in this.ids memory; DO restart → lookups 404 while the user's directory pill says 'live'.

defects.title: Failed feed post saved as 'pending' with '· sending' badge but never retried
defects.evidence: catch → saveFeed({…pending:true}); renderFeed merges local pending posts; no code path re-POSTs them.
defects.failure_scenario: Post during a 1027 outage shows 'sending' forever on that device and never reaches anyone.

defects.title: Server-controlled error strings rendered unescaped in status line; JSON.parse error snippets of peer data rendered unescaped
defects.evidence: _announceNow: _setStatus('Directory registration failed… ' + lastErr.message) — message is hub fail() text (server-controlled). _onPeerMessage: catch → _bubble('system','decrypt failed: ' + err.message) with innerHTML; V8 JSON.parse messages embed a short snippet of the offending input.
defects.failure_scenario: Only exploitable if the worker is compromised (former) or a browser embeds enough of the snippet (latter, SUSPECTED, unlikely).

defects.title: KV identity/signal modules are dead code that would silently re-enable KV writes if the DO binding were ever dropped
defects.evidence: handleMeshRequest returns the DO result whenever env.MESH_HUB exists; only otherwise falls to KV. wrangler.toml:40-41 binds MESH_HUB.
defects.failure_scenario: A future wrangler edit removing the binding would put signaling back on the ~1k/day KV write budget with no error.

risks: Budget: the mesh's announce+poll traffic is the single largest self-inflicted contributor to the 1027 daily cap; any growth in DAU makes the whole app unavailable, not just mesh.

Security: the validAddr/innerHTML XSS can exfiltrate the extractable P-384 private keys and all chat history from localStorage; combined with the spoofable feed it enables convincing phishing inside the app.
Data integrity: messages are shown as sent/relayed when they may never be delivered (in-memory relay, in-memory outbox); users will make real-world decisions (payments, meetups) on false receipts.
Money: donate/pay targets come from unauthenticated feed posts; custody is sound (user signs) but the recipient identity is not authenticated.
Operational: single global MeshHub DO instance ('mesh-v1') is a serialization point for every mesh user worldwide; feed images up to 160KB and unbounded ids/msg keys sit in one DO's storage.
Product: contacts, friends, presence and group features the users see in the UI do not function beyond a single live P2P link; trust erosion when 'it says sent but they never got it'.
keep_as_is: MeshHub as a Durable Object with DO storage (no KV on the mesh path) — hub.js; keep the single-instance model but add a WebSocket to it rather than a new service
TOFU announce with by-value JWK comparison and 409 on a different bundle (hub.js:271-298) — correct direction; only needs a signed rotation path
mesh-crypto.js: ECDH P-384 → AES-256-GCM per-message sealing, honest 'phase1-hybrid-ready' labeling
Block enforcement inside msgSend that does not reveal the block (hub.js:412-415) and the friend-graph key layout friend:<owner>:<other>
feed/clear admin gate that fails closed when MESH_ADMIN_KEY is unset (hub.js:159)
QR = address-only with bundle from directory / invite-text fallback (mesh.js:1049-1051; mesh-upgrade.js:935-946)
Scan result panel with explicit Copy/Connect instead of auto-connect (mesh.js:1115-1152) and OST_QR jsQR floor for iOS

recommended_fixes.title: Replace all mesh polling and periodic announce with ONE MeshHub WebSocket per session (signals, mailbox push, presence, feed deltas)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Cuts per-user mesh traffic from thousands of requests/day to ~1 per session, fits the 100 req/user/day budget, and makes presence and delivery real instead of implied. The DO already exists; Cloudflare hibernatable WebSockets keep the cost at one request.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the request-generating loops (mesh.js:407-408, veil.js:205-214, mesh-rtc.js:315-342, mesh.js:910-966, mesh-mobile.js:574-577) rather than tuning intervals; presence becomes socket connect/close truth rather than a TTL guess.

recommended_fixes.title: Immediately delete the duplicate veil announce loop and lengthen/announce-once until the socket lands
recommended_fixes.rationale: Halves announce traffic today with a one-line change; announce only on identity change or every ≥6h (record TTL is 7 days).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates redundant work; does not hide failures — announce errors still surface.

recommended_fixes.title: Fix the XSS: canonical address regex on the server and escape in _setStatus
recommended_fixes.rationale: validAddr must be /^ost-mesh:[a-f0-9]{4}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}$/ (hub.js:48-50); _setStatus must escape msg or accept only pre-escaped HTML; normalizeAddress(item.from) in the relay poller.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Closes the injection at both the trust boundary (server validation) and the sink; no behavior is hidden.

recommended_fixes.title: Route offline DMs through the 7-day DO mailbox and separate signaling from mail
recommended_fixes.rationale: When the data channel is not open, POST /mesh/v1/msg/send; receive mail via the socket (or, interim, via /msg/inbox on open) with explicit acks (drain=0 + ack list) instead of drain-on-read. Stop the relay poller from consuming the signal inbox.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Uses the durable store that already exists; the 'sent through offline relay' message becomes true, and at-least-once delivery replaces silent loss.

recommended_fixes.title: Persistent local outbox with honest state
recommended_fixes.rationale: Store undelivered wires in localStorage/IndexedDB keyed by message id; render bubbles as 'pending' until an ack (socket/mailbox) or channel send; flush on channel open and on socket open; never clear on chat switch.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Replaces the in-memory queue and the premature 'sent' rendering with tracked delivery state; failures stay visible.

recommended_fixes.title: Cached directory with fingerprint pinning; surface real error classes
recommended_fixes.rationale: Cache looked-up bundles per address (already fingerprinted) and use them when lookup fails; on a bundle change, block and warn (client TOFU). _fetchPeerBundle should throw {status, reason} and the UI should say 'directory unreachable (cap/429/network)' vs 'not found'.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Adds a real offline capability and stops collapsing distinct failures into a misleading message.

recommended_fixes.title: Signed key rotation instead of identity_locked dead-end
recommended_fixes.rationale: Announce accepts a new bundle if the body carries an ECDSA signature by the OLD sig key over the new bundle; client rotation must either sign with the old key or also rotate the address. Keep 409 for unsigned changes.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Keeps the anti-poisoning guarantee while making rotation work; no silent fallback.

recommended_fixes.title: Wire friend routes + presence into the contacts UI
recommended_fixes.rationale: mesh-upgrade contacts should call friend/request|respond|list and render pendingIn/blocked; handle friend-request/friend-accepted mailbox notices; show online from the socket presence.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Turns dead server features into the server-authoritative contact graph the founder's architecture calls for (thin directory/mailbox).

recommended_fixes.title: Fix mesh-group-markets pavilion lookup and fan out group state via the mailbox
recommended_fixes.rationale: pavilion() → window.OST_MESH.pavilion; selfAddress → pavilion address; group create/message/market events sent to EACH member address via msg/send so members converge.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Replaces a silently broken integration (null pavilion, 'local' identity) with real addressing and delivery.

recommended_fixes.title: Authenticate feed authorship and stop recording unproven donations
recommended_fixes.rationale: Require an ed25519 signMessage over {text,img hash,ts} verified in the DO for post/react/reply; feedDonate should accept only a tx signature the DO can verify on-chain (or be removed and derive totals from signed replies). Add a per-IP DO rate limit like /ghost/chat.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the wallet on a post mean something before real OSTC is sent to it; removes fabricated public totals.

recommended_fixes.title: Remove dead KV mesh modules and the stale route list
recommended_fixes.rationale: Delete identity.js/signal.js and the KV branch in mesh/index.js so a binding mistake fails loudly (503) instead of silently spending KV budget; update index.js:3798 listing.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Converts a hidden fallback into an explicit error.

recommended_fixes.title: announce: fail loudly when storage.put fails; client honors stored:false

borrowing.summary: BORROWING as of 2026-09-17 (read-only, all primaries read in full). Model: a global LoanLedger DO (loans-v1) records DEBT + per-loan "tainted" buckets; the global PlayLedger DO (global) holds the only spendable money (bal:<wallet>) and does the draw credit / repay debit / cashout lock. Draw = /loans/draw -> PlayLedger.handleLoanDraw (lendable = 0.5*(poolOSTG - Σbal) check) -> LoanLedger.borrow (line/slots/descending rule) -> credit bal:. Repay = /loans/repay -> PlayLedger.handleLoanRepay (debit bal: first) -> LoanLedger.repay(viaPlay). Cashout lock = handleCashout refuses amount > bal - LoanLedger.lockedTotal. VERIFIED CRITICAL: (1) index.js:3353 forwards ANY /loans/<op> to the DO, so /loans/borrow, /loans/stake, /loans/settle, /loans/void are client-callable while LOANS_MODE=test (wrangler.toml:151, devnet) -> draw then /loans/void (or /loans/stake bucket=loanId) erases the lock and the borrowed principal cashes out to real OSTG; also debt can be fabricated on any wallet with an astronomical tainted bucket that permanently blocks its cashout. (2) No wallet-signature auth on any loan/play mutator: any caller creates debt on any wallet (/loans/draw {wallet:victim}); July griefing finding is NOT closed. (3) usdPerOstg is client-supplied on draw (cards-hub:392, play-ledger:183, loan-ledger:106) and OST_TOPUP_RATE is never set anywhere, so the USD credit line is bypassable (rate=1e-9 draws the entire lendable reserve for $0.01 of line). (4) LoanLedger.repay never checks loan.address===address and handleLoanRepay debits the full amount while only min(amount,owed) is applied -> cross-wallet repayment burns a victim's play balance to retire an attacker's debt; overpayment is silently destroyed. (5) Games deliberately ignore the bucket (play-ledger:708-716), so loan OSTG is fungible in bal:; combined with no due date/default/liquidation code (defaultedCount is never written) and free wallets, every loan is a free option on house capital: win -> cash out profit, lose -> abandon. (6) Line growth ×1.5 per settled loan with zero minimum duration lets draw->repay-immediately farm the $100 line to $5000 at ~0 interest. Silent masks on money paths: handleLoanRepay reports refunded:true after a swallowed refund failure (play-ledger:294-295); handleSettle/handleStake ignore LoanLedger results (344, 317) so taint silently drops; poolBankroll serves an unbounded-age cached bankroll unflagged (635-646); /loans/summary capacity swallows PlayLedger health failures and emits lendable=0 (index.js:3323-3345) which cards-hub renders as "$0 drawable"; client lockedTotal()=0 when the summary failed (ost-ostg-source:90-93) shows borrowed OSTG as "Personal". A loan-repay card payment is queued for OST delivery like a purchase (purchase-ledger:147,183; index.js:3230) — double effect unless the external dispatcher filters by purpose (not verifiable here). Request-budget: every bet fans out to /loans/summary + /balance/truth (ost-loan-usd:184, ost-balance:187) = 3 worker requests per bet, against the 100/user/day budget.

defects.title: /loans/<op> proxy forwards borrow/stake/settle/void to the DO: lock bypass + debt erasure
defects.evidence: index.js:3269 op = path.slice('/loans/'.length); only draw/repay are special-cased (3300-3308); 3353 `stub.fetch('https://loan-ledger/' + op + url.search, init)` with the client body. loan-ledger.js fetch switch (368-390) executes borrow/stake/settle/void with no auth. LOANS_MODE=test (wrangler.toml:151) + devnet cluster (index.js:2728) => enabled (3282). Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker: POST /loans/draw {wallet:A, usd:100, usdPerOstg:0.0118} -> bal:A += 8474 OSTG; POST /loans/void {loanId} -> tainted deleted, status void, bal: untouched; POST /play/cashout 8474 -> lockedTotal 0 -> real OSTG leaves the pool. Alt: POST /loans/stake {address:A, amount:8474, bucket:loanId} zeroes the lock without any play debit. Griefing: POST /loans/borrow {address:victim, usd:99, usdPerOstg:1e-12} -> tainted[victim] = 9.9e13 -> victim's cashout blocked forever (withdrawable = bal - locked).

defects.title: No wallet-signature auth on /loans/draw, /loans/repay, /play/bet, /play/predict/open etc.: griefing NOT closed
defects.evidence: index.js:3300-3308 attaches x-ost-internal to ANY client's /loans/draw|repay body (body.wallet trusted); /play/* forwarded as-is (3491-3494); play-ledger.js handleLoanDraw 181 wallet = cleanText(b.wallet), only isPubkey; handleBet 654; prediction-ledger open 103. grep for ed25519/nacl/x-ost-sig in index.js: none. Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: Anyone POSTs /loans/draw {wallet:victim,...} three times: victim now carries 3 open loans at 12% APR, all slots consumed, descending rule blocks their own draws; then POST /play/bet {wallet:victim, game:'limbo', wager:<bal>, count:50} burns the victim's play balance (bets are unauthenticated). Cross-wallet repay (next defect) turns this into value transfer.

defects.title: Repay does not check loan ownership and debits the full amount while applying only min(amount, owed)
defects.evidence: handleLoanRepay debits `amount` from bal:<wallet> (271-276) before asking LoanLedger; LoanLedger.repay loads loan by loanId (233) and never compares loan.address to body.address; applied = Math.min(amt, owed) (250); the play-ledger debit is never reduced to `applied`. Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker draws loan L on wallet A, then POST /loans/repay {wallet:victim, loanId:L, amount:X}: victim's bal: -= X, L settled with victim's money, A keeps the drawn OSTG. Also any honest user repaying 105 on a 100 debt loses 5 OSTG permanently (total decremented -> becomes house buffer with no record).

defects.title: usdPerOstg is client-supplied on draw; credit line is denominated in a number the borrower chooses
defects.evidence: handleLoanDraw: `const usdPerOstg = Number(b.usdPerOstg); if (!(usdPerOstg > 0)) ...` — no comparison to topupUsdPerOst(env) (index.js:2551). LoanLedger.borrow stores it as the struck rate (149) and sizes principalOstg = usd/rate (143). Only the OSTG lendable cap (209) bounds it. Client rate() always returns 0.0118 because OST_TOPUP_RATE is never set (grep docs/: only read at cards-hub:496). Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: POST /loans/draw {usd:0.01, usdPerOstg:1e-12} -> principalUsd $0.01 (line barely touched, descending rule trivially satisfied), principalOstg capped at the full lendable reserve (50% of pool buffer) -> attacker holds the house's entire lending reserve as a play balance for a $0.01 nominal debt; gamble it (games ignore bucket), cash out wins, abandon.

defects.title: Unsecured lending with no default/due/liquidation: every loan is a free option on house capital
defects.evidence: Wallet record has defaultedCount (73) but nothing in loan-ledger.js writes it; no dueAt field; no op reclaims bal:. Games ignore bucket by explicit decision (play-ledger 708-716 'NO TAINT IN FAIR GAMES'). Draw requires nothing but a pubkey. Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: Fresh wallet draws $100-worth, plays limbo at 2x: 49% of the time bal = 2P -> cashout P (withdrawable = 2P - P), repay nothing; 51% of the time bal = 0 -> walk away. House EV per wallet ≈ -0.49P + 0 = large negative; repeat with new wallets until the lendable reserve is gone.

defects.title: Credit-line farming: draw -> repay instantly with the loan's own principal grows the line x1.5 at ~zero cost
defects.evidence: handleLoanRepay pulls repayment from the blended bal: (271) which contains the just-drawn principal; LoanLedger.repay with viaPlay skips the bucket check (243) and passes from:'clean' (play-ledger:286) so the `src === loanId` rule (223) never fires; on settle lineUsd = min(5000, line*1.5) (271) with no minimum tenure; interest for seconds is ~0 (89-96). Verified in code.
defects.failure_scenario: 10 cycles of draw $N / repay $N within a minute: line 100 -> 150 -> 225 -> ... -> 5000. Then draw $5000-worth and apply the free-option defect at 50x the intended exposure.

defects.title: Failed refund reported as refunded:true after a swallowed catch
defects.evidence: `try { ...restore bal:/total... } catch (_) { /* surfaced below as refunded:false so it is never silent */ } return json({ ok:false, error:..., refunded: true }, 409);` — the comment promises refunded:false, the code always sends true. Verified in code.

Reverse at 317: stake refund fails after LoanLedger already decremented tainted -> lock under-counts principal.

defects.title: poolBankroll serves a cached bankroll of unbounded age, unflagged, and lends against it
defects.evidence: On RPC failure `catch (_) {}` then `return cached && Number.isFinite(cached.v) ? cached.v : null` — no age check on the fallback, no stale flag; handleLoanDraw (191-208) and all win gates treat it as current. Verified in code.

Verified in code.

defects.evidence: OST_PLAY.bet emits ost:play:balance (42,141); ost-loan-usd listens and refetches /loans/summary (184 -> 152 -> 67-70); ost-balance listens and refresh(true) bypasses MIN_GAP (187 -> 49-56). Verified in code.

defects.title: Cross-wallet repay leaves the borrower's record corrupt (settled loan stays in openLoans, tainted never released) and inflates the payer's line
defects.evidence: On settle, openLoans filter and tainted release run on `w` = wallet(body.address), not wallet(loan.address); settledCount/lineUsd also credited to body.address. Verified in code.

risks: Live exposure today: LOANS_MODE=test on devnet means Leaks A/B/E are exploitable against the devnet pool right now; flipping to live on mainnet ships the same holes against real OSTG.

The lending reserve is the same money that pays game winners (play-ledger:200-208); a drained reserve manifests as bankroll_cap refusals on legitimate wins before anyone notices lending was the cause.

Two ledgers (LoanLedger tainted vs PlayLedger bal:) with no reconciliation job: any dropped cross-DO call (defects on 317/344) permanently desyncs lock vs money; /play/reconcile only checks pool vs Σbal, never tainted vs bal.
Griefing has a real cost to the house, not just the victim: every drawn-on-victim loan credits pool OSTG into a balance the victim can gamble away; the house has no recourse.
Geoblock on /settlement/* applies to the processor's webhook origin country (index.js:3223-3224); if NOWPayments posts from an EU IP the loan-repay webhook 451s after the customer paid.
Voiding a loan whose OSTG was already spent (handleLoanDraw failure path is the only intended caller) is indistinguishable from the attacker path because void has no caller identity.
Cashout fails closed on any LoanLedger hiccup (515-517) — correct, but under the 1027 daily cap every cashout in the app is blocked, so users will read 'loan check unavailable' as 'my money is gone'.
Line growth persists in DO storage: farmed $5000 lines survive any fix that does not also reset lineUsd.
keep_as_is: Order-of-operations in handleLoanDraw: record debt first, credit second, void on credit failure (play-ledger:218-243) — never a credit without a debt or a debt without money.
Draw credited only from pool surplus (buffer = pool - Σbal) so no unbacked OSTG is ever minted (play-ledger:197-233); invariant pool >= Σbal preserved and reported at /health/play (1141-1173).
Cashout LOAN LOCK fails closed on loan-ledger read failure (play-ledger:508-527) — refusing is the right shape.
bankroll_unreadable -> 503 refuse-to-lend (play-ledger:192-194) rather than lending against unknown.
Internal-key gate on /play/stake|settle|loan-draw|loan-repay (405-424) still holds and fails closed when the key is unset.
balance-truth.js: four labelled places, spendablePlay only when all inputs known, degraded+reason, stale-flagged last-good cache (105-118, 181-214).
Client 'unknown is undefined, never 0' discipline in ost-balance.js (101-107), ost-play.js mirror (32,117), ost-loan-usd lockedOstg (80-84), ost-ostg-source personalBalance (82-88).
Simple non-compounding interest (loan-ledger:89-96) and USD-as-unit-of-account for debt display (307-343) — the intent is right even though the rate provenance is wrong.
DO storage (not KV) for both ledgers with blockConcurrencyWhile around the short storage sections and RPC kept outside the lock.
prediction-ledger's open->stake(bucket) / resolve->settle(bucket) symmetry (134, 210-216, 264-267) is the one product where provenance is actually round-tripped.
handleLoanRepay debit-then-record with explicit refund attempt (271-296) — the shape is right; only the refunded flag and the amount cap are wrong.
open_questions: Is INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY actually set as a secret on prod? If unset, /loans/draw|repay return 503 (index.js:3302) and the whole borrowing feature is dark — cannot verify without a live call (not made, per the 2-call budget).
Does the external top-up dispatcher (consumer of /topup/admin/pending) filter intent.purpose==='loan-repay'? Not in the repo; if not, cash repayments double-pay.
Is @solana/web3.js's nacl/ed25519 already bundled in the worker (for a signature-auth fix) or would tweetnacl need adding? Not checked.

Has anyone already farmed lineUsd or holds a void-then-cashout loan on devnet? A read of the LoanLedger DO state (wallets with lineUsd>100 or loans with status 'void' and no matching handleLoanDraw failure) would answer; needs a wrangler/DO read, not done (read-only, no wrangler).

What is the intended semantics of 'tainted' now that games are exempt: is the lock meant to cover principal only (current effect) or all loan-derived money (the header comment)? The two halves of the codebase disagree and the founder's choice determines the fix.
Is the founder's model that the house lends its own capital (current), or should draws be collateralized by the borrower's own OSTG/OSTC? This decides whether P0-5 is 'remove' or 'collateralize'.
Where should a server-authoritative OSTG/USD rate come from for loans — topupUsdPerOst(env) constant, or the /ost/ price engine / Pyth anchor already in the worker (index.js /anchor/, /ost/)?

recommended_fixes.title: Allowlist /loans/<op> in the proxy to {summary, health, draw, repay}; never forward borrow/stake/settle/void
recommended_fixes.rationale: Closes Leak A/B and the astronomical-tainted griefing in one line: index.js:3353 must only reach LoanLedger for read ops; borrow/stake/settle/void are internal (PlayLedger/prediction-ledger already call them DO-to-DO). Optionally also require x-ost-internal inside LoanLedger.fetch for those four ops so a future proxy mistake fails closed.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the unauthenticated path to the state mutators rather than validating their inputs; the mutators keep their DO-internal contract. No fallback, no new poll.

recommended_fixes.title: Wallet-signature authorization on every wallet-scoped mutator (loans draw/repay, play bet/session/meme/stock/cashout, predict open/cashout)
recommended_fixes.rationale: The July finding 'callers can create debt on wallets they don't control' is still open because body.wallet is trusted everywhere. Require an ed25519 signature over {op, wallet, amount/loanId, nonce, ts} by the wallet key (the client already signs with OST_WALLET.session); verify in the worker (CPU only, zero extra requests). Reject replays by (wallet,nonce) in the PlayLedger DO.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Binds each mutation to proof of key control instead of trusting a pubkey string; no rate-limit or heuristic that merely slows griefing. Fits the free-plan directive: one request per action, same as today.

recommended_fixes.title: Server-authoritative usdPerOstg for loans; reject or ignore the client's rate
recommended_fixes.rationale: handleLoanDraw must take the rate from topupUsdPerOst(env) (or the worker's own price engine with an explicit staleness bound) and pass it to LoanLedger.borrow; /loans/summary capacity uses the same server rate; cards-hub sends no rate and renders the one in the summary. This ends the credit-line bypass (Leak E) and the six 0.0118 fallbacks become one server constant that is reported, never assumed.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates client control over a money parameter rather than clamping it; if the server has no rate it refuses (rate_unavailable) instead of defaulting to 0.0118.

recommended_fixes.title: Repay: enforce loan ownership and debit exactly the applied amount
recommended_fixes.rationale: LoanLedger.repay must refuse when loan.address !== address; handleLoanRepay should first ask LoanLedger for outstanding (or accept `applied` back) and debit min(amount, outstanding) — simplest: call LoanLedger.repay first with a 'quote' then debit `applied`, or debit after and reconcile the difference back to bal: in the same lock. Kills cross-wallet theft and overpayment burn.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the debit equal to the debt reduction by construction and ties a loan to its borrower; no compensating refund path needed.

recommended_fixes.title: Decide and implement an honest lending model: collateralized draws with server-side liquidation, or no lending
recommended_fixes.rationale: Unsecured + games-exempt + no default + free wallets = free option on house capital regardless of auth fixes. The settled OSTG/OSTC split makes collateral natural: a draw locks the borrower's own play OSTG (or bridged OSTC) as collateral >= principal+interest, and on due date the DO deducts from collateral (server-authoritative bal:, no on-chain action needed). Alternative honest product: a house-funded 'bonus' that is fully locked (games honour bucket) and only winnings above principal ever become withdrawable after repayment. Pick one; the current hybrid cannot be patched into safety.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Fixes the economics (who bears loss on default) instead of adding more lock paths; every leak C/D variant disappears because default has a defined, enforced consequence.

recommended_fixes.title: Line growth gated on tenure/interest paid; reset farmed lines
recommended_fixes.rationale: lineUsd *= 1.5 only when the settled loan was open >= N days or paid >= $X interest; one-time migration resets lineUsd to BASE for wallets whose settledCount is inconsistent with total interest paid.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Ties creditworthiness to the thing it is supposed to measure (paid, aged credit) rather than to a counter that can be spun.

recommended_fixes.title: handleLoanRepay: report refunded honestly and record orphans
recommended_fixes.rationale: On refund failure return refunded:false with the error, and write 'repay-orphan:<wallet>:<ts>' {amount, loanId, error} to DO storage so /play/reconcile can list it. Same for the LoanLedger-failure branches in handleSettle/handleStake: make the loanOp result load-bearing (fail the settle, or persist a 'taint-pending' record processed by a DO alarm), never drop provenance silently.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Converts silent state divergence into a recorded, reconcilable fact; no fabricated success flag. The alarm retry is DO-internal (no client poll).

recommended_fixes.title: poolBankroll: bound the age of the stale fallback and flag it
recommended_fixes.rationale: Return {v, at, stale:true} and have handleLoanDraw refuse to LEND on stale > N minutes (win gates may continue on stale with the flag logged). /health/play should surface bankrollAgeMs.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Stale becomes visible data with a policy attached instead of an unbounded silent substitute.

recommended_fixes.title: Capacity in /loans/summary: emit {ok:false, reason} instead of $0; align limitedBy; cards-hub renders 'unknown'
recommended_fixes.rationale: When /health/play is not ok, capacity = {ok:false, error:h.error}; cards-hub shows 'lending capacity unavailable' and disables the draw button rather than '$0.00 drawable'; fix the 'pool_buffer' vs 'lending_reserve' mismatch by sharing the string.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Unknown is rendered as unknown; the fabricated zero is removed rather than reinterpreted.

recommended_fixes.title: One definition of 'your OSTG' on screen: drop LoanLedger.clean from the UI and from publicWallet; use balance-truth spendablePlay everywhere; make the games chip tell the truth
recommended_fixes.rationale: cards-hub 'Your OSTG' -> OST_BALANCE.spendablePlay(); repay modal 'your OSTG' -> spendablePlay (and if the model keeps blended repay, say so in the copy); appbar OSTG face = onchainOstg + spendablePlay with Loaned shown separately; ost-ostg-source lockedTotal() returns undefined when the summary failed and the chip shows '—'. Games chip: either honour bucket server-side (per fix 5) or relabel to 'spends play balance (loan principal locked until repaid)'.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the drifted counter and the double-count at the source instead of adding a fourth reconciled number; unknown stays unknown.

recommended_fixes.title: Loan-repay intents must not enqueue OST delivery
recommended_fixes.rationale: creditIntent passes enqueue: intent.purpose !== 'loan-repay' (purchase-ledger already supports enqueue=false), and /topup/admin/pending filters purpose. Also carry the loan's struck rate on the intent so repayLoanFromCash converts at the same rate the loan was struck.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: The purpose recorded on the intent actually branches the money path; no reliance on an external dispatcher remembering to filter.

recommended_fixes.title: Stop the per-bet fan-out: return lock/owed on the bet response or push it over the single realtime channel
recommended_fixes.rationale: PlayLedger can include {loanLocked, owedUsd} it already fetches at cashout time... but cheaper: LoanLedger state only changes on draw/repay/prediction-settle, so ost-loan-usd and ost-balance should refresh on those events only (ost:loan-changed emitted by cards-hub/prediction flows), not on every ost:play:balance; long-term the DO WebSocket pushes loan deltas. Removes 2 of 3 requests per bet.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Refreshes are tied to the events that actually change the data; nothing polls, nothing is cached as a guess.

money-core.summary: Money core as of 2026-09-17, read-only deep read (all claims cite file:line actually read). The server side is mostly honest: balance-truth.js labels unknown/stale, PlayLedger verifies deposits on-chain and debits-before-send on cashout, PayoutGate is crash-safe/idempotent, /health/peg and /health/play refuse to fake a verdict. The client side and the rails around them are where money is still wrong. Verified critical findings: (1) POST /wallet/payout (wallet-payouts.js:106-231, routed publicly at index.js:3208) has NO auth, NO rate limit (rateLimited() is only used by cosign at :270) and no linkage to any faucet reservation or ledger; caps are 2% of pool per call (vaultConfig :521, wrangler.toml OST_VAULT_MAX_PAYOUT_FRACTION=0.02) with unlimited calls under distinct payoutIds, so the OSTC pool is an unauthenticated printer. Every client caller passes a CLIENT-DECIDED amount: faucet (app.js:4380), legacy-credits cash-out (faucet-hub.js:987, amount = localStorage credits), prediction cash-out (app.js:15730 -> devnet-rescue.js:374), memecoin sell (devnet-rescue.js:363), and non-SOL 'treasury deposits' that release OSTC for BTC/ETH/USDC that never arrive (wallet-extras.js:296-301, 382-395). (2) Legacy credits (ost.faucet.hub.v2) still pay REAL OSTC: ost-money.js:53-58 mints 25 credits to every new browser, code-academy/games-meta/parlay/prediction-extras/offline-vault add more, and faucet-hub.js:944-999 cashes the whole credits number out of the pool via /wallet/payout (MIN_PAYOUT 0.5 at :18). The 'credits pays on-chain' and 'silent downgrade to credits' bugs named in TOKEN-ARCHITECTURE.md §1 are still live (app.js:3669-3677). (3) The user-reported 'Reward vault is being refilled' message is a client-side fabricated zero: devnet-rescue.js:118-125 getPoolOstBalance catches ANY RPC error (its own hardcoded public endpoints api.devnet/helius-public/ankr, never the /rpc-config keys) and returns 0; app.js:4362-4368 then throws 'Reward vault is being refilled' before ever calling the server, whose own read failure would have said balance_unknown (wallet-payouts.js:139-141). On a 1027 day the worker path yields 'Could not reach the OST payout service' -> 'Could not claim OST right now. Make sure Devnet is reachable' (app.js:6829-6831): nothing anywhere tells the user the request cap was hit. (4) Budget: ost-balance.js:187-189 calls refresh(true) on EVERY ost:play:balance, and force bypasses the 6s gap (:53), so each bet costs a /play/bet plus a /balance/truth (1 worker request + 2 server RPC + 2 DO hops); and ost-play.js:335 sweeps pending deposits every 60s with up to 8 POST /play/deposit each (:293-305) for as long as a deposit stays unverified, while play-ledger.js:112-114 uses getSignatureStatuses without searchTransactionHistory so any deposit older than the status cache returns tx_not_found forever: funds sit in the pool uncredited and the client burns ~10k requests/day per stranded signature. (5) Solvency guard fail-open: play-ledger.js poolBankroll() (:636-647) swallows RPC errors and returns null, and every credit path treats null as 'no cap' (:687, :810, :876, :980, :1059), so wins are credited unbacked exactly when the chain cannot be read. Pool OSTC/SOL solvency is not monitored server-side at all (no cron/alarm; OST_VAULT_LOW_WATER only read client-side at devnet-rescue.js:443 through the same catch->0 read); only reactive per-payout checks exist, and SOL exhaustion surfaces as opaque send errors. Store blending persists in ost-balance-tree.js:83-84, ost-total-balance.js:80, ost-appbar.js:84+, ost-ostg-wallet.js:125. The OSTC<->OSTG 'Convert' in ost-ostg-source.js:302-346 is mislabeled: it moves wallet OSTG<->play balance (OST_PLAY.deposit/cashout), never OSTC; the real bridge is ost-bridge-ui.js. Event contract drift: ost-money.js emits 'ost-money-changed' while app.js/ost-predict-mobile use 'ost:money:change' (two events, different dispatchers); a successful SOL->OSTC swap (wallet-extras.js:234-291) dispatches neither ost:wallet-changed nor ost:balance.

steps: ost-games.js deposit button (:723-760): reads OST_BRIDGE_UI.balances() with catch leaving ostc=ostg=0 (:736-739) -> if RPC failed, throws 'Need N more OSTG... Claim from the faucet' for a funded wallet (:740-743); else auto-bridges shortfall then OST_PLAY.deposit

OST_PLAY.deposit (ost-play.js:246-281): ata-rent, fee-only transfer with 3 retries on transient (:266-273), addPendingDeposit, creditDeposit up to 8x POST /play/deposit (:291-308); server verifyDeposit (play-ledger.js:107-130) uses getSignatureStatuses WITHOUT searchTransactionHistory (:112-114) -> old/evicted status = tx_not_found (treated as transient by client :302) -> deposit stays pending forever; sweep every 60s (:335) + on wallet-changed/resume

Games: getBalance() = Number(OST_PLAY.balance())||0 (ost-games.js:193) renders 0.00 when unknown; playSingle maps insufficient_balance/bankroll_cap honestly (:400-405); server errors 'http_<status>' on 1027 -> 'Bet failed.' (:410-413)

Predictions: only BTC-5m rounds use OSTG via /play/predict/open (app.js:3572-3583); any other failure silently falls back to credits/wallet rail (:3577-3582); non-BTC markets stake OSTC into the swap pool (:3657) or credits (:3587), violating 'market accepts OSTG only'
weak_points: Stranded deposits + infinite sweep budget burn
Zero rendered for unknown play balance
Silent rail switching in predictions

flows.name: Drift and reconciliation between stores
steps: PLAY mirror (OST_PLAY) vs authoritative /balance/truth play: ost-balance.js:141-168 detects |delta|>0.01, console.warn + ost:balance-drift; no listener found (grep), no auto-resolve; mirror also seeded from localStorage cache with no stale flag

Σ play balances (DO 'total') vs pool OSTG on-chain: /play/reconcile and /health/play report drift honestly (play-ledger.js:1106-1172) but nothing calls them automatically (no cron); 'total' is clamped at 0 on stake/repay (:280,:323) so under-count drift is hidden

Legacy credits vs KV platform-ledger gameCredits: faucet-hub.js:75-93 overwrites local credits from remote every 15s (:1047-1049) with a value any client can POST (index.js:4346) — reconciliation in the attacker's favour

OST_TREE cache vs live chain: reportChain (ost-balance-tree.js:94-101) overwrites only on successful reads (app.js:8122-8130 keeps last on failure, sound); but cache is not keyed to current wallet on read (:66-73)
FaucetGate vs local reward claims: applyRemoteRewardClaimState merges max() (app.js:4082-4107); when gate is down local wins; commit failure leaves gate behind local (:4387-4391)

OSTG supply vs bridge vault OSTC: /health/peg (index.js:3082-3117) honest, on-demand only; ost-bridge-ui shows 'Peg check unavailable' when !pegHolds (:342) — a BROKEN peg (ok:false, pegHolds:false, 500) renders as 'unavailable', hiding a real break
weak_points: No automatic reconciliation anywhere; every checker is on-demand
Bridge UI collapses 'peg broken' into 'peg check unavailable' (ost-bridge-ui.js:341-343)

flows.name: Pool solvency monitoring (OSTC pool + SOL for fees + OSTG bankroll)
steps: Server reactive checks only: handlePayout reads pool OSTC per call (wallet-payouts.js:136-153; caps maxSinglePayout 1e9, maxPayoutFraction 0.02, minReserve 0 from wrangler.toml); sol-to-ost checks pool OSTC (:295-299); ost-to-sol checks pool SOL >= 0.05 reserve (:308-310); NO SOL check for payout/ata-rent/fee-only/cashout — pool pays fees+rent until empty, then every pool-signed tx fails with a raw send error

Server monitoring: none. No scheduled()/alarm in index.js or wrangler.toml [triggers]; /health (index.js:3734+) does not report pool OSTC/SOL; /health/play reports pool OSTG vs Σ play (play-ledger.js:1137-1172, 502 on read failure); /health/peg reports bridge vault only
Client 'monitoring': devnet-rescue.js:436-445 bootstrap console.warn 'POOL LOW' when poolBalance < lowWater 1e9, but poolBalance is catch->0 so it warns falsely on RPC failure and nobody sees console

When low: payouts 409 insufficient_pool/reserve_protected (honest text); cosign sol-to-ost 409 insufficient_pool (client maps to 'OST vault needs refill' wallet-extras.js:263, honest); play cashout: pool OSTG short -> buildSignSend throws -> refund + cashout_send_failed 502 (honest); bets: bankroll_cap 409 unless poolBankroll read failed (then unguarded)
weak_points: No SOL floor for the pool on the most common pool-paid paths
No server-side alert; low-water only a console.warn on a fabricated-zero read

defects.title: POST /wallet/payout is unauthenticated and pays any client-chosen amount from the OSTC pool
defects.line: 106-231 (routing index.js:3208; caps solana-pool.js:513-524; rateLimited only at :270)
defects.evidence: handlePayout validates only wallet/amount/payoutId; no signature, no header, no reservation lookup; only vault caps (2% of pool per call, minReserve 0) and per-payoutId idempotency. rateLimited() is called solely in handleCosignBuild. Client callers all pass amounts they computed: app.js:4380 (faucet), faucet-hub.js:987 (credits), devnet-rescue.js:363-369,374-390 (memecoin sell, prediction cash-out), wallet-extras.js:392 (treasury IOU).
defects.failure_scenario: curl -X POST /wallet/payout {wallet:<mine>, amountOst:<2% of pool>, payoutId:<random>} in a loop drains the whole faucet/swap pool; no attacker needed either — a tampered client-side payout amount in any caller is paid as-is.

defects.title: Legacy localStorage credits cash out as real OSTC from the pool
defects.line: 944-999 (credit sources: ost-money.js:53-58, code-academy.js:26, ost-games-meta.js:73/97/124, ost-parlay.js:595/666, prediction-extras.js:735, offline-vault.js:398)
defects.evidence: onCashout reads amount = s.credits from ost.faucet.hub.v2 (:950) and calls OST_RESCUE.payoutOst(wallet, amount) (:987); MIN_PAYOUT 0.5 (:18). ost-money.js migrate() mints 25 credits to every fresh browser. The store is user-editable JSON (PLAY-BALANCE.md acknowledges).
defects.failure_scenario: Set localStorage ost.faucet.hub.v2 = {credits: 1e7}, click 'Cash out from vault' repeatedly: pool pays 2%-of-pool chunks of unbacked OSTC. Even honest users convert unbacked welcome/academy credits into pool OSTC.

defects.title: 'Reward vault is being refilled' is produced by a fabricated zero pool balance, not by the vault
defects.evidence: getPoolOstBalance uses its own public RPC list (api.devnet.solana.com, helius public, ankr) and .catch(()=>0); returns 0 when !window.OST_SWAP_POOL too. app.js comment says 'do NOT block the claim' but the try/catch at :4363-4365 never fires because the callee swallows; poolBalance 0 < amount -> throw 'Reward vault is being refilled' -> UI :6819-6822. Server's own failure path says balance_unknown (wallet-payouts.js:139-141).
defects.failure_scenario: Public devnet RPC throttles (peak load, same time the 1027 cap tends to hit): every faucet claim is refused with 'vault is being refilled' while the pool is full and the worker would have paid.

defects.title: Cloudflare 1027 (daily cap) is never named; users see 'Make sure Devnet is reachable' / 'Could not reach the payout service'
defects.evidence: apiPost: res.json() on the Cloudflare HTML error throws -> generic network_error text (:169). runOstFaucetFlow falls to the else branch (:6829-6831) blaming Devnet. ost-play api() yields 'http_<status>' -> games show 'Bet failed.' (ost-games.js:410-413). faucetGateRequest returns {ok:false, httpStatus} treated as 'gate down' -> local fallback. Only comments (ost-idle-guard.js:12, prediction-modal.js:336) know 1027 exists.
defects.failure_scenario: Account hits 100k req/day; every user is told Devnet is down or the vault is loading; nobody is told the app is over its request budget, so support chases the wrong cause.

defects.title: Every ost:play:balance event forces a /balance/truth request (bypasses the 6s gap): 2 worker requests + 2 server RPC per bet
defects.evidence: boot() registers refresh(true) for ost:wallet-changed, ost:play:balance, ost:tree-changed; refresh() skips MIN_GAP_MS only when !force (:53). ost-play.js emits ost:play:balance after every bet/session/meme/stock call (:141,154,168,177,184,202,209). /balance/truth does 2 sequential RPC reads + 2 DO fetches (balance-truth.js:141-176).
defects.failure_scenario: A user playing 50 spins makes 100+ worker requests plus 100 server-side RPC reads; the 100 req/user/day budget is gone in one session; at scale this alone trips 1027.

defects.title: Deposit verification cannot see older signatures; pending sweep then retries forever (8 POSTs/min per stranded deposit)
defects.evidence: verifyDeposit calls conn.getSignatureStatuses([signature]) without {searchTransactionHistory:true} and returns tx_not_found when status is null BEFORE trying getParsedTransaction. Client treats tx_not_found as transient (:302 only no_ostg_to_pool/tx_failed/invalid_wallet stop), retries 8x per creditDeposit, and sweepPendingDeposits runs every 60s (:335) plus on wallet-changed/resume.
defects.failure_scenario: Deposit tx lands but the first /play/deposit fails (1027 or 429) for a few minutes; the signature ages out of the recent status cache; every later verify says tx_not_found; OSTG sits in the pool uncredited indefinitely while the browser fires ~11k requests/day against the capped worker. (Code path verified; the ageing behaviour relies on Solana RPC semantics for searchTransactionHistory=false.)

defects.title: Solvency guard fails OPEN when the pool OSTG read fails
defects.evidence: poolBankroll(): try{...}catch(_){} then returns cached value or null. Every credit path guards with `bankroll != null && (total+net) > bankroll` so null disables the cap.
defects.failure_scenario: RPC keys throttled for >20s; a run of wins (or meme sells / stock closes) pushes Σ play balances above pool OSTG; /health/play later reports UNDER-COLLATERALIZED but the credits already exist and are cashable.

defects.title: Prediction wallet rail silently converts a failed on-chain stake into a credits-funded ticket and pays wallet tickets with client-decided amounts
defects.evidence: On funding failure: if creditsAvailable() >= stake, OST_MONEY.spend and patch record fundedBy:'credits' with fake sig 'credits-…'. Settlement pays `payout` (computed client-side above :15690-15694) via OST_TRADE.predictionCashOut -> /wallet/payout. TOKEN-ARCHITECTURE.md §1 lists exactly this as the bug class to make unrepresentable; non-BTC markets still stake OSTC (:3657) or credits (:3587), violating 'market accepts OSTG only'.
defects.failure_scenario: User believes an on-chain position exists; it is a localStorage credit ticket; a modified client claims any payout via the unauthenticated payout endpoint.

defects.title: fetchDashboardBalances returns {0,0} on any error/no-connection and syncJourneyUi coerces undefined to 0 -> funded user told to claim the faucet
defects.evidence: `if (!conn) return { solBalance: 0, ostBalance: 0 }`; outer catch returns the same; syncJourneyUi does Number(balances.ostBalance || 0) -> hasOst=false -> 'Claim the 100 OST head start now' (:8245-8250, :8264-8269).
defects.failure_scenario: RPC hiccup during boot: journey card says wallet has no OST and offers the faucet; user re-claims / files 'my OST disappeared'.

defects.title: Games render 0.00 OSTG and refuse bets when the play balance is unknown
defects.evidence: getBalance(): `Number(b) || 0` with an inline admission it is 'unknown, not empty'; placeBet gates on it; deposit button swallows balance read failure leaving ostc=ostg=0 then throws 'Need N more OSTG… Claim from the faucet'. ost-play.js:113 keeps last-known with no stale flag; ost-ostg-wallet.js:117-126 also renders play 0 / total from (wallet||0)+play and persists fake 0 points to its sparkline (:129-134).
defects.failure_scenario: First seconds after load or during a 1027 outage: balance shows 0.00, bets/deposits refused with 'not enough' / 'claim from the faucet' for a funded account.

defects.title: Legacy credits blended into on-chain totals on three surfaces
defects.evidence: breakdown(): spendable = chain.amount + credits; total adds vault. Nav badge: total = getWalletOst() + getCredits(). Direct contradiction of balance-truth.js rule 2 'NO BLENDED TOTAL' and CLAUDE.md two-pools rule.

defects.title: OST_TREE last-known cache is not keyed to the active wallet on read

defects.title: ost-ostg-source 'OSTC <-> OSTG' converter actually moves wallet OSTG <-> play balance
defects.line: 302-346 (deposit impl ost-play.js:246-281 transfers OSTG_MINT ATA; cashout play-ledger.js:532-586 pays OSTG)

defects.evidence: fetchSolUsd returns 150 after swallowing all feed errors; quoteSolToOst/quoteOstToSol price real swaps from it with no flag.

defects.evidence: `if (j && j.pegHolds) … else 'Peg check unavailable right now.'` — a 500 {pegHolds:false, drift:X} is indistinguishable from a network failure.

defects.title: Pool SOL (fee/rent payer) has no floor and no monitoring; low-water only a console.warn from a fabricated read

defects.evidence: showOptimisticFaucetClaim + OST_OPTIMISTIC.balanceHint(+amount, pending) fire before reserve/payout; the catch branch sets status text but dispatches no rollback hint (contrast faucet-hub.js:1021-1025 which does).
defects.failure_scenario: Claim fails on 1027; balance hint keeps +100 pending until whatever expiry OST_OPTIMISTIC applies (not verified).

defects.title: Event contract split: 'ost-money-changed' vs 'ost:money:change'
defects.line: 81 (vs app.js:3567,15339,15638; listeners ost-predict-mobile.js:1113 vs ost-appbar.js:453, ost-total-balance.js:87)
defects.evidence: Two distinct event names carry 'money changed'; each surface listens to one.
