risks: Pool drain via unauthenticated /wallet/payout is exploitable today with one curl loop; the 2% cap only sets the rate.

Any hard reset of ost.faucet.hub.v2 will be undone by ost-data-guard.js backups (:30) and ost-engine-guard.js repairs (:27) and by faucet-hub.js:75-93 re-syncing credits from KV wallet:events unless those three are changed together.

The event fan-out on ost:wallet-changed (balance/truth + play/balance + loans/summary(+health/play RPC) + bridge/ostg-wallet RPC + updateWalletBalance) is multiplied by bridge-ui dispatching it twice per convert and OST_TREE dispatching it at boot; this is a structural request-cap risk independent of polling.
OSTG stranded in the pool by tx_not_found deposits is invisible to users and support: no endpoint lists uncredited pool inflows.
Client-side RPC lists are inconsistent: app.js uses /rpc-config keys; devnet-rescue.js:95-99 and wallet-extras.js:451 use public endpoints only, so pool-balance prechecks fail first under load.
play-ledger session 'building' and PayoutGate 'building' records require human reconciliation (409) with no admin tool found in this read.
POOL_OSTG_ATA is hardcoded in ost-play.js:27; if the pool keypair or derivation ever changes, deposits go to an account the server never credits (not verified on-chain here).
keep_as_is: balance-truth.js: four labelled places, null-not-zero, stale-with-age cache, degraded flag, sequential RPC reads, no blended total (whole file).
PlayLedger deposit: on-chain verification of source/destination ATAs and amount before credit; idempotent by signature (play-ledger.js:107-130, 450-480).
PlayLedger cashout: loan-lock fail-closed, debit + 'building' record before broadcast, refund only when send never left, no auto-resend on unknown state (play-ledger.js:495-606).
PayoutGate idempotency/building/sent/confirmed state machine and payoutId memo on-chain (wallet-payouts.js:113-230).
solana-pool.js getPoolOstBalance/getPoolSolBalance throwing instead of returning 0 (:282-307); withRpc cooldown rotation; assertPoolAbsent for fee-only.
/health/peg and /health/play refusing to fabricate a verdict on read failure (index.js:3093-3098, play-ledger.js:1146-1150).
x-ost-internal gate on /play/stake|settle|loan-* failing closed when the key is unset (play-ledger.js:406-425); /loans/* proxy attaching it (index.js:3300-3308).
app.js getOstBalanceForAddress returning undefined (never 0) and fetchDashboardBalances keeping the last on-screen value on undefined (:3821-3835, :8122-8138).
OST_BALANCE getters returning undefined when unknown; OST_CCY rendering '—' for non-finite.
Client RPC key chain from /rpc-config with cooldown rotation (app.js:2278-2309) and worker /rpc/blockhash + /rpc/send relay.
ost-bridge-ui.js honest 'wallet holds X' messages and letting the chain decide on read failure; readBal distinguishing 'no account' zero from unknown.
ost-idle-guard fetch gate for hidden/idle tabs (design; not part of this subsystem's files but load-bearing for the cap).
open_questions: Is POOL_OSTG_ATA BtXrBdbFrHdQ4d9F9uxV76fMa6TFHv1miL7MK9RipVKG (ost-play.js:27) equal to getAssociatedTokenAddressSync(OSTG_MINT, 5ibGwXAV…, Token-2022)? Not verified on-chain (no RPC calls made).

What HTTP status does Cloudflare 1027 return to fetch()? faucetGateIsDown treats >=500 and unknown as down; if it were 4xx-but-not-429 the branch at app.js:4153 still returns true, so behaviour is the same, but the httpStatus recorded in logs differs.
Does OST_OPTIMISTIC auto-expire pending balance hints? If not, failed faucet claims leave a phantom +100 (app.js:6711).

Are PredictionLedger settle calls the only remaining legitimate caller of /play/settle, and does app.js:15718 (OST_PLAY.settle on fundedBy:'ostg' tickets) still have live records that can never settle?
Which surfaces still mount faucet-hub's 'Cash out from vault' button in production (faucet-hub.js TEMPLATE :141-149 is loaded by index.html:6214)? If visible, defect 2 is live for every visitor.
Is there any admin tooling for PayoutGate/PlayLedger 'building' records (payout_unknown_state / cashout_unknown_state)? None found in the files read.
Does KV wallet:events ingestion (index.js:4300-4360) require any auth? The excerpt read shows none; if so gameCredits overwrite (faucet-hub.js:75-93) is attacker-controlled.

recommended_fixes.title: Make /wallet/payout server-authorised: every payout must reference a server-side entitlement (faucet reservation, PlayLedger cashout, prediction settlement) and the amount comes from that record, never the body
recommended_fixes.rationale: Closes the unauthenticated printer and, in the same stroke, removes every client-decided payout amount (faucet, credits cash-out, prediction cash-out, memecoin sell, treasury IOU).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the capability rather than rate-limiting or hiding it; the FaucetGate reservation (index.js:2426-2459) already exists as the entitlement for the faucet, so the payer reads amount/kind from the reservation and marks it paid; PlayLedger already owns cashout. No new fallback, no new poll: it is the same number of requests.

recommended_fixes.title: Retire legacy credits as a value store: stop cashing them out, stop minting them, and delete the key through the guards
recommended_fixes.rationale: Approved hard reset. Credits currently convert unbacked numbers into pool OSTC and still fund/receive prediction tickets.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Deletes the third store instead of guarding it; must also remove it from ost-data-guard CRITICAL and ost-engine-guard repair and drop faucet-hub's KV gameCredits re-sync, otherwise the value resurrects. Rewards that must survive become PlayLedger credits behind the internal key (backed by pool OSTG per PLAY-BALANCE.md), or are dropped.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete the client pool-balance precheck in the faucet claim and let /wallet/payout be the only solvency authority
recommended_fixes.rationale: The 'vault is being refilled' report is generated by a fabricated 0 from public RPC; the server already answers balance_unknown/insufficient_pool honestly.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the mask at its source (app.js:4362-4368) and changes devnet-rescue.js getPoolOstBalance/getPoolSolBalance to throw or return undefined so no caller can mistake failure for empty; saves 1-2 public RPC calls per claim.

recommended_fixes.title: Surface the request cap honestly: detect a non-JSON/1027 worker response in the shared fetch wrappers and show 'OST is over its daily request budget' with the retry-after time; stop retry loops on it
recommended_fixes.rationale: Users and support currently get 'Devnet unreachable' / 'payout service unreachable'; retries (swap-resilient queue, deposit sweep) make the outage longer.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Tells the truth about the failing layer instead of a generic message, and treats the cap as non-transient so clients back off; no fallback value is invented.

recommended_fixes.title: Stop the per-bet /balance/truth: on ost:play:balance update OST_BALANCE's play place from the event detail (server-returned balance) instead of refetching; keep force refresh only for ost:wallet-changed
recommended_fixes.rationale: Halves worker requests and removes 2 server RPC reads per bet; the DO already returned the authoritative balance in the bet response.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Uses the authoritative number the server just sent rather than polling for it; drift detection still runs on the next real refresh. Aligns with the one-push-channel directive (no new poll).

recommended_fixes.title: Fix deposit verification and bound the sweep: use getSignatureStatuses with searchTransactionHistory:true (or go straight to getParsedTransaction), and cap client retries with exponential backoff and a hard stop that lists the signature for support
recommended_fixes.rationale: Prevents permanently stranded pool OSTG and the ~10k req/day per stranded signature.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the server able to verify what actually happened on-chain instead of the client retrying blind; a deposit that truly cannot be found is reported to the user with its signature rather than silently pending.

recommended_fixes.title: Solvency guard must fail CLOSED: when poolBankroll() is unknown, refuse credits (bankroll_unreadable 503) exactly as handleLoanDraw already does
recommended_fixes.rationale: Unbacked play balance is created precisely when the chain cannot be read.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Mirrors the existing honest pattern at play-ledger.js:190-193; no cached guess, a loud 503 the client already knows how to show (bankroll_cap message). Debits (stakes) can still proceed; only credits are gated.

recommended_fixes.title: Add wallet-signature auth to client-callable PlayLedger mutators (signed nonce per request or a session key issued after a signed challenge)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Anyone can drain or gamble another wallet's play balance.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Binds the request to the keyholder; a session key (one signed challenge per session) keeps request count flat and fits the push-channel model.

recommended_fixes.title: Relabel/rewire the ost-ostg-source converter to what it does (Wallet OSTG <-> Play OSTG) and route true OSTC<->OSTG through OST_BRIDGE_UI.convert
recommended_fixes.rationale: Current labels claim OSTC moves; it never does.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Fixes the description to match the on-chain action instead of adding another conversion path.

recommended_fixes.title: Key OST_TREE's last-known cache reads to the active wallet and stop blending credits into chain totals
recommended_fixes.rationale: Cross-wallet balance bleed and blended totals contradict the four-store rule.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Cache remains display-only but becomes correct per wallet; badges render OST_BALANCE places separately or '—'. Follows from the credits retirement.

mobile.summary: Mobile OST is an additive shell over a 6.4k-line desktop index.html: an inline fastboot detector (index.html:6-140) marks the page mobile, compartments.js forces one-section focus mode (compartments.js:70,143-145,369-371), ost-appbar.js renders the ONE bottom nav (Home/Markets/Games/Wallet/More + tools sheet) 1.4s after DOMContentLoaded (ost-appbar.js:474-475), mobile-shell.js injects a 6-tile "mobile command center" into the hero (mobile-shell.js:74-127), ost-predict-mobile.js replaces the whole predict panel with an OSTG buy/sell surface that drives the hidden desktop board (ost-predict-mobile.css:264, ost-predict-mobile.js:1095-1105), and mesh/mesh-mobile.js (lazy) turns the mesh overlay into Feed/Chats/Pay/Play/Profile tabs. Verified strengths: OST_BALANCE unknown-is-never-zero (ost-balance.js:101-107), idle-guard fetch gate with an honest banner (ost-idle-guard.js:82-104,124-141), sw.js no-catch-all respondWith + user-consented update swap (sw.js:348-373,393-444; ost-update.js:170-248), jsQR floor for iOS (ost-qr-reader.js). Verified defects: (1) the mobile predict desk polls the worker at ~17 req/min while a BTC round is open (ost-predict-mobile.js:1137-1148) — 100 req/user/day is gone in ~6 minutes, directly against the free-plan directive; (2) balance is still rendered from 5 sources with 3 of them fabricating 0 or blending unknown as 0 (ost-total-balance.js:18-38,80; ost-ostg-wallet.js:159,217-226; ost-appbar.js:290-292; ost-predict-mobile.js:150-157; index.html:2102,2110; app.js:8091-8093); (3) /btc/round failure is masked by a client-invented round (ost-predict-mobile.js:608-618,580-589) that stays "Live" and tradeable; (4) the "sticky" buy bar and buy/sell sheet are position:absolute inside an unbounded in-flow container, so on a phone they sit at the bottom of the panel, not the viewport (ost-predict-mobile.css:275-283,411-425); (5) sw.js precache lists 8 stale asset versions vs index.html (app.js?v=243 vs 251, ost-predict-mobile.js?v=18 vs 27, ost-session-key.js?v=6 vs 11, ost-bridge-ui.js?v=3 vs 5, prediction-pro.js?v=206 vs 210, ost-world.js?v=4 vs 6, ost-cards-hub.js?v=10 vs 9, ost-ostg-wallet.js?v=1 vs 2) and the index.html offline warm-up writes 180 fetches into 'ost-pwa-runtime-v213' while sw.js RUNTIME_CACHE is v253 (index.html:6270 vs sw.js:2); (6) ost-lazy.js only flushes on hashchange (ost-lazy.js:95) but compartments navigates with history.replaceState (compartments.js:197), so the home "Mesh"/"Fair Games" tiles silently route to Wallet/Get-OST when mesh.js has not loaded (mobile-shell.js:111-112,124). First paint: 60 sync scripts = 2.61 MB raw (app.js 1.05 MB alone), 37 defer = 0.69 MB, 29 stylesheets = 0.74 MB, 423 KB HTML, 22 lazy = 0.68 MB, plus web3.js IIFE from unpkg and 2 Google Font sheets; 150 setInterval calls across docs/. Rebuild priority: kill the predict-desk polling in favour of the one push channel, collapse balance rendering onto OST_BALANCE with '—' for unknown, remove the fabricated-round fallback, make the buy bar/sheet viewport-fixed; polish the rest.

Tags existing mesh sections with data-mesh-view (js:569-575), builds Feed (worker /mesh/v1/feed/*, js:199-358), Pay (OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst / SOL transfer via OST_WALLET.sign, QR scan via OST_QR, js:360-522), Profile, Chats, Play, and a fixed .omm-tabbar inside the pavilion (js:167-192,543-561). components.name: PWA service worker + update + registration
components.role: CACHE_NAME ost-pwa-cache-v403 / RUNTIME ost-pwa-runtime-v253 (sw.js:1-2); 175 precache entries, pooled 4-wide, only CRITICAL shell awaited (sw.js:214-251); navigations network-first, versioned css/js/json stale-while-revalidate, cross-origin script/style/font/image cache-first, fetch()/XHR untouched (sw.js:328-444); skipWaiting only on first install, otherwise waits for OST_SKIP_WAITING (sw.js:348-373). ost-update.js shows a Reload bar when a worker is waiting, one reload ever, reg.update every 30min/visibility/online (ost-update.js:209-256). index.html registers sw.js, sets status text, and runs a 180-URL 'warmOfflineAssets' into 'ost-pwa-runtime-v213' (index.html:6252-6283).

components.name: Idle guard + offline mode
components.role: Idle guard wraps window.fetch: GET to *.workers.dev is answered locally with 503 when document.hidden or no input for 5 min, with a visible 'Live updates paused' pill; POST never gated; wake dispatches ost:resume + ost:wallet-changed (idle-guard:64-104,149-174). Offline mode wraps fetch to observe (never probe): 3 own-API failures + 12s quiet → body.ost-offline + top bar; [data-ost-needs-net] greyed; requireNetwork() helper (offline-mode:60-176,221-239,270-281).

components.name: Lazy loader + manifest
components.role: 22 entries (ghost, mesh/*, mesh-mobile, code-academy, qrcode-generator, ost-qr-reader, ost-pq-demo) injected one at a time on requestIdleCallback after window load, async=false to keep order; flush() only on the first hashchange (ost-lazy.js:86-95); dispatches ost:lazy-ready.

components.name: QR reader
components.role: OST_QR.fromFile / scanVideo: jsQR (vendored, precached) as the universal floor, BarcodeDetector fast path on Android; used by mesh-mobile scan-to-pay (mesh-mobile.js:389-396,504-511).

components.name: Balance sources rendered on phone (five of them)
components.role: OST_BALANCE = /balance/truth + client-RPC backfill, getters return undefined when unknown, drift detection vs OST_PLAY (ost-balance.js:49-107,141-168). OST_PLAY mirror with last-known localStorage cache, display-only (ost-play.js:74-117). OST_SESSION cachedWallet/cachedBal. ost-total-balance nav badge = OST_TREE.chain() or parseFloat(#wdOstBal.textContent) + credits (:25-38,80). ost-ostg-wallet card = OST_BRIDGE_UI.balances() (direct RPC) + OST_PLAY.balance() (:217-226). ost-bridge-ui reads its own RPC (:326-333). app.js #wdOstBal via getOstBalanceForAddress (undefined on failure, :3821-3835) but markup initialises to '0.00'/'0.0000' (index.html:2102,2110).

components.name: Onboarding surfaces reachable on phone
components.role: Welcome overlay (lang+currency, shown unless ost_prefs has lang+currency+welcomeVersion 'currency-picker-v2', app.js:13845-13856); #new-here faucet (#claimFaucetBtn → runOstFaucetFlow → /faucet/v1/reserve+commit gate, app.js:4180-4198); wallet Access tab cards (Phantom/Solflare/Backpack/'Create OST wallet' local keypair, app.js:4510-4523, backup file auto-downloaded app.js:2858-2861); Convert tab = OST_TOPUP intent → SOL/USDC treasury payment (app.js:6414-6440) and the bridge panel mounted first in #wallet-panel-convert .wallet-convert-grid (ost-bridge-ui.js:372-385); Predict tab = ost-predict-mobile; first bet via prediction-pro placeBet → placeFiveMinBtcBetDirect / DOM-driven card click (prediction-pro.js:1753-1790) → OST_PREDICTION_API.placeOrder wrapped by ost-onchain-route (route.js:183).

flows.name: Phone boot → first paint → bottom nav appears
steps: index.html:6-140 inline detector runs before any stylesheet: OST_MOBILE_FASTBOOT=true, html.ost-mobile-fastboot, viewport meta forced, localStorage defaults written (tour/guide seen, compartments.focusMode=false).

29 stylesheets load (index.html:248-275); mobile order: style.css → mobile.css → … → mobile-shell.css → ost-mobile-scale.css → ost-scroll-fix.css → ost-mobile-fit.css → ost-appbar.css → predict-mobile.css (last).

60 synchronous scripts parse/execute in body (2.61 MB raw): mobile-shell.js at index.html:5905 (before web3), then web3.js IIFE from unpkg (6126), rpc-multiplexer, ost-appbar.js (6169), app.js 1.05 MB (6187), compartments.js (6198), prediction-pro (6201), games 294 KB (6223) …; 37 defer scripts follow.
mobile-shell.js boot (mobile-shell.js:176-206): mounts .ost-mobile-home into the hero, toggles body.ost-mobile-shell, relabels FABs.
compartments.js boot (compartments.js:368-394): focusMode=true on mobile, active = location.hash section or 'home'; only that section is display:block (mobile-shell.css:113-122).
ost-appbar.js waits 1400ms after DOMContentLoaded, then builds the bar/sheet/backdrop and starts the 5s balance + 3s face-rotation intervals (ost-appbar.js:450-466,474-475).
window load → ost-lazy.js starts pumping the 22 lazy scripts on idle (ost-lazy.js:71-87); mesh, mesh-mobile, QR are unavailable until then.

OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) on DOMContentLoaded (ost-balance.js:185-191) → 1 worker request + up to 2 client RPC reads; ost-play refresh → 1 worker request; app.js loadDedicatedRpc → /rpc-config (app.js:2292) → 1 worker request; SW registration → precache (sw.js:239-251).
weak_points: No bottom nav for ≥1.4s + full sync-script parse (ost-appbar.js:474-475) — on a mid phone the 2.6 MB sync bundle lands well after first paint; the page is a hero with no nav during that window.
Home tiles for Mesh/Fair Games depend on lazy mesh.js; the fallback routes are wrong destinations (mobile-shell.js:111-112,124).
Inline fastboot persists compartments.focusMode=false (index.html:~84-85) while compartments forces true on mobile — two sources of truth for the app model.
Three files set the base type (mobile-shell.css:69 body 16px, ost-mobile-scale.css:21 html 15px, mobile.css:149-151 body 15px); CLAUDE.md says 16px base.

flows.name: Onboarding funnel on a phone: create/import wallet → claim → swap → bridge → first bet
steps: SCREEN 0 Welcome overlay (index.html:283-300): 2 taps minimum (language, currency, Next, Enter). Shown unless prefs complete (app.js:13845-13856). No network.

SCREEN 1 Home hero + mobile command center (mobile-shell.js:83-98). Tap 'Wallet' tile → activateSection('wallet','access') → OST_COMPARTMENTS.activate + click [data-wallet-tab=access] after 220ms (mobile-shell.js:57-72). Balance cards already show '0.0000 SOL' and '0.00 OSTC' before any read (index.html:2102,2110) — fabricated zero on screen.

SCREEN 2 Wallet › Access. Cards Phantom/Solflare/Backpack open external sites on a phone without the extension (app.js:4457-4491 window.open) — dead end on iOS Safari. 'Create wallet' → connectWallet('local') → Keypair.generate + persistLocalWallet (app.js:4510-4523) → setConnectedWalletSession(backup:true) → exportLocalWalletBackup auto-downloads a JSON file + 3 toasts (app.js:2858-2874) → verifyWalletAccount (1 RPC getBalance) → publishWalletState dispatches ost:wallet-changed → OST_BALANCE.refresh (1 worker + 2 RPC), OST_PLAY.refresh (1 worker), ost-bridge-ui.refresh (2 RPC), ost-ostg-wallet (2 RPC), ost-session-key armSoon (≥2 RPC + marketFor), app.js updateWalletBalance (2 RPC). Import path: Convert tab 'Paste an existing wallet secret key' textarea inside a <details> (index.html:2296-2305) — hidden two taps deep, not on the Access tab.

SCREEN 3 Get OST (#new-here). Reached via home tile 'Get OST' or More sheet. #claimFaucetBtn → showOptimisticFaucetClaim (balance hint before any network, app.js:6900) → runOstFaucetFlow (app.js:6729-6800): animateFaucetCoins, reward-state check (local), maybeRecordSeedlessOnboard, claimOstFaucetForActiveWallet → /faucet/v1/reserve + /faucet/v1/commit (app.js:4180-4198) + on-chain claim tx (pool-cosigned), then getOstBalanceForAddress (1 RPC). faucetAmount renders '0.00' initially (index.html:541).

SCREEN 4 Wallet › Convert ('Buy OST'/'Swap' links, index.html:2115,2119). #transferBtn (app.js:6383-6450): requires wallet else bounces to Access; OST_TOPUP.createIntent (worker) → settleIntent (SOL/USDC treasury tx) → possibly pendingVerification 'Waiting for devnet confirmation indexing…' with no timeout shown. This is a mainnet-SOL → devnet-OST purchase rail, not a swap of devnet SOL.

SCREEN 5 Bridge (same Convert tab, panel inserted first: ost-bridge-ui.js:377-383). Balances read by its own RPC (readBal, ost-bridge-ui.js:326-333) — '…' when unknown (honest). Convert → OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) (worker) then readBal fallback, ensureUserAtaForMint ×2 (worker /wallet/ata-rent), up-to-12×2 getAccountInfo polls at 1.2s, sendPoolFeeOnly (worker cosign + RPC send) (ost-bridge-ui.js:127-193). Then ost:wallet-changed + OST_BALANCE.refresh ×2 (immediately and +3.2s).

SCREEN 6 Predict (Markets tab → navTo('wallet','predict',…), ost-appbar.js:139). ost-predict-mobile mounts; browse grid from window.__ostPredictionMarkets ('Loading live markets…' until app.js publishes). Tap a BTC card → openMarket: loadRound (/btc/round), startFlow RAF loop, loadComments (/predict/comments), refreshBalance (OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) + OST_SESSION.refresh 2 RPC + OST_PLAY.refresh), loadTrades on round id (/positions/recent), loadOnchain (marketFor RPC). Chip shows '—' until playBal() knows something (js:170-178).

Tap 'Buy Yes' → sheet (position:absolute at the bottom of the panel, css:422-426) → amount/quick/Max → 'Buy Yes · N OSTG' → confirmBuy: optimistic balance drop + 40s hold (js:896-897), position card rendered as pending, sheet closes, ensurePlayFunds (OST_PLAY.deposit if play < stake: ensureUserAtaForMint + pool-cosigned transfer with up to 3 retries + /play/deposit up to 8 retries, ost-play.js:246-308) → OST_PREDICTION_API.placeBet (prediction-pro.js:1753-1763 → placeFiveMinBtcBetDirect → placeOrder wrapped by ost-onchain-route: on-chain place_bet if wallet+market open, else fundFromOstgNative POST /play/predict/open, app.js:3520-3569) → +800ms refreshBalance/refreshPosition/loadTrades.
Post-bet: 1s countdown, 6s /btc/round, 13s /positions/recent + refreshPosition, 40s refreshBalance, 60s autoClaimOnchain (js:1137-1148).
weak_points: Blank/zero/ambiguous balance moments (verified): #wdSolBal/#wdOstBal '0.00' before first read (index.html:2102,2110) and again whenever fetchDashboardBalances has no connection (app.js:8091-8093 returns {0,0}); nav total badge parses #wdOstBal text and adds credits (ost-total-balance.js:35-38,80); OSTG card totals (wallet||0)+play (ost-ostg-wallet.js:217-226); appbar OSTG face sums known+unknown (ost-appbar.js:290-292); predict chip playBal() sums wallet+play+session with unknown→0 (ost-predict-mobile.js:150-157); faucet pool '0.00' (index.html:541); optimistic faucet hint before the gate answers (app.js:6900); 40s optimistic bet hold can disagree with the ledger for 40s (js:896-897); bridge shows '…' (honest) while wallet card shows a number — same wallet, two renderings.

Ambiguous states: Convert 'Waiting for devnet confirmation indexing…' with no bound; predict sell path scrapes the hidden DOM cash-out button text for the net amount (js:727,825,942) — 'a picture of a balance'; if the button is not in the DOM the sale is refused with 'settles at close' (js:934-939).
On iOS Safari the three extension cards open app-store pages (app.js:4457-4491) — the only working path is 'Create wallet'; import is buried in Convert › details (index.html:2296-2305).

First bet can silently take three different rails (on-chain program / ostg-native custodial / credits) depending on wallet+market state (ost-onchain-route.js header; app.js:3515-3575,3590-3640); the sheet labels it 'Wallet OST · on-chain' vs 'Personal OSTG' only by onchainActive (js:815).

flows.name: App-bar tab navigation
steps: Tap → widgetsLive(false), setSheet(false), setActive(key) (class toggle only), t.go() (ost-appbar.js:383-389).
Home: activate('home', false) + window.scrollTo(0) (js:133-138).

Markets: navTo('wallet','predict',['#predictionMarketBoard','#live-bet']) → activate('wallet', false) (no scroll because subTab given), 300ms later click [data-wallet-panel-target=predict] then scrollToFirst on #predictionMarketBoard — which is display:none under `#wallet-panel-predict > :not(#ostPredictMobile)` (ost-predict-mobile.css:264) — then '#live-bet' (index.html:2651, also inside the hidden subtree) (js:109-128,139).
Games: navTo('games', null, ['#games']) → activate('games', false) + scroll to #games (js:140).
Wallet: navTo('wallet','access',['#wallet']) (js:141).
More: toggles the sheet; refreshSheet hides tiles whose `need` selector is absent (js:328-340); tile tap closes sheet, setActive('home') and runs the tool after 90ms (js:422-426).
weak_points: Markets tab ends on two hidden targets → scrollIntoView no-ops; the user is left wherever the page was scrolled (verified CSS; effect deterministic).
Active-tab state is only a CSS class; no aria-current/aria-selected (js:273-279).
Two 'Ghost AI' tiles (js:152,219); 'Mesh' tile needs #ost-mesh-trigger which exists only after lazy mesh.js (js:193).

flows.name: Balance chip refresh loop (what the phone renders every few seconds)
steps: ost-appbar setInterval 5s → refreshBalance/refreshBadge: reads OST_BALANCE getters (no network) (ost-appbar.js:460).
ost-appbar setInterval 3s → rotateBalanceFace (js:463).
ost-total-balance setInterval 4s → render(): OST_TREE.chain() or parseFloat(#wdOstBal) + credits → nav badge (ost-total-balance.js:75-92).
ost-ostg-wallet 90s + every ost:wallet-changed/ost:play:balance → OST_BRIDGE_UI.balances() = 2 client RPC (ost-ostg-wallet.js:220-221,239-243).
ost-predict-mobile 40s → OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) (worker, bypasses the 6s MIN_GAP) + OST_SESSION.refresh (2 RPC) + OST_PLAY.refresh (worker) (ost-predict-mobile.js:194-197,1141).

OST_BALANCE.refresh also fires on ost:wallet-changed / ost:play:balance / ost:tree-changed / visibility (ost-balance.js:187-190); idle-guard's wake() dispatches ost:wallet-changed on every resume (ost-idle-guard.js:152) — one extra worker round per wake.
weak_points: Five renderers, three formatting rules (fmtOst k/M in appbar, toLocaleString 2dp in predict, toFixed(2) in badge), three 'unknown' policies ('—', '0.00', partial sum).
ost:wallet-changed is used as a generic 'please refresh' signal by ≥6 modules, so one event fans out to ≥4 worker requests + ≥6 RPC reads.

flows.name: PWA install / update / offline
steps: index.html registers sw.js at pwaBasePath() (index.html:6341); status text 'Offline access ready on this device' is set on navigator.serviceWorker.ready (6345-6348) — before the non-critical precache finishes (sw.js:250 not awaited).
scheduleOfflineWarmup: idle → 180 same-page URLs fetched with cache:'force-cache' into caches.open('ost-pwa-runtime-v213') (index.html:6253-6283).
sw install: precache CRITICAL (index/markets/style/app/manifest) awaited, rest pooled in background; skipWaiting only if no active registration (sw.js:239-251,348-366).

Deploy: new sw.js with bumped CACHE_NAME installs, stays waiting; ost-update.js shows the Reload bar (ost-update.js:179-216); Reload → postMessage OST_SKIP_WAITING → controllerchange → one reload (170-177,244-248). activate deletes every ost-pwa-* cache except the two current names (sw.js:375-383).

Offline navigation: network-first, then caches.match(request) → './' → './index.html' (sw.js:253-264). Assets: stale-while-revalidate serves cached versioned files. Live API calls fall through to the browser and fail; ost-offline-mode flips body.ost-offline after 3 own-API failures + 12s quiet, or immediately on navigator.onLine false (ost-offline-mode.js:101-106,170,243).
weak_points: Precache list is stale for 8 assets (see summary) so the first offline load after a fresh install depends on stale-while-revalidate having cached the live URLs during the online visit — CLAUDE.md's 'add to PRECACHE and bump' rule is not being followed.
warmOfflineAssets cache name v213 ≠ RUNTIME_CACHE v253 → all 180 warm entries are deleted on the next activate and re-fetched every install (index.html:6270 vs sw.js:2,375-383).
Status copy claims offline readiness before the background fill completes.
Offline, the predict desk still offers Buy (no OST_OFFLINE_MODE.requireNetwork call in ost-predict-mobile.js) and the HTML's '0.00' balances render as if true.

flows.name: Mesh on a phone
steps: mobile home 'Mesh' tile or More › Mesh → OST_MESH.open() (mobile-shell.js:110-113; ost-appbar.js:193-196); requires lazy mesh.js.

mesh-mobile init polls for .ost-mesh-shell every 400ms up to 60× and on mesh:ready (mesh-mobile.js:612-614); tags sections, builds 5 views + fixed tabbar; setView('feed') → renderStories + renderFeed (/mesh/v1/feed/recent).

Pay: recipient input + Scan (getUserMedia → OST_QR.scanVideo; 'Use a photo' file path for iOS) → doPay → OST_RESCUE.sendPeerOst (OSTC) or SystemProgram transfer (SOL) (mesh-mobile.js:404-427,495-522).
Profile: /mesh/v1/feed/recent again for stats (438-455). Feed refresh 15s while open (604-607).
weak_points: Before lazy load completes, the Mesh tile routes to the wallet section instead (mobile-shell.js:112).
Feed poll (15s) + profile fetch are worker requests; donation posts two more (316-317).
Post send failure is masked as a local 'pending' post (mesh-mobile.js:228) — acceptable UX but it renders as if posted with a small '· sending' tag.

defects.title: Mobile predict desk polls the worker ~17 req/min while a BTC round is open
defects.evidence: setInterval 6000 → loadRound() (fetch API+'/btc/round', js:609); setInterval 13000 → loadTrades() (fetch '/positions/recent', js:653) + refreshPosition; setInterval 40000 → refreshBalance() which calls OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) (force, bypassing MIN_GAP_MS, ost-balance.js:53) + OST_SESSION.refresh (2 RPC) + OST_PLAY.refresh ('/play/balance'); setInterval 60000 autoClaimOnchain. Only document.hidden gates them; ost-idle-guard adds a 5-min idle gate. 10 + 4.6 + 1.5 + 1.5 ≈ 17.6 worker requests/minute for a visible watcher.
defects.failure_scenario: One user watches a 5-min round on their phone: 100 req/user/day budget is spent in ~6 minutes; 1,000 users → 1027 for everyone within the hour. Directly contradicts the 'worker must not be the hot path / no polls' directive.

defects.title: Fabricated round when /btc/round fails (clientRound fallback)
defects.evidence: loadRound().catch(() => applyRound(clientRound())). clientRound() (js:580-589) builds marketId 'ost-btc5m-'+openAt from the clock and sets priceToBeat from OST_PREDICTION_API.fiveMinRound(), else localStorage 'ost.btc5m.round.lk', else `beat || price || d.livePrice || 0`. applyRound then renders 'Live · closes m:ss', a price-to-beat, odds, and the Buy buttons stay enabled; comment says bets 'fall through to the credits rail'.
defects.failure_scenario: Worker at 1027 or KV exhausted: the user sees a live-looking market with a client-invented price-to-beat, taps Buy Yes · 25 OSTG; the optimistic balance drops and a position card appears; the bet is then routed to a rail the server never opened or is refunded later — the screen showed a market that did not exist.

defects.title: Buy bar and buy/sell sheet are anchored to the bottom of the in-flow panel, not the viewport
defects.evidence: #ostPredictMobile{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:460px;…padding-bottom:88px} has no height bound; .opm-buybar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0} and .opm-sheet{position:absolute;…bottom:0;max-height:90%}; .opm-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0}. Comment at :410 calls it a 'sticky buy bar'. The detail view stacks graph + YES/NO + pool + position + Trades/Holders/Comments panes above it (js:345).
defects.failure_scenario: On a 390×844 phone the detail is >1500px tall; 'Buy Yes/No' is only visible after scrolling past comments. Tapping 'Add more'/'Sell' on the position card near the top opens a sheet whose translateY(0) resting position is at the panel's bottom edge, off-screen; the scrim covers only the panel. The user sees nothing happen.

defects.title: Balance is still rendered from five sources; three fabricate 0 or blend unknown as 0
defects.evidence: getCredits catch→0 (:18-23); getWalletOst falls back to parseFloat(document.getElementById('wdOstBal').textContent) and 0 when missing/NaN (:35-38); render(): total = getWalletOst()+getCredits() → nav badge every 4s (:80,92). Same pattern: ost-ostg-wallet.js:159 initial '0.00', :217-226 play defaults 0 and total=(wallet||0)+play from its own RPC read; ost-appbar.js:290-292 OSTG face = (Number(a)||0)+(Number(p)||0) when only one is known; ost-predict-mobile.js:150-157 playBal sums wallet+play+session with any unknown as 0; index.html:2102,2110 seed '0.0000'/'0.00'; app.js:8091-8093 fetchDashboardBalances returns {solBalance:0, ostBalance:0} when no connection. ost-balance.js header (:5-13) documents that parsing #wdOstBal text was the day-one defect — ost-total-balance.js still does it.
defects.failure_scenario: Worker /balance/truth degraded and RPC 429: appbar chip shows 'OSTG 0' (play known, wallet unknown), nav badge shows credits only, wallet card shows '0.00', predict chip shows play-only — four different numbers for one wallet, three of them understating money.

defects.title: 'Max' quick-stake fabricates 25 OSTG when the balance is unknown or zero
defects.evidence: function maxBal() { var b = playBal(); return b > 0 ? Math.floor(b) : 25; } wired at :878 (data-q='max' → amt = maxBal()). confirmBuy then places `stake = amt` (:883-905).
defects.failure_scenario: Balance read has not landed (undefined) → user taps Max → ticket says 'Buy Yes · 25 OSTG' → optimistic balance drop and a pending position render before the server rejects with insufficient funds; the toast then says 'reverted'.

defects.title: sw.js precache lists stale versions for 8 assets index.html actually loads
defects.evidence: Computed diff (index.html vs sw.js PRECACHE_PATHS): app.js?v=251 vs ?v=243 (sw:81), ost-predict-mobile.js?v=27 vs v=18 (sw:82), ost-session-key.js?v=11 vs v=6 (sw:84), ost-bridge-ui.js?v=5 vs v=3 (sw:151), prediction-pro.js?v=210 vs v=206 (sw:136), ost-world.js?v=6 vs v=4 (sw:32), ost-cards-hub.js?v=9 vs v=10 (sw:40), ost-ostg-wallet.js?v=2 vs v=1 (sw:51). CLAUDE.md requires every new/bumped module to be added to PRECACHE with a cache bump.
defects.failure_scenario: Fresh install then airplane mode before the SWR runtime cache has seen app.js?v=251: precache holds ?v=243 (a different URL), navigationResponse serves cached index.html referencing ?v=251 → 'Offline access ready' page loads without app.js. Also every install downloads 8 dead files.

defects.title: Offline warm-up writes into a cache name the service worker deletes on activate
defects.evidence: caches.open('ost-pwa-runtime-v213') in warmOfflineAssets; sw.js:2 RUNTIME_CACHE = 'ost-pwa-runtime-v253'; sw.js:375-383 activate deletes every cache starting with 'ost-pwa-' that is not CACHE_NAME or RUNTIME_CACHE. collectOfflineAssetUrls fetches up to 180 URLs (6266-6283).
defects.failure_scenario: Every install/upgrade performs ~180 extra fetches on the phone into a cache that is wiped at the next activate; none of it contributes durable offline coverage.

defects.title: Lazy loader never flushes on in-app navigation; home tiles silently misroute before mesh loads
defects.evidence: window.addEventListener('hashchange', flush, { once: true }) is the only early trigger; compartments.activate uses history.replaceState('#id') (compartments.js:197) which fires no hashchange. mobile-shell.js:110-113: Mesh tile → if OST_MESH missing → activateSection('wallet'); :115-124 Fair Games → activateSection('new-here'). ost-appbar TOOLS 'Mesh' tile hidden until #ost-mesh-trigger exists (ost-appbar.js:193).
defects.failure_scenario: User taps 'Mesh' within the first seconds on a slow phone (22 lazy scripts, 0.68 MB, one per idle callback): lands on the Wallet section with no message; the More sheet has no Mesh tile yet. User concludes Mesh is missing.

defects.title: Markets tab scroll targets are display:none — navigation ends nowhere
defects.evidence: navTo('wallet','predict',['#predictionMarketBoard','#live-bet']) → activate('wallet', false) (no scroll because subTab/scrollSel given) → scrollToFirst on #predictionMarketBoard (index.html:2488) and #live-bet (index.html:2651), both descendants of #wallet-panel-predict hidden by `#wallet-panel-predict > :not(#ostPredictMobile){display:none!important}` (ost-predict-mobile.css:264); scrollIntoView on a display:none element is a no-op.
defects.failure_scenario: From the bottom of the Games section, tap Markets: the wallet section swaps in but the viewport stays at the old scroll offset; the user sees whatever part of the wallet section happens to be there, not the predictions surface.

defects.title: Sell amount is scraped from a hidden DOM button's text
defects.evidence: renderPosition: net = (myPos.cashText.match(/([\d,]+\.?\d*)\s*$/)||[])[1]; sellQuote realNet likewise; confirmSell parses btn.textContent for the optimistic bump and, if the button is absent after 4×500ms, refuses with 'settles at close' (:934-939). The button lives in the desktop ledger the CSS hides (css:264).
defects.failure_scenario: Ledger re-render or i18n changes the button label format → sell shows 'Sell · undefined OSTG' or a wrong net; the optimistic +net bump holds for 40s on a number read off a picture.

defects.title: Tap targets below 44px on phone surfaces
defects.evidence: .opm-back is a div 34×34 (css:514; js:290 — not a button, so ost-mobile-scale.css:55 min-height:44 does not apply); .oas-link min-height:38px (ost-appbar.css:279, class beats the `button` rule); .ost-mesh-close 38×38 (mesh-mobile.js:180); .omm-attach 44×38 and .omm-prev-x 24×24 (mesh-mobile.js:104,107); .opm-bal .k 8.5px and .oab-sub 9px text (css:297; ost-appbar.css:137); .opm-mcard .mf 9.5px, .msrc 8.5px (css:510-511).
defects.failure_scenario: Back arrow on the market detail misses under a thumb; 8.5–9px labels are unreadable at 15px base on a 390px screen; WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size fails.

defects.title: PWA status claims offline readiness before the precache finishes
defects.evidence: navigator.serviceWorker.ready → setStatus('Offline access ready on this device'); sw.js:246-250 awaits only CRITICAL, the remaining ~170 files are pooled without await; manifest description says 'Works offline after install'.
defects.failure_scenario: User installs on cellular, reads 'ready', goes offline within seconds: games/mesh/predict modules missing; app half-loads with console errors.

defects.title: Predict desk ignores offline mode; Buy remains armed with no network
defects.evidence: confirmBuy never calls OST_OFFLINE_MODE.requireNetwork (no reference to OST_OFFLINE_MODE anywhere in the file); no [data-ost-needs-net] attributes on .opm-buybar/.opm-confirm. ost-offline-mode.js:193 only greys elements carrying that attribute.
defects.failure_scenario: Airplane mode: tap Buy → optimistic balance drop + pending position → fetch TypeError → 'Could not place the bet — reverted' after a hold; ledger unchanged but the user saw a placed bet.

defects.title: Global reset that shatters horizontal scrollers is still live and is patched per-surface
defects.evidence: body.ost-mobile-shell * { min-width:0; max-width:100%; overflow-wrap:anywhere } applies to every descendant; predict-mobile.css:22-52,117-122 and ost-mobile-fit.css:116-129 re-add flex:0 0 auto/overflow-wrap:normal for the tape and chips only; mesh-mobile's .omm-stories-row/.opm-feat/.opm-chips set flex:0 0 auto but not overflow-wrap:normal (text can still break mid-word).
defects.failure_scenario: Any new horizontal rail (a games strip, a token list) renders one character per line on phones until someone adds another override — the documented CSS trap remains armed.

defects.title: Base type scale is set in three files and contradicts CLAUDE.md
defects.evidence: html{font-size:15px} at ≤820, 14px at ≤380; mobile-shell.css:69 body{font-size:16px}; mobile.css:149-151 body{font-size:15px}; CLAUDE.md: 'Mobile type scale lives in ost-mobile-scale.css (16px base — never reintroduce a global shrink)'.
defects.failure_scenario: An engineer 'fixes' to 16px in one file and the cascade order (scale.css loads after mobile-shell.css) silently keeps 15px; rem-based layouts differ from the documented intent.

defects.title: Inline fastboot persists compartments.focusMode=false, contradicting the mobile app model
defects.evidence: applyAccessDefaults: compartments.focusMode = false; localStorage.setItem('ost.compartments.v1', …). compartments.js:70-71 only honours the stored value on desktop when focusModeUserSet===true; mobile-shell.js:45-46 comments say never force focus off.
defects.failure_scenario: A tablet that crosses the 820px/1024px boundary (rotate, split view) re-evaluates isMobileViewport() on resize (compartments.js:391-393) and can flip between one-section and all-sections mid-session.

defects.title: Duplicate 'Ghost AI' tiles in the More sheet
defects.evidence: TOOLS[1] {lbl:'Ghost AI', need:['#ostGhostOrb']} and TOOLS[12] {lbl:'Ghost AI', need:['#ostGhostOrb','#ghost-summon-trigger']} both call OST_GHOST_COMPANION.open.
defects.failure_scenario: When the orb exists both tiles show; the 3-column grid presents two identical buttons.

defects.title: mobile.css kills every transition/animation ≤640px, including the sheet slide and press feedback
defects.evidence: *, *::before, *::after { animation:none!important; transition:none!important } at ≤640px; ost-appbar.css:197-208 sheet transition, ost-instant.js relies on CSS transitions for the pressed state, .opm-live pulse (ost-predict-mobile.css:307).
defects.failure_scenario: On phones the More sheet and buy sheet snap in/out and pressed state has no spring; the 'LIVE' dot never pulses — the UI reads frozen.

defects.title: Accessibility basics missing on the mobile chrome
defects.evidence: Tabs toggle .is-active only (no aria-current/aria-selected); sheet has role=dialog but no aria-modal, no focus move, no Escape/close button (only backdrop tap); ost-predict-mobile.js has zero aria-* attributes, .opm-back/.opm-fcard/.opm-mcard/.opm-trow are click-handled divs without role/tabindex (js:290,219,228,1044); no :focus-visible rules in ost-appbar.css, ost-predict-mobile.css or mobile-shell.css (grep: none); emoji glyphs are the tab icons (js:133-142); .opm-ink3 #647d92 on #050b13 ≈4:1 used at 8.5–11px.
defects.failure_scenario: Keyboard/switch users cannot reach market cards or the back control; screen readers announce '🏠 Home' as 'house building Home' and never learn which tab is active.

risks: Removing the predict-desk polls requires the RealtimeHub push channel to carry /btc/round state and /positions/recent deltas; if the DO WebSocket is not yet wired for those, a naive removal leaves the round countdown and trades stale (ost-predict-mobile.js:571-607 depends on d.ticks/closeAt).

Durable Object WebSocket on the free Workers plan: 1 request per session but DO CPU/duration limits still apply; not verified here that RealtimeHub handles 1,000 concurrent sockets within free-tier DO limits.

ost-predict-mobile drives hidden desktop money paths by clicking DOM buttons (js:934-951,1068-1071); any rebuild that removes the hidden board must first move sell/claim to explicit APIs or sales break silently.

Collapsing balance renderers onto OST_BALANCE makes /balance/truth a single point of display failure; its client-RPC backfill (ost-balance.js:84-95) must remain so a worker outage degrades to 'stale' not '—' everywhere.
Regenerating the sw.js precache from index.html will bump CACHE_NAME and trigger a full re-precache for every installed user (175 files, pooled 4-wide) — schedule with a deploy, not ad hoc.
The 40s optimistic balance holds (ost-predict-mobile.js:897,943,968) can mask a rejected bet or sale for up to 40s; tightening them exposes RPC lag jitter the holds were added to hide.

ost-session-key auto-arm drains the full wallet OSTG into a localStorage session key when an on-chain market exists (ost-session-key.js:188-200); any mobile flow that assumes wallet OSTG stays in the wallet (bridge withdraw pre-check, ost-bridge-ui.js:144-151) will mis-report.

CLAUDE.md's 'no new floating corner buttons' is enforced only by the hide-list; ost-appbar.js's own #ostShortcutsPanel (js:172-191) and ost-idle-guard/ost-update/ost-offline bars are fixed elements outside that list — acceptable today (top/above-bar), but z-index ordering (99500 bar vs 10070/10080/10085 pills) is coincidental, not designed.
keep_as_is: OST_BALANCE contract: every getter returns undefined when unknown, stale flagged, drift between play mirror and authority logged and dispatched (ost-balance.js:101-123,141-168).
ost-idle-guard fetch gate: GET polls to the worker answered locally with a real 503 (never a fake 200), POST never gated, visible 'Live updates paused' pill (ost-idle-guard.js:82-141).

sw.js discipline: no catch-all respondWith (so updates can activate), documents network-first, versioned assets stale-while-revalidate, skipWaiting only on first install, update swap only on user consent via ost-update.js (sw.js:328-444; ost-update.js:170-248).
ost-play last-known cache is display-only and never spendable; deposit credit is idempotent by signature with a pending-sweep (ost-play.js:66-117,279-311).
app.js getOstBalanceForAddress/updateWalletBalance keep the last chain-confirmed value on screen instead of writing 0 (app.js:3821-3835,8109-8129).
ost-bridge-ui readBal: 'could not find account' = genuine 0, anything else = undefined, rendered '…' (ost-bridge-ui.js:65-79,331-332).
ost-appbar as the single hide-list authority + safe-area env() math + tools sheet gated by `need` selectors (ost-appbar.css:40-60; js:147-229,328-340).
Compartments focus mode on mobile (one section at a time) and the mobile-shell decision not to force showAll (compartments.js:70,143-145; mobile-shell.js:45-55).
predict-mobile sell price lock and throttled DOM patching that never rebuilds a button at tick rate (ost-predict-mobile.js:169,482-517,780-787).
predict-mobile.css structural repairs: tape/chip nowrap restoration and the flex-basis→height fix with matched specificity (predict-mobile.css:22-52,82-139).
ost-qr-reader jsQR floor with BarcodeDetector fast path; mesh-mobile 'Use a photo' path for iOS (ost-qr-reader.js; mesh-mobile.js:373,389-396).
ost-mobile-scale v4 native density (no zoom transform), iOS 16px input guard, 44px button floor (ost-mobile-scale.css:18-67; mobile-shell.css:13-22).
ost-scroll-fix: overscroll-behavior none + overflow-x clip + 100lvh backgrounds + standalone body lock (ost-scroll-fix.css).
ost-lazy.js ordered idle injection with async=false (ost-lazy.js:41-53) — only its flush trigger needs fixing.
OST_WALLET.onReady replay contract used by ost-session-key (ost-session-key.js:214-217; app.js:6856).
ost-offline-mode's observe-don't-probe detection and the honesty rules in its header (ost-offline-mode.js:42-176).
open_questions: Does the worker's /play/predict/open reject a marketId minted by clientRound() when no server round exists, or does it open a custodial position against a client-supplied round? (workers/ost-api/src not read for this path.)

Is RealtimeHub (DO WebSocket) already publishing btc round state and recent positions so the predict desk polls can be deleted outright, or does it only carry toasts? (realtime.js and the DO were not read in this pass.)
Measured on-device numbers are absent: TBT, time-to-appbar, and script parse time for the 2.61 MB sync bundle on a mid-range Android are inferred from sizes, not profiled.

Does the DOM cash-out button (.prediction-cashout-btn[data-order-sig]) exist for every order type the mobile desk lists, or only for wallet/credits-funded orders? If not, mobile 'Sell' on those tickets is unreachable (ost-predict-mobile.js:934-939).
What does /balance/truth return for `play` and `loanLocked` when the play DO is unreachable — null (→ '—') or last-good? Only the on-chain branches were read (balance-truth.js:1-120).
Are markets.html visitors served the same lazy manifest and SW scope? diff shows only the <title> differs (verified), but pwaBasePath() logic for '/ost-token/' vs '/' was not exercised.
Is `#live-bet` (index.html:2651) ever laid out on mobile, i.e. is it outside the `:not(#ostPredictMobile)` hidden subtree? Line position suggests inside; not confirmed by DOM ancestry.
How many of the 150 setInterval sites are live on the mobile home path vs. gated behind section visibility — only the mobile-specific ones were traced.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete the predict-desk polling loops; feed round/trades/balance from the single push channel + local clock
recommended_fixes.rationale: ost-predict-mobile.js:1137-1148 is the largest per-user worker spend on a phone (~17 req/min while watching). Countdown can be derived from round.closeAt locally; round rollover, recent positions and balance changes should arrive as push events on the one DO WebSocket; OST_BALANCE.refresh(true) on a 40s timer should become event-driven only.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the request source instead of throttling it or caching stale answers; the screen updates from authoritative pushes and says nothing when none arrive (the idle-guard banner pattern), rather than re-asking on a timer.

recommended_fixes.title: Remove clientRound(): on /btc/round failure show 'round unavailable' and disable Buy
recommended_fixes.rationale: A client-invented price-to-beat is a fabricated market state that stays tradeable (ost-predict-mobile.js:580-618). Settlement truth is server-authoritative by directive; the desk must render the absence honestly.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Deletes a fallback that fabricates success; the failure becomes visible and actionable (retry / wait for push) instead of a plausible-looking round.

recommended_fixes.title: One balance truth rendered one way: all phone surfaces read OST_BALANCE and render '—' when any component is unknown
recommended_fixes.rationale: Five renderers disagree today (ost-total-balance.js:18-38,80; ost-ostg-wallet.js:159,217-226; ost-appbar.js:290-292; ost-predict-mobile.js:150-157; index.html:2102,2110; app.js:8091-8093). Delete ost-total-balance.js's badge or rewire it to OST_BALANCE.fmt; make ost-ostg-wallet read OST_BALANCE.onchainOstg()/play() instead of its own RPC; make the appbar OSTG face and predict playBal() return undefined if any addend is undefined; seed the HTML balance cells with '—'; make fetchDashboardBalances return undefined, not {0,0}. Add one shared formatter (OST_BALANCE.fmt) used by all.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates the alternative sources (screen-scraping, private RPC reads, credits-as-OST) rather than reconciling them; unknown stays unknown end-to-end so a degraded read can never print a smaller number.

recommended_fixes.title: Make the buy bar and buy/sell sheet viewport-fixed above the app bar (or bound #ostPredictMobile to the viewport with internal scroll)
recommended_fixes.rationale: position:absolute inside an unbounded in-flow container (ost-predict-mobile.css:275-283,411-426) puts the primary CTA and the sheet at the bottom of a >1500px panel. Use position:fixed; bottom:calc(var(--ost-appbar-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); z-index just under 99490, scoped to body.ost-mobile-shell, and give the scrim inset:0 fixed.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Fixes the geometry that makes the control unreachable; no scroll hacks or auto-scroll-to-bottom workarounds.

recommended_fixes.title: Flush the lazy queue on in-app navigation and make home tiles wait instead of misrouting
recommended_fixes.rationale: ost-lazy.js:95 listens only for hashchange; compartments uses replaceState. Listen to document 'ost:compartment' and appbar taps; in mobile-shell.js the Mesh/Fair Games tiles should call OST_LAZY.flush() and open on 'ost:lazy-ready' with a visible 'Loading Mesh…' state, never activateSection('wallet'/'new-here').
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the silent wrong-destination fallback and fixes the trigger that should have loaded the module; the user sees the true state (loading) instead of a substitute screen.

recommended_fixes.title: Generate sw.js PRECACHE from index.html at deploy time and drop the index.html warm-up (or align its cache name)
recommended_fixes.rationale: 8 stale precache versions and a warm-up into 'ost-pwa-runtime-v213' vs RUNTIME 'v253' (index.html:6270; sw.js:2,375-383) waste bandwidth and break the offline promise. A tiny node script (read-into-var first, per the CLAUDE.md trap) can emit PRECACHE_PATHS from the <script>/<link> tags + lazy manifest and bump CACHE_NAME; warmOfflineAssets is redundant with precache.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the precache derive from the truth (the HTML) so it cannot drift; deletes the duplicate warm-up rather than patching its cache name.

recommended_fixes.title: Point the Markets tab at the mobile surface
recommended_fixes.rationale: navTo targets are display:none (ost-appbar.js:139; ost-predict-mobile.css:264). Markets should call OST_PREDICT_MOBILE.mount() then scroll to #ostPredictMobile (or openFlagship()).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Targets the element that exists and is visible instead of adding fallback selectors that also no-op.

recommended_fixes.title: Disable 'Max' and Buy while balance is unknown; stop scraping the cash-out button text
recommended_fixes.rationale: maxBal fabricates 25 (ost-predict-mobile.js:789); sell nets come from btn.textContent (js:727,825,942). Expose the ledger's computed cash-out quote/handler on OST_PREDICTION_API (a function returning {net, kind}) and call it; render 'Max' disabled with '—' when playBal() is undefined.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Replaces a fabricated default and a screen-scrape with the real source of the number; unknown remains unknown.

recommended_fixes.title: Honest PWA/offline copy and offline-aware predict desk
recommended_fixes.rationale: index.html:6345-6348 claims readiness before the background precache; predict desk ignores OST_OFFLINE_MODE. Set status from an 'ost:precache-complete' message the SW posts after pooled(rest) resolves; add data-ost-needs-net to .opm-buybar/.opm-confirm and call requireNetwork in confirmBuy/confirmSell.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: The message states what is actually cached; offline buys are refused up front instead of failing after an optimistic render.

recommended_fixes.title: Accessibility + tap-target pass on the mobile chrome
recommended_fixes.rationale: aria-current on tabs, aria-modal + Escape + focus move on the More sheet, role=button/tabindex=0 on .opm-back/.opm-fcard/.opm-mcard/.opm-trow (or make them <button>), min 44px for .opm-back/.oas-link/.ost-mesh-close/.omm-attach, no text below 11px, :focus-visible outlines, restrict mobile.css's transition kill to decorative selectors so sheet/press motion survives (mobile.css:66-70).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Structural semantics and sizes, not overlays or hidden labels.

recommended_fixes.title: One base type scale and one app-model flag
recommended_fixes.rationale: Collapse html/body font-size to ost-mobile-scale.css only (remove mobile-shell.css:69 and mobile.css:149-151), update CLAUDE.md to the real 15px/14px ramp or change the ramp; delete the compartments.focusMode=false write in the inline fastboot (index.html:84-85). Dedupe the Ghost tile (ost-appbar.js:152/219).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the competing declarations instead of adding !important overrides.

recommended_fixes.title: Scope the mobile-shell global reset instead of patching each rail
recommended_fixes.rationale: body.ost-mobile-shell * {min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere} (mobile-shell.css:124-128) is the documented trap. Replace with targeted selectors (block containers, headings, paragraphs) and an opt-in .ost-scroll-x utility that sets flex:0 0 auto/overflow-wrap:normal on children; then delete the per-surface repairs in predict-mobile.css and ost-mobile-fit.css.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the cause (a universal selector) so future rails do not need a bespoke counter-rule.

backend-core.summary: READ-ONLY deep read of the ost-api Worker (index.js 5404 lines + 11 DOs + KV/D1) as of 2026-09-17. Verdict: the ledgers that were rebuilt as Durable Objects (PurchaseLedger, PlayLedger deposit/cashout, PredictionLedger resolve, PayoutGate idempotency, settlement.js) are sound in their internal mechanics, but the AUTHORIZATION layer in front of them is largely absent and the pricing inputs into them are still sourced from the eventually-consistent KV/Cache tier. Four CRITICAL/HIGH money defects verified in code: (1) POST /wallet/payout is an unauthenticated pool→wallet transfer of client-chosen amountOst, capped only at 2% of pool per call and 1e9 OST (index.js:3208-3211 → wallet-payouts.js:106-231; client devnet-rescue.js:212 asserts the amount) — an unauthenticated money printer on real pool OST; (2) /loans/draw forwards a CLIENT-supplied usdPerOstg into PlayLedger/LoanLedger (index.js:3300-3309, play-ledger.js:182-187, loan-ledger.js:106-107,143-150; client ost-cards-hub.js:392), so a $100 line converts to arbitrarily many OSTG; (3) /play/predict/open and /cashout compute entry/sell odds from KV 'btc:latest' which is never refreshed while the hub is healthy, and default silently to 0.5 on any error (index.js:3382-3407, 3419-3441) — mispriced, exploitable entries; (4) every /play/* mutator (bet, session, meme, stock, cashout, rotate, predict open) authenticates the wallet by a plain string (play-ledger.js:380-448; only stake/settle/loan-* are internal-keyed at 414-426). Additional HIGH: RealtimeHub WebSocket 'publish' messages bypass the PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES allowlist (realtime.js:350-352 vs 177-196), and POST /wallet/events (index.js:4308-4355) lets anyone push private 'transaction.alert' events to any wallet channel — fake payment notifications, the exact class the July remediation targeted. Consistency: the DO IS authoritative for BTC rounds via getCanonicalBtcRound (index.js:1585-1591) and the market-state degraded path IS flagged (1476-1500), but the BTC-round fallback buildCanonicalBtcRound returns canonical:true with no degraded flag (511-537) and /btc/ticks fallback writes KV on reads; kvGet's Cache API tier is still per-colo 300s over eventual KV for every non-DO key (745-761, 753-757). Capacity: the client still runs several unthrottled/aggressive worker polls (prediction-modal /positions/recent every 1s at 2159; ost-onchain-sync /play/onchain+/play/reconcile every 5s incl. a Solana RPC per reconcile; /balance/truth every 6s doing 2 RPC + 2 DO; /ost/price 10s), each far beyond the 100 req/user/day budget; RealtimeHub already broadcasts the full round snapshot on price.tick (index.js:1876-1896) so zero polling of /btc/round is needed. July gates verified still present: x-ost-internal on play mutators, REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN on HTTP publish, DO rate limiter on /ghost/chat (fail-open), TOFU on mesh announce. mesh-games XSS escaping is client-side and was not in the read set (not verified). Live worker was NOT called (0 of 2 allowed calls used).

components.name: Router + BTC round engine + tiered store (index.js)
components.role: Single fetch() router (index.js:3047-5403) for ~70 route families; inline NativeMarketHub DO (1660-2035) and FaucetGate DO (2372-2540); BTC feed waterfall (96-171), kline open price (221-303), Coinbase 5m close (310-343); tiered store memory→CacheAPI→KV→D1→R2 with circuit breakers (585-819); native market-maker math (1109-1451); Polymarket relays (3533-3567, 4009-4052); topup/Stripe/crypto verification (2541-3043, 4652-4990); launchpad/stocks/positions/comments/wallet-events KV lists (4118-4600, ~5048-5110); bot API (~5113-5400).

components.name: PlayLedger DO (play balance, games, memes, stocks, loans rails)
components.role: Single global DO 'global' (index.js:3491-3494 forwards ALL /play/* and /health/play raw). Owns bal:<wallet>, total, seed:<wallet>, sess:*, meme:*, stockpos:*, cashout:*, dep:*, poolOstgCache. Deposit verified on-chain (107-130, 450-480); cashout pool→user with crash-safe idempotency (495-606); bets HMAC from secret seed (648-716); internal-key gate ONLY on stake/settle/loan-draw/loan-repay (414-426); /play/rl rate-limit counter (362-378).

components.name: PayoutGate DO + pool signer
components.role: Holds OST_POOL_SECRET_KEY server-side (solana-pool.js:130-140). /wallet/payout pool→user transferChecked with caps from vaultConfig (wallet-payouts.js:106-231; caps solana-pool.js:513-524); /wallet/ata-rent (238-255); /wallet/cosign build/submit for sol-to-ost, ost-to-sol, peer-transfer, fee-only (261-381). withRpc rotation with cooldown (solana-pool.js:97-127); confirmSignature manual polling (345-378).

components.name: PredictionLedger DO
components.role: Server-owned OSTG prediction positions ppos:*; open debits via PlayLedger stake with x-ost-internal (56-66, 134); resolve idempotent, rejects settlePrice<=0 (160-229); sell at server odds (240-277). Entry odds and priceToBeat are supplied by index.js /play/predict/* (index.js:3371-3468); openPrice from KV round:<openAt> via env.__store (79-86).

components.name: LoanLedger DO
components.role: Credit lines + provenance buckets (clean / tainted[loanId]); borrow/stake/settle/repay/void/summary (100-395). Debt in USD at the rate passed by the caller (106-107, 143-150). Reached via index.js /loans/* proxy (3265-3357) and PlayLedger.loanOp (play-ledger.js:151-160).

components.name: PurchaseLedger DO + settlement adapters
components.role: Real-money intents, atomic credit keyed on payment ref (purchase-ledger.js:146-195), D1 audit journal (57-109), dispatcher queue. settlement.js: NOWPayments HMAC-SHA512 verify, amount check vs intent, SETTLEMENT_LIVE kill switch, loan-repay-from-cash branch (159-272).

components.name: RealtimeHub DO (push channel)
components.role: WebSocket hub 'ost-realtime-hub-v1': /realtime/v1/ws (270-302), /publish (HTTP gated by REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN or PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES allowlist 154-197), /events poll fallback (252-261), MAX_CLIENTS 1200 (9), recent 220 events persisted (304-322). Server code publishes via publishRealtimeEvent (201-214) from NativeMarketHub btcSnapshot (index.js:1876-1896), positions, wallet events, faucet, launchpad, stocks, topup.

components.name: NativeMarketHub DO (BTC round + native market state) — TWO implementations
components.role: The LIVE class is the one in index.js (1660-2035; exported at wrangler class_name NativeMarketHub — index.js does not import native-market.js, so native-market.js:178-336 is DEAD CODE with a different odds model). Live DO: blockConcurrencyWhile on every request (1661), btcSnapshot 250ms cache (1849-1852), refreshBtcState fires all 4 BTC feeds in parallel when livePriceTs>650ms old (1755-1767 → 150-171), rollover snapshot btc:round:<openAt> using last livePrice as closePrice (1729-1750), /btc/round-result with Coinbase-kline fallback memoized (1993-2018), quoteMarket WRITES storage on every GET (1946-1954).

components.name: GameSeedHub DO (legacy per-player seed)
components.role: Per-player commit-reveal seed for the legacy client-computed games (/games/seed, /rotate, /digest; 96-143); player id is client-chosen (146-167). PlayLedger now holds its own per-wallet seed (play-ledger.js:610-630), so this DO serves only the old rail.

components.name: FaucetGate DO
components.role: Per-wallet reservation/commit/cancel of faucet claims (index.js:2372-2540). Commit records a client-supplied signature without verifying it (2462-2508); the actual OST movement is a separate /wallet/payout call from the client.

components.name: MeshHub DO + KV mesh fallback
components.role: Directory (TOFU 271-298), signaling inbox in DO memory (360-405), offline mailbox msg:* (407-422, 487-502), friend graph (425-485), presence, shared feed with likes/replies/donation totals (170-261), admin clear via MESH_ADMIN_KEY (157-161). index.js:3203-3205 routes all /mesh/ to the DO; KV code paths in identity.js/signal.js only run if MESH_HUB is unbound.

components.name: AdTreasury DO
components.role: Server-side daily view cap per client-chosen uid (47-73, 166-177); admin-only revenue entries idempotent on reference (76-99, 181-189); public summary separates accrued vs received (101-124).

components.name: OST price + anchor
components.role: /ost/price,/stats,/history,/event: P0*A(t)*N(t)*M(t) with Pyth FX anchor (ost-anchor.js:77-136, stale-flagged) and KV counters/history via env.__store with 20s write coalescing (382-430).

components.name: Balance truth
components.role: /balance/truth: 2 sequential Solana RPC reads + PlayLedger + LoanLedger, unknown never zero, degraded flag (121-217).

components.name: Web push
components.role: VAPID bare push, subscriptions in D1 push_subs, endpoint host allowlist (173-248).

components.name: Ghost AI
components.role: /ghost/chat Workers AI with PlayLedger-backed IP rate limit 12/min fail-open (index.js:3129-3194); /ghost/v2/* Groq/Gemini/DDG relay, anthropic proxy with user key, KV journal and KV peer stubs.
