flows.name: BTC 5-min round read (hot path) and its fan-out
steps: Client prediction-modal fetchBtcLive every 500ms + per WS tick (prediction-modal.js:2480,2366-2400) → only hits worker /btc/round when cached btcSpot tick >1500ms stale, throttled to 4s (66,100-105); prediction-pro 1.5s cadence (prediction-pro.js:70); ost-predict-hud 20s (149)

GET /btc/round (index.js:3872) → globalThis.__ostRoundCache 900ms isolate cache (3874-3876) else getCanonicalBtcRound (1585) → nativeMarketHubJson('/btc/round') (1531-1544) → NativeMarketHub DO fetch under blockConcurrencyWhile (1661)

DO btcSnapshot (1845): 250ms in-DO cache else refreshBtcState (1752): rollover check + Promise.all([kline open via 2 URLs Promise.any (263-303) if open missing/non-kline, fetchBtcPriceFast = ALL 4 BTC_FEEDS in parallel (150-171) if livePriceTs>650ms]) + fetchBtcPrior5mDriftFast (289-294, 180ms race → 0) + storage.put('btc:state') every call (1809)

DO publishes price.tick (with FULL snapshot payload incl. ticks) to RealtimeHub DO when >1200ms or ≥0.5 USD moved (1876-1896) → WS broadcast to all clients on channels all/price/price:btc/prediction/market:<id>

Fallback when hub fails: hubFailed() logs+counts (1521-1528) → buildCanonicalBtcRound (461-538): memGet/kvGet btc:latest, fetchBtcPrice, lockRoundOpenPrice + appendBtcTick KV writes (474-477), kvGet round:<openAt>, fetchBtcRoundOpenPrice; returns canonical:true (536) — UNFLAGGED
weak_points: One /btc/round cache miss = 1 worker req + 1 NativeMarketHub DO req + up to 4-7 external subrequests + 1 RealtimeHub DO req + 1 DO storage write; all serialized through ONE DO instance with external fetches inside blockConcurrencyWhile
Fallback payload is indistinguishable from authoritative (canonical:true, no degraded flag) unlike getNativeMarketState (1476-1500)

Binance klines are documented as blocked from CF egress (322-325, 3539-3540) yet remain the ONLY open-price source (263-303); when they fail the DO uses the first live tick as a 'provisional-open' (1779-1786) — the open price is then traffic-timing dependent

Rollover closePrice = last cached livePrice at the first request after the boundary (1729-1750), a different definition from the Coinbase 5m candle close used as fallback (310-343); getBtcRoundResult prefers the DO snapshot (1600) so settlement truth depends on traffic pattern

flows.name: OSTG prediction open → sell → resolve (money)
steps: Client POST /play/predict/open {wallet, marketId, side, stake, bucket} (index.js:3375) — no auth

index.js computes oddsYes: getCanonicalBtcRound(refresh:false) for openPrice/priceToBeat (3389-3398), live price from memGet('btc:latest')||kvGet('btc:latest') (3390-3391) — canon.livePrice is NOT used; any throw → oddsYes stays 0.5 (3382, 3407)

PredictionLedger.open (prediction-ledger.js:98-155): PREDICT_LIVE gate, round not closed, openPrice from KV round:<openAt> via __store (79-86,122) else body.priceToBeat, entry=clampOdds(oddsYes), shares=stake/entry, PlayLedger stake with x-ost-internal (134), position stored with priceToBeat line (143-153)
Sell: POST /play/predict/cashout (3413-3446) same stale-live odds computation → ledger.sell pays shares×cur minus 2% of profit via internal settle (240-277)

Resolve: POST /play/predict/resolve (3447-3468) → getBtcRoundResult (1594-1614): DO btc:round:<openAt> snapshot if closePrice>0, else after close+8s Coinbase 5m candle (fallback:true) → ledger.resolve rejects settlePrice<=0 (185-187), pays shares−2% profit via internal settle (212-217), idempotent
weak_points: Entry/sell odds sourced from a KV key (btc:latest) that is only written by the fallback paths (appendBtcTick at 410-425 is called from 476, 3859, 3921 — none run while the hub is healthy) → odds are stale or 0.5 by construction
Anyone can open/sell positions for any wallet (griefing/forced losses); open at 0.5 late in a decided round is +EV against the house

Position id p_<openAt>_<wallet6>_<ts36><rand3> is guessable enough to trigger sell on others (resolve is idempotent and harmless; sell is not harmless: it force-exits a winning position at current odds)

flows.name: Play balance: deposit → bet/session/meme/stock → cashout
steps: POST /play/deposit {wallet, signature} → verifyDeposit reads parsed tx, sums transfers from user OSTG ATA to pool OSTG ATA (play-ledger.js:107-130) → locked dedup+credit (469-478)

POST /play/bet → poolBankroll() (635-646: DO-cached 20s, RPC else cached-or-null) → locked loop: nonce+1, computeBet from secret seed, solvency check only if bankroll != null (686), write bal/total/seed (695-699)
Session start/step/cashout (744-885), meme buy/sell (911-991), stock open/close with server-fetched Yahoo price (1003-1066) — all locked, all solvency-gated only when bankroll != null

POST /play/cashout {wallet, amount, idempotencyKey} → LoanLedger summary lock check fails closed (514-530) → locked: idempotency, debit, 'building' record, buildSignSend; refund only if broadcast threw (552-590) → unlocked confirm (596-605)
weak_points: No wallet signature anywhere: any caller can spend/cash-out/rotate any wallet by naming it
Solvency gate silently disabled when poolBankroll() returns null (644-645 catch, 686/810/877/980/1059 `bankroll != null &&`)

handleBet ignores `bucket` for LoanLedger provenance (703-716) while cashout subtracts lockedTotal — loan-funded winnings are withdrawable (documented as intended, but combined with client-chosen usdPerOstg it is an extraction path)

flows.name: Loan draw / repay
steps: Client ost-cards-hub.js:392 POST /loans/draw {wallet, usd, usdPerOstg: rate()} → index.js:3265-3309 geoblock + LOANS_MODE, then forwards RAW body to PlayLedger /play/loan-draw with x-ost-internal

PlayLedger.handleLoanDraw (178-244): wantOstg = usd/usdPerOstg from body (182-187); lendable = 50% of (bankroll − total) (206-207); LoanLedger.borrow records principalUsd=usd, principalOstg=usd/rate (loan-ledger.js:143-150); credits principalOstg to bal under lock (225-234)
Repay from play: /loans/repay → handleLoanRepay debits first, then LoanLedger.repay viaPlay (257-298); cash repay via settlement webhook uses intent.usdPerOst (server rate) (index.js:3236-3249)
weak_points: usdPerOstg is client-supplied on the draw path; the only bound is `lendable` (half the pool buffer)
No default/collections path: defaultedCount never incremented; interest accrues but nothing enforces repayment; drawn OSTG spent in games yields withdrawable winnings

flows.name: Real-money top-up (Stripe / crypto / NOWPayments) → delivery
steps: POST /topup/intent → PurchaseLedger put (index.js:4686-4726); /topup/checkout → Stripe session, ref.map (4728-4764)

Stripe webhook HMAC verified (2606-2622) → intent paid + queue (4766-4805); crypto: /topup/crypto/verify on-chain memo+amount check (2872-2942) → ledger credit atomic on signature (purchase-ledger.js:146-195)
NOWPayments IPN → settlement.js verify + amount vs intent + SETTLEMENT_LIVE → credit; loan-repay branch (159-272)

Delivery: EITHER admin dispatcher (/topup/admin/pending + mark-sent, 4867-4904) OR client 'self-release' then POST /topup/claim {id, wallet, signature, deliveryKind} which marks 'sent' and removes from queue WITHOUT verifying the signature (4826-4865)
weak_points: /topup/claim trusts a client-asserted delivery signature — a paid intent can be marked delivered by anyone holding the intent id (present in the Stripe success_url 4737 and readable via public /topup/status/:id)
jurisdictionBlocked applies to the provider webhook path (3222-3224), keyed on the PROVIDER's egress country, not the customer's

flows.name: Tiered store (kvGet/kvPut) and cross-colo consistency
steps: kvGet (index.js:745-761): memory (60s) → caches.default synthetic origin key (612-628, 300s max-age) → KV → D1 → R2 → `fallback` (null/[])
kvPut (800-819): memPut + cachePut(local colo only) then Promise.all KV+D1+R2; hot keys (btc:latest, btc:ticks:*, launchpad:ticks:*, ost:counters, ost:history) skip durable tiers within 25s (777-797)
Breakers: any tier error trips it 60s (595-599); KV quota errors → tierDown('kv') → appendBtcTick sheds the ring (414)

Every KV-backed list is read-modify-write (positions:<w> 4282-4283, positions:recent 4285-4287, launchpad:coins 4478-4479, wallet:events 4348-4350, payouts:* ~5070-5085, comments 4160-4166, offline-vault ~5010-5020)
weak_points: Per-colo Cache API 300s over eventual KV is still the read path for every non-DO key: positions, launchpad, comments, wallet events, payouts audit, round:<openAt> (used by /play/predict/open fallback and PredictionLedger.roundRecord)
Read-modify-write lists lose concurrent writes across colos and clobber with [] when all tiers are tripped (kvGet returns the [] fallback, then kvPut overwrites)
Non-hot keys (positions:*, launchpad:coins) count against the ~1k/day KV write budget on every POST

flows.name: Realtime publish/subscribe (the push channel)
steps: Client realtime.js:26 opens wss://<api>/realtime/v1/ws?wallet=… → RealtimeHub.handleWebSocket (realtime.js:270-302) subscribes default channels + wallet:<w>
Server publishes via publishRealtimeEvent (201-214) → hub /publish → normalizeEvent → broadcast to matching sessions (315-322, 365-376)
HTTP /realtime/v1/publish: token or PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES (154-197)
WS frame {type:'publish', event} → this.publish(event) with clientId — no auth, no type allowlist (350-352)
WS down → client polls /realtime/v1/events every 10s (150,164)
weak_points: WS publish bypasses the privileged-type allowlist; client-side receivers dispatch wallet.*/transaction.*/topup.* to ost:wallet-changed per the module's own comment (171-177)
MAX_CLIENTS 1200 per single DO instance (9, 274-276) is the ceiling for 'one WebSocket per user'; no sharding
recent-events persisted to DO storage on every publish (319, 311-313) — one storage write per price tick (~1/1.2s while anyone is watching)

defects.title: POST /wallet/payout is an unauthenticated pool→wallet OST transfer of a client-chosen amount
defects.evidence: handleWalletPayoutsRequest forwards the raw request to PayoutGate with no header/signature check (index.js:3208-3211, wallet-payouts.js:388-392). handlePayout validates only pubkey, amt>0, cap (OST_MAX_SINGLE_PAYOUT=1e9), pool balance, 2% dynamic cap, reserve=0 (106-153), then buildSignSend with the pool keypair (207). rateLimited() exists but is only used by cosign (270). The client itself asserts amountOst (devnet-rescue.js:212).
defects.failure_scenario: curl -X POST /wallet/payout -d '{"wallet":"<attacker>","amountOst":<2% of pool>,"payoutId":"x1"}' repeated with fresh payoutIds drains the pool 2% per call (~50 calls ≈ 63%). No ticket, no signature, no rate limit. On mainnet this is total loss of the pool; on devnet it is the 'stranded OST' class inverted.

defects.title: /loans/draw accepts a client-supplied usdPerOstg and mints OSTG credit at that rate
defects.evidence: index.js forwards `await request.text()` unchanged to /play/loan-draw with the internal key (3305-3309). handleLoanDraw reads usdPerOstg from the body and computes wantOstg = usd/usdPerOstg (182-187); LoanLedger.borrow records principalOstg = wantUsd/rate with the same client rate (143-150). The only bound is lendable = 50% of pool buffer (206-208). ostUsd(env) exists server-side (solana-pool.js:489-492) but is not used here.
defects.failure_scenario: Wallet with the default $100 line posts usd=100, usdPerOstg=1e-9 → wantOstg=1e11, clamped only by the pool buffer → receives up to half the house bankroll as play balance, gambles it (game wins are not tainted, play-ledger.js:703-716) and cashes out winnings (cashout only subtracts lockedTotal, 518-530). Debt remains as principalUsd=$100 at a fictional rate; no default enforcement exists.

defects.title: Prediction entry/sell odds computed from stale KV btc:latest, silently default to 0.5
defects.evidence: livePrice = memGet('btc:latest')||kvGet('btc:latest') (3390-3391, 3428-3429); canon.livePrice from the authoritative hub is never referenced. btc:latest is written only by appendBtcTick (410-425), called from buildCanonicalBtcRound fallback (476), /btc/price non-canonical branch (3859) and /btc/ticks fallback (3921) — none execute while the hub is healthy. Whole block wrapped in try{}catch(_){} with oddsYes initialised to 0.5 (3382-3408).
defects.failure_scenario: Late in a round with BTC clearly above the line (true P(yes)≈0.95), attacker opens YES at entry 0.5 (or a minutes-old stale price) → shares = 2×stake → resolve pays ≈2× minus 2% of profit. Repeatable every round; the house loses systematically. Also sells (cashout) are mispriced both directions.

defects.title: All /play/* balance mutators and /play/predict/* accept a bare wallet string (no signature)
defects.evidence: handle() routes bet/rotate/session/meme/stock/cashout/deposit by wallet from the body with isPubkey only; x-ost-internal is checked solely for stake/settle/loan-draw/loan-repay (414-426). /play/predict/open|cashout take body.wallet and call the internal-keyed stake/settle on the caller's behalf (prediction-ledger.js:134, 265).
defects.failure_scenario: Anyone can force-cash-out any wallet (funds go to that wallet's ATA, but the play balance is emptied mid-session), spend any wallet's balance on losing bets/memes/stocks, rotate their seed, open/sell predictions for them. Denial and griefing of every funded user; combined with defect 3 it is theft-adjacent.

defects.title: RealtimeHub WebSocket 'publish' frames bypass the privileged-type allowlist
defects.evidence: onClientMessage: `if (msg.type === 'publish' && msg.event) return this.publish(Object.assign({}, msg.event, { clientId: session.id }))` — no token, no PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES check. The HTTP path enforces both (154-197). Module comment states privileged events (wallet.*, transaction.*, topup.*, payout.*) must only originate server-side because receivers dispatch them as payment alerts.
defects.failure_scenario: Any WS client sends {type:'publish', event:{type:'topup.sent', wallet:'<victim>', amount:5000, private:true}} → delivered on wallet:<victim> → victim's UI shows '+5000 OST delivered' / ost:wallet-changed. Fake payment notifications at scale; REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN remediation is void.

defects.title: POST /wallet/events lets anyone write activity for any wallet and push a private transaction.alert to it
defects.evidence: No auth; wallet/kind/amount/sig from body; kvPut wallet:events:<wallet> (4348-4350); publishWalletRealtime(... type:'transaction.alert', message '+amount OST') to the private wallet channel (4351-4355, 1001-1020).
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker posts {wallet:victim, kind:'topup-sent', amount:1000, sig:'fake'} → victim's wallet history and live alerts show a delivery that never happened; support reconciling from wallet:events is misled.

defects.title: /topup/claim marks a paid intent as delivered from a client-asserted signature
defects.evidence: Requires only intent id (+ optional wallet match) and a non-empty `signature` string; sets status 'sent', removes from dispatcher queue (4839-4845), journals 'delivered' via sent.push. No on-chain verification of the delivery signature. Intent id appears in the Stripe success_url (4737) and /topup/status/:id is public (4807).
defects.failure_scenario: Paid intent + attacker (or a buggy client) POSTs /topup/claim with signature 'abc' → customer's paid order leaves the dispatcher queue unpaid; the audit journal records a delivery that did not occur. This is the credits-pays-an-on-chain-debt costume applied to real money.

defects.title: BTC-round hub fallback returns canonical:true with no degraded flag (unlike market state)
defects.evidence: getCanonicalBtcRound: `if (hubRound) return hubRound; return buildCanonicalBtcRound(env, opts)` — the fallback's payload sets canonical:true (536) and no degraded/authoritative field. buildCanonicalBtcRound reads btc:latest and round:<openAt> through kvGet's per-colo 300s cache (745-761). Contrast getNativeMarketState which sets authoritative:false, degraded:true (1494-1500).
defects.failure_scenario: Hub hiccup → /btc/round, /btc/price, /rounds/current, /bot/v1/btc/round serve per-colo stale openPrice/livePrice/odds labelled canonical; clients in different colos show different lines for the same round and cannot tell. /play/predict/open's canon fallback (3393-3398) inherits this.

defects.title: Solvency gate silently disabled when pool bankroll is unreadable
defects.evidence: poolBankroll: `catch (_) {}` then returns cached value or null (644-645). Every credit path guards with `bankroll != null && (total + net) > bankroll` — a null bankroll skips the check entirely rather than refusing.
defects.failure_scenario: RPC keys throttled (documented as frequent) on a fresh DO instance (no poolOstgCache) → wins, meme sells, stock closes and session cashouts credit unbounded play balance with no backing check; /health/play later reports UNDER-COLLATERALIZED after the fact.

defects.title: fetchSolUsd returns a fabricated $150 SOL price used to quote pool swaps
defects.evidence: `return 150; // last-resort fallback` after all three feeds fail; quoteSolToOst/quoteOstToSol divide/multiply by it; PayoutGate builds and partial-signs the pool leg at that quote (wallet-payouts.js:293-304, 306-314). index.js has its own fetchSolUsd that returns null (2696-2724) — inconsistent.
defects.failure_scenario: Feeds down while SOL is $60 → sol-to-ost quotes 2.5× too much OST per SOL; the pool signs and pays out at the invented rate. Money moves at a price nobody observed.

defects.title: /loans/* forwards ANY op (settle, void, stake, borrow) verbatim to LoanLedger without auth
defects.evidence: `const op = path.slice('/loans/'.length)` (3270); after the draw/repay branch, `stub.fetch('https://loan-ledger/' + op + url.search, init)` with the client body (3354). LoanLedger.fetch switches on op including 'borrow', 'stake', 'settle', 'void' (367-391). Only geoblock + LOANS_MODE gate it.
defects.failure_scenario: POST /loans/void {loanId} voids any unrepaid loan (removes the tainted bucket → locked funds become withdrawable via cashout); POST /loans/settle {address, payout, bucket:'clean'} inflates provenance; POST /loans/borrow records a debt on any address without crediting money.

defects.title: Settlement provider webhook is subject to the customer geoblock
defects.evidence: `const geoS = jurisdictionBlocked(request, env); if (geoS && path !== '/settlement/health') return geoS;` — applies to /settlement/nowpayments/webhook whose caller is the processor's server; jurisdictionBlocked keys on CF-IPCountry of that caller (2650-2668) and is forced on for mainnet.
defects.failure_scenario: On mainnet, if NOWPayments' IPN egress resolves to EU/GB/US, every paid invoice returns 451 and is never credited; customers pay and receive nothing until reconciled by hand.

defects.title: Round close price definition depends on traffic timing
defects.evidence: rolloverBtcStateIfNeeded stores closePrice = state.livePrice (whatever tick was last fetched before the first request after the boundary) with closeSource = livePriceSource; getBtcRoundResult prefers that snapshot whenever closePrice>0 (1600) over the Coinbase 5m candle close (fallback only when missing). Comments call the kline close 'deterministic' and 'the settlement source of truth'.
defects.failure_scenario: Round A (busy) settles on a Binance spot tick up to 650ms+ before close; round B (quiet) settles on the Coinbase candle close — two definitions of truth, and the snapshot one can be minutes stale on sparse traffic yet marked found:true.

defects.title: POST /rounds/open-price lets a client set the KV open price when klines are unreachable
defects.evidence: If no KV record and fetchBtcRoundOpenPrice returns null (Binance blocked from CF per 322-325), serverPrice = Number(openPrice) from the body and is locked with source 'client-fallback'. /play/predict/open falls back to that record when canon is for another round, and PredictionLedger.open uses rec.openPrice as the line when priceToBeat is absent.
defects.failure_scenario: Hub degraded + attacker pre-posts an absurd open price for the next round → positions opened in that window are priced/settled against a poisoned line.

defects.title: POST /positions moves the native market-maker quote with no proof of stake
defects.evidence: Any wallet/stake/side accepted; applyNativePositionToMarketState → hub /position mutates openYesShares/openNoShares which drive yes/no ask/bid (1305-1360). `signature` is stored but never verified.
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker posts a 1e9 OST YES 'position' → quote pinned near 0.999 for everyone; bots and the bot API price off it. Also pollutes positions:<victim>.

defects.title: /launchpad/coins POST accepts 500KB images into a single KV list value
defects.evidence: image sliced to 500_000 chars, coins array capped at 200 and stored as ONE KV value 'launchpad:coins' (4412-4414). KV values cap at 25MiB; kvNativePut failure trips the whole KV tier for 60s (598-599, 725).
defects.failure_scenario: ~50 coin posts with max images → launchpad:coins put fails → tierDown('kv') → every KV-backed read/write across the worker degrades to D1/cache for 60s, repeatedly. Cheap DoS.

defects.title: /play/onchain reports 0 OSTG on an RPC failure inside withRpc
defects.evidence: `conn.getTokenAccountBalance(ata).catch(() => null)` then `res && res.value ? … : 0` inside the withRpc callback — the exact pattern balance-truth.js:81-85 warns defeats endpoint rotation and yields a false zero. Client ost-onchain-sync.js:95 polls this every 5s.
defects.failure_scenario: Throttled endpoint → onchainOstg:0 with ok:true; UI shows 'nothing in wallet' for a funded user (the vanishing-balance class).

defects.title: Stock mirror order accepts a client price when the server quote fails
defects.evidence: `fetchStockQuote(symbol).catch(() => null)` then `price = cleanNumber(body.price, quote && quote.price) || (quote && quote.price) || 0` — body.price takes precedence whenever present, quoteSource 'client'.
defects.failure_scenario: Order records at any price; wallet events and the public stock.order feed show fabricated fills (KV-only, no OSTG moves, but it is the record support reads).

defects.title: /btc/ticks and /btc/price fallbacks write KV on read paths
defects.evidence: On hub miss, /btc/ticks calls buildCanonicalBtcRound (which itself locks/appends) and kvPut(ringKey) (3948); /btc/price calls lockRoundOpenPrice + appendBtcTick (3859-3860). Contrast the market-state degraded path which explicitly refuses to write (1487-1490).
defects.failure_scenario: During any hub degradation every poller burns the ~1k/day KV write budget (25s hot throttle helps for ticks but round:<openAt> and non-hot writes are not throttled), accelerating the outage that caused the degradation.

defects.title: kvGet returns the caller's empty fallback when every tier is tripped, and lists are then overwritten
defects.evidence: kvGet ends with `return fallback` (760) regardless of whether the miss was 'not found' or 'all tiers down'; POST handlers do `bucket = await kvGet(key, []); kvPut(key, mergeNewest(bucket, record))`.
defects.failure_scenario: KV+D1 tripped (both have daily quotas) → positions:<wallet> read as [] → next write persists a 1-element list to Cache/memory and later to KV/D1 when they heal → wallet history truncated; same for launchpad:coins (all coins vanish), payouts audit.

defects.title: /ghost/chat rate limiter fails open and its counter is publicly reachable via /play/rl
defects.evidence: `catch (_) { /* limiter unavailable: allow */ }`; /play/* passthrough forwards /play/rl to the DO before any gate (play-ledger.js:390).
defects.failure_scenario: Anyone can POST /play/rl {key:'ghost:<victim ip>', limit:1} to pre-exhaust a victim IP's Ghost quota; when the DO is slow the AI quota is unprotected.

defects.title: AdTreasury view cap is per client-chosen uid
defects.evidence: uid comes from body (172); cap 20/day keyed on it; accruedUsd increments per view.
defects.failure_scenario: New uid per request → accrued estimate inflates without bound (labelled estimate, not money received, so limited blast radius).

defects.title: Dead duplicate NativeMarketHub implementation with a different odds model
defects.evidence: index.js never imports native-market.js; wrangler binds class NativeMarketHub which index.js exports from its own inline class (1660). native-market.js computeOdds uses volatility/momentum/confidence damping the live code explicitly removed (index.js:438-455).
defects.failure_scenario: A future import swap silently changes every quote; reviewers reading the standalone file audit the wrong model.

risks: Live behaviour not verified: the worker was not called (0/2 calls used); all findings are code-level. Whether INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY, REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN, BOT_API_KEY, SOLANA_DEVNET_RPC_* are set in prod is unknown — if INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY is unset, /play/predict/open and /loans/draw fail closed (good) but predictions are dead.

Binance is documented as blocking CF egress (index.js:322-325, 3539-3540, 2779-2785) yet BTC_FEEDS tries api.binance.com first and klines are the only open-price source — if true, every round's open is a 'provisional-open' live tick and priceToBeat drift projection is always 0 (fetchBtcPrior5mDriftFast → 0). Suspected, not verified.

Single NativeMarketHub instance serializes every /btc/round, /markets/state, /positions/recent, POST /positions through blockConcurrencyWhile with external fetches inside the lock — latency under load, not correctness, is what breaks first; RealtimeHub is a second single instance with MAX_CLIENTS 1200.

Durable Object free-plan quotas (requests/day, rows written/day) are shared with the Worker's 100k/day cap per the memory notes; quoteMarket writes storage on every /markets/state GET (1953) and RealtimeHub persists recent-events on every publish (319) — DO row-write budget is being spent on reads. Plan-limit numbers not verified in repo.

Cross-colo Cache API (300s) remains the read tier for every KV key; only DO-backed data is globally consistent. Anything computed from round:<openAt>, btc:latest, positions:recent, launchpad:coins can differ by colo for 5 minutes.

Loan economics: no default/collection path exists (defaultedCount never incremented; interest accrues forever); combined with client-chosen rate and untainted game winnings, lending is an extraction rail rather than credit.

Idle guard only blocks GETs while hidden/idle; a watched tab with the prediction modal open still issues ~1 req/s to /positions/recent plus ~0.4 req/s of other polls — one active user ≈ 5,000 req/hour vs a 100 req/user/DAY budget.

Secrets: /rpc-config intentionally hands SOLANA_DEVNET_RPC and 3 fallbacks (with API keys embedded in URLs) to every browser (3665-3668) — this is the founder's 'users carry the load' design, but the keys are shared account keys whose quota one abusive user can exhaust for everyone (and the worker's own withRpc uses the same keys).
mesh-games XSS escaping (July remediation) is client-side and was not in the read set — not verified either way.
keep_as_is: PayoutGate/PlayLedger crash-safe payout pattern: 'building' record before broadcast, 'sent' with sig, confirm unlocked, refuse auto-resend on unknown state (wallet-payouts.js:174-231; play-ledger.js:550-606) — keep verbatim; add auth in front, do not change the state machine.
PurchaseLedger.credit atomic-by-payment-ref inside blockConcurrencyWhile with journaled flag reported (purchase-ledger.js:146-195).
settlement.js four rules (HMAC verify, amount vs intent, terminal-only, idempotent on processor ref) and SETTLEMENT_LIVE kill switch (159-272).
PlayLedger.verifyDeposit reading the amount from the confirmed tx keyed on the pool's OSTG ATA (play-ledger.js:107-130) and the locked dedup credit (469-478).
PredictionLedger.resolve rejecting settlePrice<=0 and staying open (prediction-ledger.js:178-187); sell bounded to shares (256-259).
PlayLedger cashout failing CLOSED on loan summary unavailable (514-517) — this is the correct shape; extend it to poolBankroll.
balance-truth.js: unknown-never-zero, last-good with age, degraded flags, sequential RPC reads (75-119, 141-142, 178-215).
getNativeMarketState degraded path: flagged authoritative:false/degraded:true with reason and NO KV writes on reads (index.js:1476-1500); hubFailed loud logging + /health/hub (1521-1528, 3062-3072).
Tiered store circuit breakers and the KV_HOT_RE 25s throttle scoped to reconstructable price keys (585-819) — keep the mechanism; fix the fallback/RMW semantics.

RealtimeHub as the single long-lived push channel, and NativeMarketHub publishing the FULL round snapshot on price.tick (index.js:1876-1896) — this already carries everything the clients poll /btc/round for.

x-ost-internal fail-closed gate on stake/settle/loan-* (play-ledger.js:414-426); HTTP publish allowlist (realtime.js:154-197); mesh TOFU (mesh/hub.js:271-298); push endpoint host allowlist (push.js:189-192); Stripe constant-time HMAC (index.js:2606-2622).
ost-anchor.js stale-flag semantics and refusal to invent a rate (77-136); ost-price.js hold-last-good index (189-204).
/health/peg and /health/play refusing a verdict on read failure (index.js:3094-3100; play-ledger.js:1146-1150).
ost-idle-guard.js fetch gate and its honesty banner (docs).
open_questions: Is /wallet/payout reachable in production exactly as read (no Cloudflare Access/WAF rule in front of it)? The repo shows no gate; a dashboard-level rule would not be visible here.

Which server-side caller is supposed to authorise a payout amount? Today only the client (devnet-rescue.js:212) asserts it. Is the intended source PlayLedger.cashout (already server-authoritative) — i.e. can /wallet/payout be deleted outright once faucet/prediction sells move to the play balance?

Are INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY, REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN, BOT_API_KEY, MESH_ADMIN_KEY, TOPUP_ADMIN_TOKEN set on prod? (wrangler.toml lists only STRIPE_*, TOPUP_ADMIN_TOKEN, OST_POOL_SECRET_KEY as secrets to set.)

Is Binance actually blocked from CF egress today (open price source)? If yes, the 'deterministic kline open' never runs and the DO's provisional-open is the real open — should Coinbase candles become the open source too (they already are the close fallback)?

What are the current free-plan Durable Object limits (requests/day, rows written/day) and are they pooled with the Worker's 100k? This decides whether DO storage writes on read paths (quoteMarket, recent-events) are a second cap.
Should loan draws be allowed to fund untainted game winnings by design (play-ledger.js:708-713 says yes, tested and rejected taint)? With a server rate fix this is a product decision, not a bug.
Is native-market.js meant to be deleted, or is it a planned replacement? It has a different odds model.
Who consumes /wallet/payouts audit and /wallet/events for reconciliation? If support does, both need write auth or must be labelled client-reported.
Does any client still call /games/* (GameSeedHub) or is it fully superseded by PlayLedger seeds? If superseded, it is a free DO to remove.

recommended_fixes.title: Remove client-asserted payouts: gate /wallet/payout behind x-ost-internal and route every payout through a ledger that computed the amount
recommended_fixes.rationale: Critical printer. PlayLedger.cashout already implements server-authoritative pool→user sends; faucet and prediction sells should credit the play balance (internal settle) and let the user cash out via /play/cashout. If a direct payout must remain, require x-ost-internal and a payoutId that a server ledger issued.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates the class (client names the amount) rather than rate-limiting it; the amount originates only where it was computed and recorded.

recommended_fixes.title: Wallet-signature auth for /play/* and /play/predict/*: signed nonce challenge, verified with ed25519 in the DO
recommended_fixes.rationale: Every balance mutator identifies the owner by a string. Issue a per-wallet nonce (DO storage), require {wallet, nonce, sig} where sig = wallet.signMessage(nonce||method||bodyHash); verify with @solana/web3.js nacl (already a dependency). Read-only routes stay open.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Binds each mutation to the key that owns the funds; not an IP limiter or obscurity. Costs 0 extra worker requests if the nonce rides on the WS session hello.

recommended_fixes.title: Server-side loan rate: ignore body.usdPerOstg; use ostUsd(env) in handleLoanDraw and LoanLedger.borrow; strip client rate in the /loans proxy; restrict /loans/* forwarding to summary/health/repay/draw
recommended_fixes.rationale: Client rate multiplies credit arbitrarily; op passthrough exposes settle/void/borrow.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the attacker-controlled input from the money formula and closes the unauthenticated ops instead of validating ranges on them.

recommended_fixes.title: Prediction odds from the authoritative snapshot; fail closed instead of 0.5
recommended_fixes.rationale: Use canon.livePrice/livePriceTs from getCanonicalBtcRound (same round check), require livePriceTs within ~5s, else return 409 odds_unavailable. Delete the 0.5 initialiser and the swallowing catch; delete the btc:latest read on this path.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Prices come from the one authority the desk shows; an unavailable price refuses the trade rather than inventing a coin-flip entry.

recommended_fixes.title: Flag or fail the BTC-round hub fallback; stop KV writes on read paths
recommended_fixes.rationale: Set canonical:false, degraded:true, degradedReason on buildCanonicalBtcRound output (mirror getNativeMarketState), and remove lockRoundOpenPrice/appendBtcTick/kvPut from /btc/price, /btc/ticks, buildCanonicalBtcRound when invoked as a fallback. Clients already handle degraded market state.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the degraded state visible and stops the fallback from burning the quota that caused it; does not add a cache.

recommended_fixes.title: Apply the PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES allowlist to WebSocket publish frames; make POST /wallet/events and /wallet/payouts mark records client-reported and never publish private transaction alerts
recommended_fixes.rationale: Both paths let anyone fabricate payment notifications, the exact thing the July token was meant to stop.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Privileged event types can only be produced by server code; client-reported records carry their provenance instead of masquerading.

recommended_fixes.title: Fail closed on unknown bankroll and unknown SOL price
recommended_fixes.rationale: poolBankroll null → return 503 bankroll_unreadable from bet/session/meme/stock credit paths (cashout already refuses on unknown loan state). fetchSolUsd in solana-pool.js → throw (index.js's own version already returns null); cosign returns 503 quote_unavailable.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes two silent fabrications on money paths; the honest answer is 'cannot price/verify now'.

recommended_fixes.title: /topup/claim must verify delivery on-chain or be replaced by a PayoutGate-driven delivery keyed by intent id
recommended_fixes.rationale: Delivery should be the server sending OST via PayoutGate with payoutId = intent.id (idempotent), marking 'sent' only on confirmed signature; if client release stays for devnet, verify the signature transfers ≥ostAmount OST to intent.wallet before marking sent.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: The record of delivery is produced by the act of delivery, not by a client claim.

recommended_fixes.title: Move the geoblock off the settlement webhook (block at /settlement/checkout and /topup/intent by customer country; record the country on the intent)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Webhook caller is the processor; blocking it silently strands paid orders on mainnet.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Enforces the jurisdiction rule at the moment the customer acts, which is what the rule is about.

recommended_fixes.title: Kill client polling: consume the price.tick snapshot and prediction/wallet events from the WS; delete /positions/recent 1s loop, /play/reconcile from the client, /btc/round timers; event-driven /balance/truth (after own tx + on wallet.event) with 60s floor
recommended_fixes.rationale: Budget is 100 req/user/day. NativeMarketHub already pushes the full round on every tick; RealtimeHub already emits prediction.order/cashout and wallet events. Per-user worker traffic should be: 1 WS upgrade, ~10 mutations, a handful of balance reads.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the requests rather than caching or throttling them; the push channel is the design the founder specified and it already exists server-side.

recommended_fixes.title: Trim server fan-out: stop DO storage writes on read paths (quoteMarket, recent-events per publish), cache the DO snapshot in the worker isolate for /markets/state and /positions/recent like /btc/round, and move BTC feed fetching to a DO alarm (one fetch per second regardless of readers)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Each read currently costs DO requests + storage writes + external fetches. A DO alarm-driven ticker makes upstream cost O(1) instead of O(readers).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Changes who pays for the tick (one alarm) instead of hiding cost behind per-colo caches; consistency stays in the DO.

recommended_fixes.title: Replace KV read-modify-write lists with a small ActivityLedger DO (positions, wallet events, payouts audit, launchpad, comments) or at minimum bypass the Cache API for state keys and make kvGet distinguish 'all tiers down' (throw) from 'not found'
recommended_fixes.rationale: Per-colo 300s cache + eventual KV + RMW = lost updates and desync for every non-DO key; the [] fallback then truncates history.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Puts mutable state behind a single-writer with strong consistency instead of tuning TTLs; an unreadable store errors instead of returning an empty list.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete native-market.js and the legacy GameSeedHub rail once no client references remain; cap launchpad image size to a few KB or store images in D1/R2 separately
recommended_fixes.rationale: Dead code with a divergent odds model; unbounded KV value growth trips the whole KV tier.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the hazard rather than guarding it.

recommended_fixes.title: CI lint: forbid silent-default catches and require flagged-degraded returns
recommended_fixes.rationale: Regex set (ripgrep, run over docs/**/*.js and workers/ost-api/src/**/*.js; fail build on any NEW hit vs a committed baseline count, target baseline 0 for rules 1-3 on files in a MONEY_PATHS list): (1) `catch\s*(\([^)]*\))?\s*\{\s*return\s*(null|0|false|\{\}|\[\]|''|"")\s*;?\s*\}` (2) `\.catch\(\s*(\([^)]*\)|\w+)\s*=>\s*(\(?\s*(0|null|false|\{\}|\[\]|''|"")\s*\)?|\{\s*\})\s*\)` and its `function\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{\s*return\s*(null|0|false|\{\}|\[\]|'')` form (3) `catch\s*(\([^)]*\))?\s*\{[^}]*\b(balance|bal|amount|price|lamports|credits|payout|pool\w*|supply)\w*\s*=\s*(0|null|amount|\{\}|\[\])\b` (4) `catch\s*(\([^)]*\))?\s*\{\s*\}` reported as warning with count-must-not-increase (5) `(getBalance|getTokenAccountBalance|getAccountInfo|getOstBalance|poolBalance|poolSolBalance)\([^)]*\)\s*\.catch\(` error (6) `'(local|credits|fake|offline)-'\s*\+` in a `signature|sig` assignment error. Allowlist via a trailing `// mask-ok: <reason>` comment on the same line, reviewed.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the anti-pattern impossible to re-introduce silently; every existing hit becomes visible and must be justified inline — it changes the process that produced 40 new masks since July, not one symptom.

recommended_fixes.title: Replacement catalogue (apply per pattern; each site returns undefined/throws/flags)
recommended_fixes.rationale: BALANCE READ: `async read(){ try { … return n; } catch (e) { if (/could not find account/i.test(e.message)) return 0; return undefined; } }` — callers: `if (v === undefined) showDash()`; never gate a spend on undefined (let the server refuse). RPC SEND/CONFIRM: throw typed errors `{code:'timeout'|'rpc_unavailable'|'rejected', sig?:string}`; on timeout AFTER broadcast mark the ticket `pending:true, sig, unconfirmed:true` and reconcile with getSignatureStatuses — never substitute a different funding source. SERVER CALL: `res.ok && json.ok ? json : throw Object.assign(new Error(json.error||'http_'+status), {code, httpStatus, unreachable})`; treat HTML/1027 bodies as `unreachable`. PRICE FEED: return `{price, ts, source, stale:boolean}`; consumers refuse to lock/settle on stale. LEDGER (localStorage) READ: on parse failure return `{corrupt:true, raw}` and have every writer refuse to overwrite a corrupt key (move raw to `<key>.corrupt.<ts>` first). ROUTING/SECURITY LOOKUP: three-valued `{exists:true}|{exists:false}|undefined`; undefined must take the conservative branch (on-chain route: refuse/queue, hub: 503 not 'accept').
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Every shape carries the failure to the consumer instead of a plausible value; no new fallback is introduced and no request is added (all are shape changes on existing calls).

recommended_fixes.title: Faucet: remove the client pool pre-check or make it three-valued
recommended_fixes.rationale: devnet-rescue.js:119-126 → return undefined on failure; app.js:4362-4368 → only throw 'vault is being refilled' when the read SUCCEEDED and is < amount; otherwise skip to payoutOst and let /wallet/payout's insufficient_pool be the verdict (comment at 4359-4361 already states this intent). Also map devnet-rescue apiPost code 'network_error'/'timeout' to a distinct 'service unreachable' message in app.js:6817-6832 so a 1027 is never rendered as an empty vault.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Deletes the fabricated 0 and routes the decision to the only solvency authority (the worker); no poll or request is added — it removes one RPC read from the hot path.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete the credits-conversion fallback in settleInBackground; make timeout a pending state
recommended_fixes.rationale: app.js:3669-3679: on cosign failure keep the optimistic ticket as `pending:true, funding:'unconfirmed', lastError` when err.code==='timeout' (tx may have landed) and reconcile via getSignatureStatuses on the next ost:wallet-changed / push event; on definitive rejection remove + refund hint (existing 3680-3685 branch). Never mint a 'credits-…' signature. Also aligns with the settled OSTG-only market rule.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the fabricated success and the double-charge; the ticket's true state (unconfirmed) is shown instead of a substitute funding story.

recommended_fixes.title: Three-valued on-chain market lookup; unknown never routes off-chain
recommended_fixes.rationale: ost-onchain-market.js:169 return undefined (not null) on RPC failure and keep null-vs-{exists:false} distinct; ost-onchain-route.js:200 on undefined: retry once via the worker-independent RPC rotation or surface 'on-chain rail unreachable — try again' instead of inner(order). ost-session-key.js:186 same tri-state.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: The decision now depends on knowledge, not on the absence of an error object; the user sees the rail state rather than being silently moved.

recommended_fixes.title: Mesh hub: storage read failure on identity/block checks must fail closed
recommended_fixes.rationale: hub.js:285, 325, 414, 429, 431, 465: replace `.catch(() => null)` with try/catch returning `fail('directory_storage_unavailable', 503)`; the TOFU lock and block list are security decisions and 'unknown' must refuse. Keep the `.catch(()=>{})` on best-effort deletes.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Closes the bypass rather than papering over it; a 503 is the honest state and costs no extra requests.

recommended_fixes.title: Ledger keys: one guarded reader/writer per key, corrupt → quarantine not overwrite
recommended_fixes.rationale: Introduce a single `OST_STORE.readJson(key)` returning `{value}|{corrupt:true}` and `writeJson(key, v, {ifNotCorrupt:true})` that refuses to overwrite a corrupt key until the raw is copied to `<key>.corrupt.<ts>`; migrate app.js:3081-3095, prediction-pro.js:1008/1031/1034, ost-money.js:29-33, launchpad-engine.js:45-70, wallet-extras.js:36-42/464-479, prediction-extras.js:22/54, ost-parlay.js:174/181, live-watch.js:889, fast-markets.js:300, prediction-scalar.js:165, ost-ticket-overlay.js:25. ost-money migrate() must not grant WELCOME_BONUS when the hub was corrupt.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Stops data loss at the write, preserves evidence, and removes 12 independent copies of the same lie; nothing is fabricated in either direction.

recommended_fixes.title: play-ledger handleOnchain: let getTokenAccountBalance errors propagate inside withRpc
recommended_fixes.rationale: play-ledger.js:1082: remove the inner `.catch(() => null)`; map only 'could not find account' to 0 inside the callback and let other errors throw so withRpc rotates and the existing 502 guard (1085-1088) fires.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Restores the author's own guard; unknown becomes 502 as designed, and rotation across RPC keys actually happens.

recommended_fixes.title: Balance-gated UX messages must not be generated from a failed read
recommended_fixes.rationale: swap-resilient.js:158-161, wallet-extras.js:932-936, ost-games.js:183-193+952, app.js:3422-3424/15889-15891, ost-appbar.js:47-55, ost-balance-tree.js:48-55, ost-total-balance.js:18-22, ost-ghost-brain.js:71-72: return undefined and render '—'/'checking' or skip the pre-check and submit to the authority; the worker already re-validates (comment at swap-resilient.js:153-155).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates the fabricated 'have 0.00' messages; the decision moves to the server that already owns it, with zero additional requests.

recommended_fixes.title: Surface `fallback:true` client rounds and forbid settlement-bearing bets on them
recommended_fixes.rationale: ost-predict-mobile.js:580-616: when applyRound receives d.fallback, badge the market 'offline estimate' and disable stake submission on rails the server must settle (credits rail excluded per settled rules anyway); do not persist a client priceToBeat into saveRoundCache.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: The fabricated state is labelled and cannot produce a settled position; it does not add a poll and keeps the no-backend view.

recommended_fixes.title: Remove hash-parity resolution of OST-native bets
recommended_fixes.rationale: prediction-extras.js:355-366 must resolve only from a settlement source (server ledger/round result); until then leave bets 'open' with a 'awaiting settlement' label.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Deletes a fabricated outcome generator; no substitute source is invented.

recommended_fixes.title: Stock mirror orders: server quote is authoritative or the order is refused
recommended_fixes.rationale: index.js:4597-4599: if fetchStockQuote fails return 503 'quote_unavailable'; never accept body.price as the fill.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes client price trust rather than adding a sanity band that could still be gamed.

security-posture.summary: READ-ONLY audit of OST security posture as of 2026-09-17 (worker: workers/ost-api/src, client: docs/). July 2026 remediations VERIFIED INTACT in code: x-ost-internal fail-closed on /play/stake|settle|loan-draw|loan-repay (play-ledger.js:414-425); /loans/draw|repay proxy attaches INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY (index.js:3293-3303); /realtime/v1/publish HTTP path rejects non-social types without REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN (realtime.js:174-193); /ghost/chat has the DO-backed 12/60s per-IP limiter (index.js:3138-3156); MeshHub.announce is TOFU with JSON-value compare and 409 (mesh/hub.js:271-283); mesh-games.js escapes peer fields via esc() (docs/mesh/mesh-games.js:24,259); mesh.js wraps payload.html in escapeHtml (docs/mesh/mesh.js:789); SETTLEMENT_LIVE is OFF (verified LIVE: GET /settlement/health -> live:false; not in wrangler.toml [vars]). HOWEVER the posture is still broken by two CRITICALs and several HIGHs that the July work did not touch: (1) POST /wallet/payout is a fully unauthenticated pool->wallet OSTC transfer with client-decided amounts and no per-wallet/rate cap (wallet-payouts.js:96-200; index.js:3208-3210) - the exact 'money printer' shape that was closed on /play/settle, but on the OSTC rail; every faucet award, game award, mesh-game pot and even top-up DELIVERY is the client calling this endpoint (docs/app.js:4380, faucet-hub.js:987, mesh/mesh-play.js:882, wallet-extras.js:1056,1127), so paying for a top-up is optional. (2) The REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN gate is bypassed by the RealtimeHub WebSocket 'publish' message (realtime.js:345-347) and by server-side publishWalletRealtime reachable from unauthenticated KV writers (/wallet/events, /positions, /stocks/orders, /wallet/payouts POST -> index.js:993-1011), so anyone can push wallet.*/topup.*/payout.* events to any wallet channel; the client turns these into toasts + ost:wallet-changed refresh storms (docs/realtime.js:279-283). Every PlayLedger/PredictionLedger/MeshHub mutator names the wallet in the body with no proof of ownership; the prediction entry/exit odds silently default to 0.5 when price data is missing (mask on a money path); private wallet realtime events are readable by anyone via GET /realtime/v1/events and WS wallet subscription; /rpc/send, /wallet/ata-rent, /wallet/cosign fee-only, /ghost/v2/chat and ~12 legacy KV-writing endpoints are unauthenticated cost amplifiers against the free-plan budgets (Workers requests, KV 1k writes/day, Helius quota, pool SOL). The rebuild needs ONE auth primitive (ed25519 wallet signature over {wallet,path,bodyHash,ts,nonce}) slotted in index.js before the DO dispatch, removal of client-callable custody endpoints, and deletion of the legacy KV-write surface.

flows.name: Faucet / game award -> pool OSTC payout
steps: Client decides award amount (faucet-hub.js:987 spin prize, app.js:4380 faucet claim, mesh-play.js:882 pot)
devnet-rescue.js payoutOst() POSTs /wallet/payout {wallet, amountOst, memo, payoutId} (212)
index.js:3208-3210 forwards straight to PayoutGate with no auth
PayoutGate.handlePayout: cap checks only (maxSinglePayout 1e9, 2% of pool per call, reserve 0) then pool signs transferChecked (wallet-payouts.js:117-176)
FaucetGate reserve/commit (index.js:2426-2517) is bookkeeping only; commit takes client 'signature' and never verifies or gates the payout
weak_points: No auth, no ownership proof, no linkage to a reservation or intent
Per-call cap is 2% of pool balance and repeatable with fresh payoutId
Pool SOL fee spent per call

flows.name: OSTG play: deposit -> bet/session/meme/stock -> cashout
steps: /play/deposit verifies on-chain transfer user ATA -> pool OSTG ATA (play-ledger.js:112-137, 449-478) - sound
/play/bet etc. debit/credit bal:<wallet> under DO lock with server seed (651-711)
poolBankroll() caches pool OSTG 20s; on RPC failure returns stale cache or null (637-649)
/play/cashout debits, loan-locks, pool signs OSTG out, idempotent by client key (495-609)
weak_points: wallet is caller-asserted on every public mutator; anyone can spend/cash out/rotate any wallet
bankroll null silently disables the solvency cap in bet/session/meme-sell/stock-close (net>0 && bankroll != null)

flows.name: OSTG predictions: open -> sell/resolve
steps: POST /play/predict/open (public) computes oddsYes/priceToBeat from canonical round + btc:latest (index.js:3376-3408); on any failure oddsYes stays 0.5 and error is swallowed
PredictionLedger.open debits via internal-keyed stake, records entry=clamp(oddsYes) (prediction-ledger.js:106-165)
POST /play/predict/cashout (public) recomputes oddsYes, default 0.5 (index.js:3414-3441) -> sell pays shares*cur
POST /play/predict/resolve (public) uses NativeMarketHub close price; refuses if <=0 (3442-3462; prediction-ledger.js:194-196)
weak_points: wallet caller-asserted at open (anyone stakes a victim's balance)
0.5 odds fallback on missing live price is a fabricated price on a money path

flows.name: Top-up (real money in) -> OST delivery
steps: /topup/intent creates intent in PurchaseLedger DO (index.js:4689-4730, public)
Stripe webhook (HMAC, 4772-4815) or /topup/crypto/verify (memo+amount+treasury on chain, 2905-2965) marks intent paid
Client SELF-DELIVERS by calling /wallet/payout with intent.ostAmount (wallet-extras.js:1056,1127)
Client POSTs /topup/claim {id, wallet, signature} -> intent 'sent' (4835-4883), no verification of the signature

defects.title: POST /wallet/payout is an unauthenticated pool->wallet OSTC transfer with client-decided amount (money printer, OSTC rail)
defects.line: 96-200 (no auth check anywhere in handlePayout); index.js:3208-3210 forwards without gate; callers docs/devnet-rescue.js:212, docs/app.js:4380, docs/faucet-hub.js:987, docs/wallet-extras.js:1056,1127, docs/mesh/mesh-play.js:882
defects.evidence: handlePayout reads {wallet, amountOst, memo, payoutId} from body, validates pubkey and amount>0, applies only vaultConfig caps (maxSinglePayout=1e9, maxPayoutFraction=0.02 of live pool, minReserve=0 per wrangler.toml) and payoutId idempotency, then Pool.buildSignSend with the pool keypair. No header, no signature, no FaucetGate reservation, no PurchaseLedger intent, no per-wallet or per-time cap. The DO has rateLimited() (66-74) but handlePayout never calls it.
defects.failure_scenario: curl -X POST /wallet/payout -d '{"wallet":"<attacker>","amountOst":<0.019*poolBal>,"payoutId":"x"+i}' in a loop: each call moves up to 2% of the pool; ~100 calls drain ~87% of pool OSTC and the pool's SOL in fees. Also makes every top-up free: client delivery path is this endpoint with intent.ostAmount, so skip paying and call it directly.

Client dispatches ost:wallet-changed + ost:transaction-alert + toast for /^(wallet|transaction|topup|payout)\./ types.
defects.failure_scenario: Open WS to /realtime/v1/ws, send {type:'publish', event:{type:'topup.sent', wallet:'<victim>', amount:99999, title:'Top-up delivered'}} -> victim sees a fake delivery toast and every listener on ost:wallet-changed (ost-appbar.js:455, ost-balance.js:187, etc.) refetches balances via RPC. Broadcast to channel 'all' with type 'wallet.event' -> every connected client refreshes at once (1 WS frame -> N clients x k RPC calls) - a free-plan quota amplifier and phishing primitive.

defects.failure_scenario: POST /wallet/events {wallet:'<victim>', kind:'topup', amount:5000, label:'Top-up delivered'} -> victim's client receives a privileged-looking transaction.alert and a KV write is burned. Repeat to spam any user; combine with the events leak to harvest wallets.

defects.title: Every public PlayLedger mutator names the wallet in the body with no ownership proof: anyone can spend, withdraw, rotate seeds, or trade with any wallet's OSTG play balance
defects.line: handleBet 651-660, handleSessionStart 742-752, handleMemeBuy 883-892, handleMemeSell 924-933, handleStockOpen 981-990, handleStockClose 1020-1029, handleCashout 495-502, handleRotate 717-722; passthrough index.js:3491-3494; client sends only content-type docs/ost-play.js:45-56

defects.failure_scenario: Theft via memecoin curve: attacker buys coin X cheaply, then POST /play/meme/buy {wallet:'<victim>', mint:'X', ostIn:<victim balance>} pushes the curve; attacker POST /play/meme/sell for own tokens at the higher price. Victim's OSTG is converted into attacker profit. Griefing: /play/cashout {wallet:victim,...} forces on-chain withdrawal (pool pays fee+ATA rent); /play/bet gambles a victim's balance away; /play/rotate resets a victim's provably-fair epoch mid-session.

defects.title: /play/predict/open and /cashout silently fall back to oddsYes=0.5 when live price is unavailable (fabricated price on a money path)
defects.line: 3382 (`let oddsYes = 0.5`), 3408 (`catch (_) {}`), 3414-3441 cashout same pattern, serverComputeBtcOdds 432-436 returns {yes:0.5} when livePrice not finite; consumed by prediction-ledger.js:117,139 and sell 251-262

When data returns, /cashout sells at ~0.95 -> ~1.9x riskless; or hold to resolve for 2x. Reverse for sells: a position bought at 0.9 is sold at 0.5 to the house.

defects.title: /wallet/ata-rent spends pool SOL for any owner with no auth or rate limit; /wallet/cosign fee-only pays fees for arbitrary txs behind a caller-keyed limiter
defects.line: 207-224 (handleAtaRent: no rateLimited() call, pool pays rent), 230-262 (cosign: rateLimited keyed on body.wallet which the caller chooses; fee-only accepts up to 10 client instructions), solana-pool.js:263-271 assertPoolAbsent
defects.evidence: ata-rent builds ixCreateAta(pool.publicKey as payer) for any owner/sponsored mint and buildSignSendConfirm. cosign build returns a pool-partial-signed tx to the caller (txToBase64) that can be submitted anywhere; for fee-only the instructions need no other signer so the tx is valid with only the pool signature. assertPoolAbsent correctly blocks the pool from any instruction key/programId, so asset movement is prevented - cost is the exposure.
defects.failure_scenario: for i in 1..N: POST /wallet/ata-rent {owner:<fresh keypair i>, mint:OSTG} -> ~0.002 SOL rent + fee each; 1000 calls ~2 SOL. When pool SOL hits zero, /wallet/payout, /play/cashout and cosign all fail for everyone. cosign fee-only with a random 'wallet' per call defeats the 30/10min limiter and burns 5000 lamports + 2 RPC calls + a permanent 'cosign:' DO record per call.

defects.line: 4768 (stripe_error detail: r.body - full Stripe error object), 4962 (solana_rpc_failed detail), 3704 (send_failed message from web3.js), 3356 (loan_ledger_unreachable detail); play-ledger.js:445 (internal_error message); mesh/hub.js:167; ghost/index.js:100; relay.js attempts[]

defects.evidence: idFromName(playerId) for any 80-char string; each first request creates storage ('record' with seed) that is never deleted.

risks: The whole custody layer (PayoutGate) is reachable by any browser; combined with the public /rpc-config keys and the free-plan 100k req/day cap, a single hostile script can both drain the OSTC pool and take the backend to 1027 in the same hour.

Wallet identity is asserted, never proven, on every mutator across PlayLedger, PredictionLedger, LoanLedger proxy, MeshHub, push and realtime - the July x-ost-internal fix proved the CALLER is server code, not that the WALLET belongs to the requester; the rebuild must not confuse those two.

Two data-quality masks sit under money: 0.5 odds fallback (prediction) and null bankroll = no solvency cap (games). Both become exploitable exactly when the free-plan backend is degraded (KV shed, RPC cooldown, 1027).
publishAuthorized and the /ghost/chat limiter are fail-open; on a redeploy that drops a secret or on a DO hiccup, protections silently vanish.

Legacy KV-writing endpoints (/positions, /wallet/events, /launchpad, /stocks/orders, /wallet/payouts, /offline-vault) are unauthenticated, poll-shaped and contradict the founder directive; they will exhaust KV and the request budget long before 1,000 DAU.

Realtime channel is the directive's ONE push channel, but today it is also an unauthenticated broadcast/injection surface and a private-data leak; if the rebuild routes balances/orders through it, the leak becomes a money-visibility leak.

Top-up delivery being client-driven means the real-money path is only as strong as /wallet/payout (currently: not at all). Turning SETTLEMENT_LIVE on without fixing this sells tokens that anyone can also mint for free.
Mesh msg/friend surface has no client callers (dead) yet is fully live and unauthenticated - a rebuild that keeps it 'for later' inherits the identity bug.

Secrets presence (REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN, INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY, MESH_ADMIN_KEY, BOT_API_KEY) could not be verified read-only; code behaviour differs sharply between set and unset for the first and last two.
keep_as_is: play-ledger.js:414-425 internal-key gate on stake/settle/loan-draw/loan-repay - fail-closed, reads env each request.
index.js:3293-3303 /loans/draw|repay proxy attaching INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY after LOANS_MODE+cluster+geoblock gates.

PayoutGate/PlayLedger cashout idempotency state machine (building/sent/confirmed, refund only when broadcast never left, 409 on unknown state) - wallet-payouts.js:139-200, play-ledger.js:556-609.

settlement.js: HMAC-SHA512 over key-sorted body, timingSafeEqual, only 'finished' credits, amount compared to our intent, SETTLEMENT_LIVE kill switch (verified OFF live), idempotent credit on processor ref.

index.js:2905-2965 crypto top-up verification (memo required, treasury receiver, USDC or SOL amount vs intent, no client amount trusted); markIntentPaidFromCrypto serialized in the DO.
prediction-ledger.js: PREDICT_LIVE gate, server odds clamped [0.001,0.999], resolve refuses settlePrice<=0 (194-196), sell bounded to shares, blockConcurrencyWhile idempotency.
play-ledger.js:170-244 handleLoanDraw: refuses on unreadable bankroll, LoanLedger first then credit, void on failure, lending reserve fraction; handleCashout loan lock fails closed (517-533).
push.js:186-188 push-service host allowlist; /push/pending and /push/test bound to the endpoint capability URL.
balance-truth.js: unknown != zero, last-good cache labelled stale with age, no blended total, degraded flag; /health/peg and /health/play refuse to report a fake 0/0.
Client escaping: docs/mesh/mesh.js escapeHtml (1833) incl. payload.html at 789; docs/mesh/mesh-games.js esc (24); docs/mesh/mesh-mobile.js esc (26) in paintFeed.

docs/swap-pool.js holds public metadata only; no worker secret, admin token or internal key found in docs/ (grep: only user-supplied provider keys in ost-ghost-connect.js and the devnet local-wallet secretKey in localStorage by design).

open_questions: Is REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN actually set on prod? publishAuthorized (realtime.js:157) returns true when unset; a read-only probe would itself publish an event, so it was not tested.

Is INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY set on prod? If not, PredictionLedger.play() returns internal_key_not_configured and every OSTG prediction/loan draw is dead (loud, not masked) - worth one health check in the rebuild.
Are MESH_ADMIN_KEY and BOT_API_KEY set? Unset MESH_ADMIN_KEY -> feed/clear 403 (safe); unset BOT_API_KEY -> public default key (index.js:5116).
Who calls push.sendToWallet (not traced in this pass) - determines the severity of the wallet-binding leak in /push/subscribe.
Does anything consume 'offline-vault:*' records for on-chain reconciliation? If a future dispatcher pays from them, /offline-vault/sync (unauthenticated, client-asserted amounts) becomes a printer.

Are the 4 RPC keys in /rpc-config domain-restricted at the provider (Helius allowlist)? If not, the browser-side RPC directive makes provider quota a public resource and /rpc/send's amplifier is worse.
Is the faucet award amount (100 welcome / 1 daily, plus spin prizes in faucet-hub.js) ever meant to be server-issued? Today FaucetGate records amounts but PayoutGate never checks them.
Which docs/ pages still use the /positions, /wallet/events, /launchpad, /stocks/orders KV rails vs the DO rails - needed to decide delete vs migrate.
Whether web3.js error messages returned by /rpc/send (index.js:3704) can include endpoint URLs with api-key (suspected, not verified).

recommended_fixes.title: Make /wallet/payout non-client-callable and issue every pool payout from a server-authoritative source
recommended_fixes.rationale: The endpoint is a direct pool drain; the only legitimate origins are FaucetGate commits, PurchaseLedger paid intents, mesh-game settlements and PlayLedger cashout, all of which are server code that can carry x-ost-internal and a bounded amount (reservation.amount / intent.ostAmount). Client-decided amounts must not exist.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the capability (client-chosen amount reaching the signer) instead of rate-limiting or capping it; the amount is derived server-side from a record the server created, so there is nothing for a client to forge.

recommended_fixes.title: One wallet-signature auth primitive for every mutator (ed25519 over {wallet, method, path, sha256(body), ts, nonce}); replay guard in the target DO
recommended_fixes.rationale: Every PlayLedger, PredictionLedger, loans proxy, MeshHub, push and realtime-subscription mutation names a wallet the caller merely asserts. A single requireWalletSig(request, body) in index.js before PLAY_LEDGER/PREDICTION/MESH/PUSH dispatch, verified with tweetnacl (already a @solana/web3.js dependency), with a +/-120s ts window and per-wallet seen-nonce set in the DO, needs no nonce round-trip (zero extra requests under the 100/user/day budget). For ost-mesh addresses use the TOFU-locked bundle.sig key. The RealtimeHub can also hand a session nonce on 'realtime.ready' for clients that prefer server nonces.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Binds each state change to possession of the wallet key; it does not filter symptoms (per-IP limits, heuristics) and it is the same primitive the on-chain programs already rely on.

recommended_fixes.title: Close the realtime injection and leak: delete the WS 'publish' path (or restrict to PUBLIC_PUBLISH_TYPES), make publishAuthorized fail-closed, require wallet-signature to subscribe to wallet:<addr>, and exclude private events from GET /events
recommended_fixes.rationale: The July token gate covered one of three publish paths. Privileged types must originate only from server code, wallet channels must be provable, and the recent-events buffer must not be a public ledger of private events.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates the bypass at its entry points and turns 'token unset' into a refusal rather than an implicit allow-all.

recommended_fixes.title: Prediction odds: refuse instead of defaulting to 0.5
recommended_fixes.rationale: index.js open/cashout must return 503 odds_unavailable when livePrice/openPrice are missing, and serverComputeBtcOdds must return undefined (not {yes:0.5}) on invalid inputs; PredictionLedger already refuses when oddsYes is not finite.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Deletes the fabricated number; an unavailable price becomes a loud, retryable refusal instead of a tradeable mispricing.

recommended_fixes.title: Unknown bankroll = refuse credits (mirror handleLoanDraw) in bet/session/meme-sell/stock-close
recommended_fixes.rationale: poolBankroll returning null currently removes the solvency cap; the credit paths should return 503 bankroll_unreadable exactly as loan-draw does, and the 20s cache should be the only tolerated staleness.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Treats unknown as unknown rather than as unlimited; no fallback value is invented.

recommended_fixes.title: Gate pool-cost endpoints: x-ost-internal or wallet-signature on /wallet/ata-rent and /wallet/cosign; per-IP DO limiter and single-endpoint attempt (no 4-key walk) on /rpc/send; provider-side domain restriction on the /rpc-config keys
recommended_fixes.rationale: Pool SOL and RPC quota are shared, finite, free-plan resources; each caller must be identifiable and each request must cost a bounded number of upstream calls.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Caps spend at the point of authorization (who may spend) and at the amplifier (how many upstream calls one request may cause), rather than reacting after quota exhaustion.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete the legacy KV-write surface (/positions, /wallet/events, /launchpad/*, /stocks/orders, /wallet/payouts POST, /offline-vault/sync, /predict/comments, ghost memory/mesh stubs, /bot/v1 order paths) or move the few that matter into DO rails behind wallet-signature
recommended_fixes.rationale: Per the founder directive the worker keeps only custody signing, settlement truth, the push channel and a thin directory; these endpoints are unauthenticated polls/writes that also drive privileged realtime events and will exhaust KV at trivial load.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the surface instead of throttling it; state that belongs to the browser/mesh stops transiting the worker at all.

recommended_fixes.title: Mesh: authenticate every operation with the TOFU-bound signing key; drop feed/donate unless it carries a verified transfer signature; remove dead msg/friend routes until a client exists
recommended_fixes.rationale: announce already locks a signing key per address; using it (signature over {addr, op, ts, nonce}) makes friend/msg/feed ownership real. Donation totals must derive from an on-chain sig checked like deposits, not a number in the body. Also index feed posts by id (separate key) to kill the full-list scan.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Turns the existing key binding into authorization and removes fabricated data paths, rather than adding heuristics on top of asserted identities.

recommended_fixes.title: Internal-key gate /play/rl; stop passing the ignored 'expiration' option and expire counters via an in-memory Map or DO alarm; make the /ghost/chat limiter fail-closed; add the same limiter to /ghost/v2/chat
recommended_fixes.rationale: The limiter is a cost control that is both publicly writable and non-expiring in the money DO; its fail-open catch and the unlimited v2 relay leave operator AI/LLM keys exposed.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Fixes the storage leak at the API misuse and converts 'limiter broken' into a visible 503 instead of silent unlimited spend.

recommended_fixes.title: Remove /play/stake and /play/settle from the client and migrate any fundedBy:'ostg' legacy tickets to /play/predict/*; add a health check that INTERNAL_MUTATION_KEY, REALTIME_PUBLISH_TOKEN, MESH_ADMIN_KEY and BOT_API_KEY are present
recommended_fixes.rationale: Dead client paths produce permanent 'Payout failed' states; unset secrets flip several gates open (realtime, bot) or off (predictions). /health should report configured:true/false per secret without revealing values.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates code that can only fail and makes configuration state observable, rather than adding retries around a 403.

recommended_fixes.title: Error hygiene: return stable error codes, log upstream detail server-side, never echo provider bodies (Stripe r.body, web3.js messages, DO stack messages)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Detail strings from Stripe, RPC libraries and DOs are returned verbatim; codes are enough for clients and support.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Keeps the loud failure (non-2xx + code) while removing internals from the response; it does not swallow errors.

recommended_fixes.title: Verify /topup/claim delivery signature on-chain (pool -> intent.wallet for intent.ostAmount) or, once payouts are server-issued, remove /topup/claim and mark 'sent' from PayoutGate's confirmed record
recommended_fixes.rationale: Claim currently trusts any string; after fix 1 the dispatcher/PayoutGate knows the real signature and can transition the intent itself.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Makes the intent state follow the on-chain truth the server already has, instead of a client claim.

recommended_fixes.title: GameSeedHub: key the DO by authenticated wallet (or fold into PlayLedger seeds which already exist) and reject unknown player ids
recommended_fixes.rationale: Per-arbitrary-id DO creation is unbounded storage; PlayLedger already holds a per-wallet commit-reveal seed (626-649).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the unbounded namespace rather than pruning it periodically.

predictions.summary: Prediction markets today run on THREE money rails that share one localStorage ticket store (ost.prediction.orders.v1, app.js:2181) and three separate claim executors. Rail A (ostg-native, PredictionLedger DO) is the only server-authoritative rail and its DO logic is sound (server odds, clamps, tie refund, settle-price>0 guard, sell bounded by shares), but its worker front door has no caller auth (any client can open/sell/resolve positions for any wallet: index.js:3371-3467) and both open and cashout silently default entry/sell odds to 0.5 when the isolate has no 'btc:latest' tick (index.js:3382-3405, 3418-3444, catch(_){} + ignores canon.livePrice) — a masking fallback on the price of money. Rail B (on-chain program F82m…) is correct and self-contained (ost-onchain-market.js) but the desk (app.js getPredictionOrderAction 15346-15456) and modal (prediction-modal.js ordersForMarket 1636-1649) do not know about it, so an escrowed ticket is offered a 'Sell position' that pays from the OSTC PayoutGate pool. Rail C (credits/wallet) is client-settled (prediction-pro.js finalizeClosedBtcRounds 1111-1150 settles against openPrice, not the priceToBeat the UI shows, using the client's own last tick), client-priced (three different odds formulas: 0.15 scale in prediction-pro/worker, 0.10 in prediction-modal, vol/momentum in fast-markets), and paid by POST /wallet/payout, which is unauthenticated and pays a client-asserted amount (wallet-payouts.js:103-113, 388-392). Legacy 'ostg'-funded tickets can never be paid (OST_PLAY.settle → /play/settle → 403). Mobile sells: native tickets go to the server correctly (ost-predict-mobile.js:956-991); non-native sells depend on the hidden desktop .prediction-cashout-btn (921-951) rendered by app.js:15538, which is absent for optimistic tickets (signature ''), for tickets whose market rolled off state.markets, and until the desk has rendered — so 'sells not going through' is structural, not a timing bug. Recommendation: collapse to Rail A (server) for every 5-min round + Rail B as explicit opt-in, delete Rail C and all client settlement, move resolution to a DO alarm + one WebSocket push, and gate /play/predict/* and /wallet/payout with wallet-signature auth.

Object.assign overrides client oddsYes/priceToBeat (3410). prediction-ledger.js open 98-155: PREDICT_LIVE gate, round must be open (115), openPrice from KV round:<openAt> else body.priceToBeat (122-126), entry=clampOdds (129), shares=stake/entry (130), DEBIT via play('stake') → PlayLedger handleStake (play-ledger.js:300-326, bal:<wallet> decremented at 321), then storage.put(ppos:<id>) (153).
