SELL/CASHOUT: mobile only. ost-predict-mobile.js:956-991 POST /play/predict/cashout {id, marketId, wallet}; index.js:3414-3445 recomputes oddsYes (default 0.5, catch(_){} 3444); prediction-ledger.js sell 240-277: rejects after closeAt (253), gross=min(shares×cur, shares), fee=2% profit, CREDIT via play('settle') → PlayLedger handleSettle (play-ledger.js:328-357, bal += payout, houseAccrued += fee), status 'sold'. Client patches order status 'sold', cashedOut (977), optimistic balance hold, then OST_BALANCE.refresh/OST_PLAY.refresh (refreshBalance 187-197) → ost:balance / ost:play:balance → paintBalance (1114-1119). Desktop app.js getPredictionOrderAction 15398-15411 shows 'Locked until close' for the same ticket — no sell on desktop.

SETTLE: client POSTs /play/predict/resolve {id, marketId} — automatically every 20s (app.js:15299-15343, 18053) and from the 'Settle' button (15605-15641); index.js:3447-3467 derives openAt from id, settlePrice from getBtcRoundResult (1645-1663): NativeMarketHub /btc/round-result (2005-2022: rollover snapshot btc:round:<openAt>, else Coinbase 5m candle close after closeAt+8s, memoized) else worker-side Coinbase kline (fetchBtcCloseFromKline 343-372). prediction-ledger.js resolve 160-229 under blockConcurrencyWhile: replay if not open (167-169), not_yet before closeAt (170-172), settle_price_unavailable if !(settlePrice>0) (185-187), line=pos.priceToBeat (188-190), tie → refund stake (193-196), win → gross=shares, fee=2% profit, payout via play('settle') (212-217), then status persisted (219-226).

CLAIM: none — the resolve credit IS the claim (PlayLedger balance). Withdrawal to wallet is /play/cashout (play-ledger.js:495+). Client marks won/lost/refunded + cashedOut and fires OST_PLAY.refresh + ost:money:change (app.js:15320-15340, 15630-15636).
weak_points: No caller auth on /play/predict/open|cashout|resolve: wallet is a body field (prediction-ledger.js:103); anyone can debit any wallet's PlayLedger balance into bets, force-sell any position id, or trigger resolves (index.js:3371-3467).
oddsYes silently defaults to 0.5 on cold isolate / KV shed (index.js:3382, 3388-3389, 3405; 3418-3444): entry and exit prices become wrong by up to 2x/1000x while looking normal.

resolve()/sell() credit PlayLedger BEFORE persisting the position status (prediction-ledger.js:212-226, 264-274); PlayLedger settle has no idempotency key (play-ledger.js:328-357) → a DO failure between the two calls leaves the position 'open' and pays again on the next resolve.

Close price provenance is inconsistent: rollover snapshot uses state.livePrice at the FIRST request after the boundary (index.js:1762-1784, may be seconds–minutes late) and is written unconditionally, overwriting a Coinbase-kline snapshot already memoized by /btc/round-result (2013-2020) → two positions on one round can settle against different prices.
Desktop cannot sell an ostg-native ticket (app.js:15398-15411) while mobile can (ost-predict-mobile.js:956) — the same ticket has two different products.

flows.name: Rail B: on-chain ost-betting program (BTC 5m, opt-in by wallet availability)
steps: OPEN: ost-onchain-route.js:183-244 intercepts OST_PREDICTION_API.placeOrder for ost-btc5m-* when OST_ONCHAIN.available() (ost-onchain-market.js:89-91: solanaWeb3 + session key or wallet session + connection) and the crank's market exists, is unresolved and unlocked (201-203). Optimistic ticket recordOnChainTicket (109-156: fundedBy 'onchain', onChain true, onChainOpenAt sec, payoutIsIndicative) stored locally; then OST_ONCHAIN.placeBet (ost-onchain-market.js:304-346): optional ATA ix, ixSpread 1.5% to market treasury (221-235, 313-319), ixPlaceBet with net (179-203); signed silently by session key (262-272) or wallet signFast (274-282). DEBIT: user's OSTG ATA on-chain. Events: ost:house-fee(arbitrage), ost:onchain-bet, ost:prediction:order-changed, ost:wallet-changed; reverted via ost:onchain-bet-reverted (route 163-176).
PRICE: pari-mutuel impliedYes (173-177); indicative net quoteNet (365-374, 2% of profit).

SELL: none exists on-chain. However app.js getPredictionOrderAction (15346-15456) has no onChain branch → 'Sell position' with canCash=liveValue>0 (15441-15455) and prediction-modal.js refreshSellList (2163-2260) lists the ticket too.
SETTLE: program resolves from Pyth (crank); client reads market.resolved/winningSide/closePrice via parseMarket (115-149) with resolved markets cached forever (155-168).

CLAIM: prediction-extras.js claimBet rail 0 (665-720): requires OST_ONCHAIN.available() at claim time (592-594), recomputes payout from final pools with quoteNet, OST_HOUSE.book (no rake), optimistic doClaim('') then OST_ONCHAIN.claim → claim_payout; revert on failure (705-718). Mobile autoClaimOnchain (ost-predict-mobile.js:748-774) every 60s: session-signed claim, marks won/cashedOut with quoteNet ESTIMATE as cashoutOst. CREDIT: user OSTG ATA from program vault (fee swept to treasury by program). Balance reaction: OST_WALLET.refresh / ost:wallet-changed.
weak_points: Desk + modal offer a custodial 'Sell' on an on-chain escrowed ticket (pays OSTC pool via /wallet/payout while the escrow stays in the vault).

claimBet's onChainTicket detection depends on wallet availability at claim time (prediction-extras.js:592-594); with no wallet the ticket is raked client-side and routed to credits (wrong pool + second rake).
ost-onchain-bet.js targets a different PROGRAM_ID and layout (line 42, 335-380) — any caller of window.OstOnchainBet hits the wrong program.

Silent rail switch on any chain/RPC hiccup (ost-onchain-route.js:238-243; ost-onchain-market.js marketFor catch → null 169): custody changes from program vault to custodial/OSTC without the user choosing.

flows.name: Rail C: legacy credits / wallet(OSTC) vault (everything not caught by A/B: Polymarket mirrors, ETH/SOL fast markets, extras My Bets, parlays, and BTC on any Rail A error)
steps: OPEN: app.js createPredictionMarketOrder (~3400-3697): OST_ARB.bookBuy sets shares (3404-3412); if not btc5m or Rail A threw anything other than insufficient_bucket (3577-3587) → no wallet → fundFromCredits (3425-3465: OST_MONEY.spend localStorage credits, signature 'credits-…') → wallet → optimistic record (3595-3640) + background OST_RESCUE.userSendsOstToPool (real OSTC Token-2022 transfer to swap pool, 3642-3650); funding failure silently converts to credits if credits cover (3651-3660) else removes ticket. prediction-extras submitBet (330-360) and fast-markets (via placeOrder) and parlay (OST_MONEY only) also land here.

PRICE: client-computed and non-uniform: prediction-pro computeBtcOdds (596-641) + native-state overlay/spread (210-260, server quoteMarket index.js:1917-1925 with spread constants 1102-1112); prediction-modal 0.10 scale (180-207); fast-markets vol/momentum (170-191); arb ask/bid (ost-arbitrage.js:45-81).

SELL: app.js button handler 15642-15740: payout=liveValue (getPredictionOrderAction 15441-15455; livePrice from getLivePriceForOrder 15173-15181 falls back to ENTRY price when the market is no longer in state.markets) → OST_ARB.bookSell → rail switch: fundedBy 'ostg' → OST_PLAY.settle (ost-play.js:351-364 → /play/settle → 403 per play-ledger.js:414-421 → throws 'Payout failed'); 'credits' → OST_MONEY.add (15718-15721); else OST_TRADE.predictionCashOut (devnet-rescue.js:374-390) → POST /wallet/payout (PayoutGate handlePayout 103-230, client-asserted amountOst, OSTC pool). Modal sellOrder (prediction-modal.js:1691-1747) does the same via predictionCashOut. Mobile confirmSell (ost-predict-mobile.js:921-951) clicks the desk button.

SETTLE: BTC: prediction-pro finalizeClosedBtcRounds (1111-1150): closePrice = btcLastTick.price (client's own last tick if within 15s of close, or ANY tick once the round is >120s old), yesWon = closePrice > openPrice (NOT priceToBeat); orders marked won/lost (1150-1200). ETH/SOL: fast-markets settleScan (315-360) Binance kline open vs close. Polymarket: gamma status / ≥0.985 pinning (app.js:15200-15290, 15366-15371). Extras 'isOstNative' bets: deterministic hash outcome after 24h (prediction-extras.js:356-368).

CLAIM: three executors on the same localStorage record: app.js button 'prediction-settlement' (OST_HOUSE.rake 15681-15683 then rail switch), prediction-extras claimBet (rake 600-604, then predictionCashOut or OST_MONEY.add 726-739), OST_POSITIONS auto-claim sweep every 15s/on events (ost-positions.js:169-173, 261-263). Balance reaction: ost:wallet-changed + notifyOstTxHistory + RPC balance snapshot (app.js:15769-15790).
weak_points: Outcome and payout amount are decided by the client; /wallet/payout executes whatever it is told (no auth, no outcome check).
Stakes move OSTC (userSendsOstToPool / swap pool) while the settled directive says markets accept OSTG only.
Settlement is nondeterministic across users (each browser's last tick) and against a different line (openPrice) than the UI advertises (priceToBeat).

A ticket whose round rolled off state.markets is sellable at ~entry value after close and forever if the user was absent at close (getLivePriceForOrder fallback + finalizeClosedBtcRounds needs a local round record).

flows.name: BTC 5-min round truth (NativeMarketHub) and how clients consume it
steps: Worker currentRound() (index.js:80-90) is clock-derived: id ost-btc5m-<openAt>. NativeMarketHub.refreshBtcState (1786-1835): open price from Binance kline (fetchBtcRoundOpenPriceFast 300-340) else provisional live price; priceToBeat = projectPriceToBeat(open, prior 5m drift ×0.5, capped ±0.30%) (179-184, 186-200); live price via fetchBtcPriceFast; ticks ring. btcSnapshot (1837-1896) computes serverComputeBtcOdds and publishes price.tick to RealtimeHub (1878-1893).
Rollover: first request after the boundary writes btc:round:<prevOpenAt> with closePrice=state.livePrice (1762-1784).

GET /btc/round is served from a 900ms isolate cache (3872-3890) → getCanonicalBtcRound → DO snapshot; DO unreachable → buildCanonicalBtcRound over KV/memory (466-533) with hubFailed console.error (1562-1569).

Clients: prediction-pro polls /btc/round adaptively 8s/4s/1.5s (795-820) and keeps live price from Pyth/WS; ost-predict-mobile polls /btc/round every 6s in detail view (1136) and fabricates a client round on failure (580-592, 604-614); ost-predict-hud polls /btc/round every 20s (211); app.js loadPredictionMarkets every 10s (18049) + resolutions 20s/30s (18052-18053) + syncTradeWallet 30s (18055); native market state refresh; docs/realtime.js already receives price.tick/ost:btc-round via WebSocket (243-252).
weak_points: One active user on the predict page issues roughly 450 (/btc/round) + 360 (markets) + 300 (resolutions) + 120 (balance) ≈ 1,200+ worker requests/hour on desktop, ~1,500+ on mobile detail view — ~12-15 users' entire daily budget per hour under the 100 req/user/day directive, while a WebSocket channel carrying the same round already exists.
Round rollover snapshot only fires on traffic; quiet periods rely on the Coinbase kline fallback → mixed close-price sources.

defects.title: /wallet/payout is unauthenticated and pays a client-asserted amount (legacy 'Claim win' rail)
defects.evidence: handlePayout reads {wallet, amountOst, memo, payoutId} from the body, validates pubkey/amount, checks pool solvency caps, and sends pool→user OSTC. handleWalletPayoutsRequest forwards any request to the PayoutGate DO with no token, signature, or origin check. Every legacy claim/sell (app.js:15730, prediction-modal.js:1738, prediction-extras.js:654-655 via devnet-rescue.js:374-390) is this call with a client-computed payout.
defects.failure_scenario: curl -X POST /wallet/payout -d '{"wallet":"<mine>","amountOst":<2% of pool>,"payoutId":"x1"}' repeatedly with fresh payoutIds drains the OSTC pool (maxPayoutFraction 0.02 per call, maxSinglePayout 1e9). No ticket needs to exist. Verified in code; not executed.

defects.title: /play/predict/open|cashout|resolve have no caller authentication; wallet is a body field
defects.evidence: index.js only computes odds and forwards the body to the DO. PredictionLedger.open validates the wallet format only (109) and debits it via the internal key. sell/resolve take only a position id (p_<openAt>_<wallet6>_…). The header comment 'OPEN is internal-key gated' (prediction-ledger.js:19) is false for the public route. No x-ost-wallet/signature verification exists anywhere in index.js or play-ledger.js (grep: only CORS header at index.js:59).
defects.failure_scenario: Attacker POSTs open with victim wallet and stake=victim's whole PlayLedger balance on the losing side at 99.9c, or enumerates/guesses position ids and force-sells a victim's winning position at current odds. Money moves without the owner's consent. Verified in code.

defects.title: Server entry odds silently default to 0.5 when the isolate has no 'btc:latest' tick — DO livePrice is ignored
defects.evidence: let oddsYes = 0.5; livePrice = Number(live && (live.price||live.p||live.value)) where live = memGet('btc:latest') || kvGet(env,'btc:latest'). canon (from the DO) carries livePrice but is only used for openPrice/priceToBeat. appendBtcTick skips the KV write under tierDown('kv') (409-420) and memGet is per-isolate, so a cold isolate often has no tick → odds computation is skipped → 0.5 is forwarded as the SERVER price. The whole block is wrapped in try{}catch(_){} (3405, 3444). serverComputeBtcOdds returns {yes:0.5, scale:0} when price is missing and the caller accepts it because Number.isFinite(0.5) (3403).
defects.failure_scenario: Last 20s of a round with BTC +0.3% above the line (true YES ≈ 99.9c): a cold isolate opens YES at 50c → shares = 2×stake → resolve pays 2×stake minus fee from PlayLedger. Conversely a cashout at 50c of a position bought at 10c pays 5× for free, or a 90c position is dumped at 50c. The response looks normal ('position': entry 0.5). Verified in code.

defects.title: PredictionLedger credits PlayLedger before persisting the terminal status; PlayLedger settle has no idempotency key
defects.evidence: resolve: `await this.play('settle', …)` (cross-DO fetch) then `pos.status = …; await this.state.storage.put(...)`. If the put throws or the DO is evicted/times out inside blockConcurrencyWhile after the settle fetch returned, the position remains 'open'. handleSettle takes {wallet, payout, bucket, fee} with no dedupe key; nothing reconciles credits against positions.
defects.failure_scenario: Resolve #1 credits 100 OSTG, DO dies before put; client auto-resolve (app.js:18053, every 20s) retries → replay guard sees 'open' → credits 100 OSTG again. Suspected (requires a DO fault); the ordering is verified.

defects.title: Two close-price sources for one round; rollover snapshot overwrites the memoized kline close and uses a late 'live' tick as the close
defects.evidence: rolloverBtcStateIfNeeded runs on the first DO request after the boundary and does storage.put(`btc:round:${prev}`) unconditionally with closePrice = state.livePrice (the last fetched tick, possibly minutes old or seconds after close). /btc/round-result memoizes a Coinbase 5m candle close into the same key when no rec exists (closeAt+8s). getBtcRoundResult also has a worker-side Coinbase fallback with its own memory map. Order of arrival decides which price wins; a later rollover put replaces an earlier kline snapshot.
defects.failure_scenario: Round closes at T. Position A resolves at T+9s using Coinbase close 65,000.10 (line 65,000). At T+30s the first /btc/round request rolls the DO over and writes closePrice=64,999.90 (stale live tick). Position B on the same round resolves at T+40s against 64,999.90 → A 'won', B (same side) 'lost'. Verified ordering in code; occurrence suspected.

defects.title: Legacy BTC settlement uses each browser's own last tick and settles against openPrice while the UI advertises priceToBeat
defects.evidence: closePrice = Number(btcLastTick.price) (1121) accepted if the tick is within 15s of close OR the round is >120s old (any later price); r.yesWon = r.closePrice > openPrice (1140) — priceToBeat stored in the round record (1069) is never used. buildFiveMinBtcMarket's title/detail/equation say 'YES wins if BTC closes above <priceToBeat>'. This drives 'Claim win' → /wallet/payout.
defects.failure_scenario: priceToBeat projected 0.2% above open. BTC closes +0.1%: UI says NO wins; client marks YES won and pays YES holders from the OSTC pool. Two users with different feed latency get opposite outcomes for the same round. A user can also stop the feed and reload later so the 'old round' branch uses today's price. Verified in code.

defects.title: On-chain escrowed tickets are offered a custodial 'Sell position' paid from the OSTC pool (double custody)
defects.evidence: getPredictionOrderAction only special-cases cashedOut and fundedBy==='ostg-native'; a fundedBy 'onchain' ticket returns kind 'prediction-sell', canCash liveValue>0. The click handler's rail switch (15706-15731) tests 'ostg', 'credits', else hasCashOut → OST_TRADE.predictionCashOut → /wallet/payout. The modal's ordersForMarket filters only cashedOut. grep of app.js 15340-15900 for onChain/onchain returns nothing.
defects.failure_scenario: User bets 100 OSTG on-chain (escrow in program vault, 1.5 to treasury). Desk shows 'Sell position · 98'. Click → PayoutGate sends 98 OSTC from the pool; ticket marked cashedOut. Escrow remains claimable by claim_payout from another device/session (mobile autoClaimOnchain skips cashedOut, but a manual OST_ONCHAIN.claim or a wiped localStorage does not) → paid twice, from two pools, in two currencies. Verified in code.

defects.title: ostg-native tickets can be 'sold' through the modal via /wallet/payout while the server position stays open
defects.evidence: ordersForMarket returns every non-cashedOut local order for the market regardless of fundedBy; the Sell button computes payout from client mid × shares and calls OST_TRADE.predictionCashOut → OSTC pool. The PredictionLedger position (ppos:<id>) is untouched; app.js refreshOstgNativeResolutions (15299-15343) skips cashedOut orders, but /play/predict/resolve is public and idempotent per position, so anyone (or the same user on another device) can still resolve it.
defects.failure_scenario: Open 100 OSTG native YES at 60c (shares 166.7). Modal 'Sell 150 OST' → pool pays 150 OSTC. Round closes YES → POST /play/predict/resolve {id} → PlayLedger credited 165.3 OSTG. One stake, two payouts from two pools. Verified in code.

defects.title: Rail A failure silently falls through to the OSTC/credits rail (currency and custody switch)
defects.evidence: try { return await fundFromOstgNative(...) } catch (err) { if (err.code === 'insufficient_bucket') throw err; } — every other error (worker 1027, timeout, predictions_not_live, round_open_price_unknown, no_server_odds, stake_failed) proceeds to the wallet path (real OSTC transfer to the swap pool) or credits. The wallet path's own failure silently converts the ticket to credits (3651-3660). Comment admits 'quietly falls back'.
defects.failure_scenario: Worker hits the daily cap → every 'OSTG' bet becomes an OSTC transfer into the swap pool with a client-settled ticket; user believes they bet OSTG on a server-settled market. Violates 'a market/game accepts OSTG only'. Verified in code.

defects.title: Legacy 'ostg'-funded tickets can never be paid: OST_PLAY.settle hits the now-gated /play/settle
defects.evidence: fundedBy 'ostg' branch calls window.OST_PLAY.settle(payout, {bucket, fee}) → POST /play/settle without x-ost-internal → 403 mutation_requires_server_auth → api() throws → settle returns {ok:false} → handler throws 'Payout failed'. fundFromOstg (app.js:3467-3505) still exists to create such tickets (reachable via OST_TRADE.memecoinBuy etc.).
defects.failure_scenario: Any pre-existing or newly created fundedBy:'ostg' winning ticket shows 'Claim win', errors on every click, and is never paid; auto-claim retries burn requests. Verified in code.

defects.title: Client odds formulas disagree with the server: modal uses scale 0.10, fast-markets uses a vol/momentum model, desk overlays native-state spread
defects.evidence: Server and prediction-pro.js:616 both use 0.15·sqrt(max(rem,0.04)), z∈[-8,8], clamp [0.001,0.999] (match verified). prediction-modal computeFastBtcYesProbability uses 0.10 unless the canonical round is 'hot' and within 250ms/0.01 of the local tick (185-193) — otherwise its own formula. fast-markets never matches anything server-side. The desk's tradable price additionally applies the server /state spread/impact (applyNativeMarketStateToBtcMarket) and OST_ARB ask, so the displayed price ≠ the Rail A entry price recorded by the server (app.js:3556 uses pos.entry).
defects.failure_scenario: deltaPct +0.10%, full time left: server YES 0.66, modal YES 0.73, desk with +3pt impact 0.69. User sees 'Buy YES 73c, win 137%' and is filled at 66c server-side; potentialReturn in the ticket is the client's number. No slippage bound. Verified by formula reading.

defects.title: Extremes: z clamp ±8 + floor scale 0.03% in the last 12s make 0.1c entries routinely reachable (1000× shares) and 0.5-default mispricing catastrophic
defects.evidence: scale = 0.15·sqrt(max(rem,0.04)) → minimum 0.03%; z saturates at ±8 (logistic 0.9997) then clamps to 0.999/0.001. shares = stake/entry with entry ≥ 0.001 → up to 1000× stake; resolve pays gross = shares. Combined with the defect above (0.5 default) or the ±0.30% priceToBeat projection, the tail exposure of PlayLedger is unbounded relative to stake.
defects.failure_scenario: BTC 0.24% below the line with 10s left: YES 0.1c. A 10 OSTG YES buy = 10,000 shares. A late spike above the line at close pays 9,800 OSTG from PlayLedger (house has no matching book — it is not pari-mutuel). Verified math; occurrence suspected.

defects.title: A legacy ticket on a rolled-off market is sellable at ~entry value after close, forever if the user was absent at close
defects.evidence: findMarketForOrder returns null once the round leaves state.markets; getLivePriceForOrder then returns order.yesPrice/noPrice (the entry price) → liveValue ≈ stake → action 'Sell position', canCash true. finalizeClosedBtcRounds only settles rounds present in localStorage rounds (captured while the page was open).
defects.failure_scenario: Bet 100 on NO, close browser, BTC rockets. Reopen: no round record → ticket still 'open' → 'Sell position · 98' → /wallet/payout pays 98 OSTC for a lost ticket. Verified in code.

defects.title: Three claim executors with different payoutIds can pay the same win twice
defects.evidence: Idempotency at PayoutGate is by payoutId; the client id embeds the amount. app.js pays rake(potentialReturn); claimBet pays rake(payoutIfWin) with payoutIfWin = potentialReturn||stake/price; the modal pays bookSell(shares×mid). Each path guards re-entry with its own key (btn.disabled / claimingIds / btn.disabled) and re-reads localStorage, but OST_POSITIONS sweeps every 15s and on every order-changed event.
defects.failure_scenario: User clicks 'Sell 150' in the modal (payoutId …:150.000000000) while the auto-claim sweep fires claimBet for the same now-'won' ticket (payoutId …:196.000000000): two distinct PayoutGate records → two OSTC transfers. Plausible race; verified that keys differ.

defects.title: On-chain house fee is booked or raked depending on wallet availability at claim time → double rake + wrong pool
defects.evidence: onChainTicket requires window.OST_ONCHAIN.available() at claim time; if the wallet/session is not connected the on-chain ticket is treated as custodial: OST_HOUSE.rake applied (600-604) and the payout routed to credits (734-737) or /wallet/payout. Program already deducts 2% in claim_payout.
defects.failure_scenario: Wallet disconnected after betting on-chain; win resolves; auto-claim runs → credits += net-after-client-rake, ticket marked claimed; later the user connects and claim_payout pays again (program rake applied). Verified in code; occurrence suspected.

defects.title: Mobile fabricates a client round with priceToBeat = current price when /btc/round fails, and keeps the market tradeable
defects.evidence: catch → applyRound(clientRound()): priceToBeat falls to `beat || price || d.livePrice || 0` (line 588), i.e. the live price at fallback time; comment says 'bets fall through to the credits rail, which is pure client'. Buy remains enabled.
defects.failure_scenario: Worker at 1027 mid-round: user sees price-to-beat = current price (50/50), buys; ticket funds via OSTC/credits rail and is settled by the client against openPrice from prediction-pro's own record. Nothing tells the user the round they see is invented. Verified in code.

defects.title: Mobile non-native sell depends on a hidden desktop DOM button matched by signature
defects.evidence: Button is rendered only by app.js renderPredictionLedger (15538) into #predictionPositionList (index.html:2850), which mobile hides with display:none (1097) but keeps. Match key `order.signature||sig||id`: optimistic wallet/on-chain tickets have signature '' (app.js:3597, ost-onchain-route.js:118) → selector [data-order-sig=""] matches nothing or a different pending ticket. renderPredictionLedger rewrites innerHTML on ~15 triggers (18104-18147) so the node can vanish between lookup and click. Net amount is regex-parsed from button text (930, 944). After 4×500ms the user gets 'isn't sellable yet — it settles at close' even for a sellable ticket.
defects.failure_scenario: Mobile user with a still-confirming on-chain/wallet ticket taps Sell → 2s spinner → false 'not sellable' toast; or the desk section has not rendered (idle guard / first paint) → same. Verified in code.

defects.title: Legacy wallet tickets stake OSTC (swap pool) and are paid in OSTC — violates the settled OSTG-only market rule
defects.evidence: Wallet-funded prediction tickets transfer the OST(C) mint to the swap pool ATA (vaultTokenAccount = OST_SWAP_POOL.ata, 3593) and claims pay from Pool.getMint(env) via PayoutGate. prediction-extras submitBet does the same (334-340).
defects.failure_scenario: Every non-BTC market and every BTC bet during a Rail A hiccup moves OSTC; the OSTG supply==vault(OSTC) invariant is unaffected but markets are no longer OSTG-only and the pool becomes the counterparty to client-settled outcomes. Verified in code.

defects.title: Dead / wrong duplicates: native-market.js (unbound second hub with different odds) and ost-onchain-bet.js (different program id)
defects.evidence: index.js imports (1-22) never import native-market.js; wrangler binds class_name NativeMarketHub → the class at index.js:1696. ost-onchain-bet.js hardcodes PROGRAM_ID Fg6PaFpo… and a Market layout without mint/treasury, and is still loaded.
defects.failure_scenario: An engineer 'fixes' odds in native-market.js with no effect; any future caller of OstOnchainBet.placeBet sends a bet to a program that is not the audited one. Verified in code.

defects.title: resolveBetIfNeeded fabricates outcomes for extras 'isOstNative' bets from a hash of marketId
defects.evidence: After 24h, status = won/lost from hash(marketId)%2, then claimBet pays it (credits or /wallet/payout).
defects.failure_scenario: Any extras-store OST bet older than 24h is paid or lost by a coin flip that is deterministic per market — an attacker picks markets whose hash favours their side. Verified in code.

defects.title: House fee bps and totals are client-controlled localStorage; server 2% is hardcoded independently
defects.evidence: OST_FEE_HOUSE_BPS from localStorage (0..2000) sets the client rake for Rail C claims; ost.house.collected is a localStorage total. Server rake fixed at 0.02.
defects.failure_scenario: localStorage.OST_FEE_HOUSE_BPS='0' → Rail C claims pay gross via /wallet/payout. Verified in code.

defects.title: Silent catches on claim/auto-claim paths swallow payout failures
defects.evidence: try { a.claim(b.id, null, {silent:true}); done++; } catch (_) {} counts a throw as done; mobile autoClaimOnchain catch(e){} leaves 'already claimed / not payable' undistinguished (bounded to 4 tries).
defects.failure_scenario: A claim that throws synchronously is reported as claimed in the batch summary count; user sees 'Claimed n wins' with fewer payouts. Verified in code.

risks: OSTC pool drain via unauthenticated /wallet/payout is exploitable today with zero UI interaction (2% of pool per call).
PlayLedger exposure is unbounded per stake on Rail A (shares = stake/0.001) and the 0.5-default mispricing turns any cold isolate into a guaranteed-profit window during the last minute of a round.
Any localStorage wipe, second device, or private window resurrects already-paid legacy tickets (server has no record of Rail C claims beyond PayoutGate payoutId which embeds the amount).

Request budget: predict surfaces poll /btc/round (6-8s), markets (10s), resolutions (20s/30s), balance (30-40s), trades/position (13s) — a single active predict user consumes >1,000 worker requests/hour, i.e. the whole 100k/day cap is reachable with ~10 concurrent users on this page alone; when it trips, mobile silently fabricates rounds and bets fall to the OSTC/credits rail.

Settlement truth is split four ways (server priceToBeat vs Coinbase/DO close; client last tick vs openPrice; kline open vs close for ETH/SOL; Pyth on-chain) for markets that share one title and one ticket store — disputes are unresolvable after the fact.
Three claim executors + auto-claim sweeps on shared localStorage create races that PayoutGate cannot dedupe because the client payoutId embeds the amount.
Rail selection is invisible to the user and flips on transient errors (on-chain → custodial → OSTC wallet → credits), so custody and currency of a bet are nondeterministic.
Desktop and mobile disagree on whether an ostg-native ticket is sellable before close.
native-market.js and ost-onchain-bet.js will attract future 'fixes' that do nothing or target the wrong program.
keep_as_is: PredictionLedger DO core invariants: server-only odds with clampOdds [0.001,0.999], shares=stake/entry, debit-before-record, replay-safe resolve/sell under blockConcurrencyWhile, tie → full refund, settlePrice<=0 → 503 leaves position open (prediction-ledger.js:47, 129-137, 164-172, 185-196, 240-277).
PlayLedger x-ost-internal fail-closed gate on stake/settle/loan (play-ledger.js:414-421) and bucket-preserving settle for loan provenance.
PayoutGate state machine (building/sent/confirmed, payoutId memo on-chain, refusal to auto-resend on 'building') — keep the machinery, add auth in front.

NativeMarketHub as the single BTC round authority, projected priceToBeat with ±0.30% cap, deterministic Coinbase 5m candle close as the settlement source, and its price.tick publish to RealtimeHub (index.js:1878-1893) — this is the seed of the push channel.
serverComputeBtcOdds and prediction-pro computeBtcOdds are already identical (0.15·sqrt(max(rem,0.04)), ±8, [0.001,0.999]) — make this the ONLY formula.

ost-onchain-market.js (F82m…, OSTG mint, treasury read from the market account, session-key signing, arb spread as a real on-chain transfer) and ost-onchain-route.js's optimistic-ticket + revert plumbing.
prediction-extras claimBet rail-0 logic for on-chain tickets (recompute from final pools, no client rake, OST_HOUSE.book, revert on failed claim) as the reference behaviour for on-chain claims.
Mobile sell UX: locked exit quote with explicit 're-lock', optimistic balance hold that releases when truth crosses it, ost:balance repaint — keep the UX, point it at the server rail only.
House fee model: 2% of PROFIT only, never on stake/refund (server side).
fetchBtcCloseFromKline widened Coinbase window and memoization; hubFailed loud logging pattern (index.js:1562-1569).
open_questions: Is the market crank (scripts/market-crank.mjs / pyth-crank) actually running on devnet right now, i.e. is Rail B live for users, or does every BTC bet fall to Rail A/C? (Not verifiable from code.)
What are OST_MAX_SINGLE_PAYOUT / OST_VAULT_MAX_PAYOUT_FRACTION / OST_VAULT_MIN_RESERVE in the production wrangler vars? Only the code defaults (1e9 / 0.02 / 0) were read.

Does the deployed ost-betting program's HOUSE_FEE_BPS equal 200 and does place_bet accept the 1.5% pre-transfer split without a minimum-stake check? Program source was not read (anchor build broken; audited per directive).

Are there live users holding fundedBy:'ostg' (pre-server-rail) or fundedBy:'wallet' BTC tickets that would be affected by a hard reset of Rail C? (Needs a localStorage/positions-feed audit; '/positions' KV feed could be sampled.)

Does RealtimeHub on the free plan hold one WebSocket per session without counting as repeated requests, and are DO alarms available on the SQLite-backed PredictionLedger (migration tag prediction_ledger_v1 uses new_sqlite_classes) — required for the alarm-based resolver proposal.
Is /play/predict/* intended to be geoblocked like /loans/*? jurisdictionBlocked is applied only to /settlement/* and /loans/* (index.js:3222, 3267).
Which surface is canonical for 'sell before close' on Rail A — desktop says locked, mobile sells; product decision needed before collapsing.

recommended_fixes.title: Gate /play/predict/* and /wallet/payout with a wallet signature (signed nonce or signed request body) and derive the wallet from the signature, never from the body
recommended_fixes.rationale: Both are balance mutators callable by anyone; the July remediation only covered PlayLedger's internal endpoints. Rail C's /wallet/payout additionally accepts a client-asserted amount, so for it auth is necessary but not sufficient (see Rail C removal).
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the capability to move another wallet's money instead of adding rate limits or heuristics around it; the server keeps computing every amount itself.

recommended_fixes.title: Compute Rail A entry/exit odds from the DO snapshot (canon.livePrice/livePriceTs) and REFUSE the open/cashout when no fresh price exists (return 503 price_unavailable) — delete the oddsYes=0.5 default and the catch(_){}
recommended_fixes.rationale: index.js:3382-3405/3418-3444 mint mispriced shares silently; the DO already holds a fresh live price with a timestamp.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Replaces a fabricated price with an explicit refusal the client can show ('price unavailable, retry'); it does not add another fallback source.

recommended_fixes.title: Make resolve/sell atomic-idempotent: write a 'settling' marker with a settlementId before calling PlayLedger, pass that id to /play/settle, and have PlayLedger dedupe on it; reconcile 'settling' positions on DO start/alarm
recommended_fixes.rationale: prediction-ledger.js:212-226 pays before persisting; play-ledger.js:328-357 has no key. A DO fault double-pays.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Fixes the ordering/idempotency of the money transfer itself rather than adding a client-side 'already paid' flag.

recommended_fixes.title: Single close-price truth per round: write btc:round:<openAt> once (never overwrite an existing closePrice), source it from the Coinbase 5m candle close (deterministic) and treat the rollover live tick only as a provisional value that the candle replaces; expose closeSource on the position
recommended_fixes.rationale: index.js:1762-1784 overwrites; two sources race; late tick ≠ close.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the nondeterminism at its origin (one write, one source) instead of tolerating divergent prices.

recommended_fixes.title: Collapse to ONE custodial rail: route every 5-min round (BTC, ETH, SOL) and every 'OST native' market through PredictionLedger; delete Rail C for predictions (client settlement in prediction-pro.js 1111-1200 and fast-markets.js 315-360, OST_MONEY/credits funding, wallet OSTC transfers, /wallet/payout usage for predictions, prediction-extras own store + hash outcomes, OST_POSITIONS sweep, modal sellOrder); keep Rail B as an explicit user opt-in toggle, never an automatic fallback
recommended_fixes.rationale: Every double-pay, wrong-pool, wrong-line and nondeterministic-settlement defect lives in Rail C or at the seams between rails. The hard reset of legacy credits is already approved. PredictionLedger.resolveOutcome is designed to be pluggable (header 31-35); ETH/SOL need only a kline close per symbol.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Eliminates the client as an outcome/payout authority and the multi-store, multi-executor design instead of patching each seam; on-chain remains sound and becomes a deliberate choice rather than a fallback.

recommended_fixes.title: Server-held positions as the only ticket truth: add GET /play/predict/positions?wallet= (signed) and push 'prediction.resolved/sold' events over the existing RealtimeHub WebSocket; client localStorage becomes a cache, and the desk/mobile/modal render from the server list with fundedBy-aware actions
recommended_fixes.rationale: localStorage ost.prediction.orders.v1 is the root of 'already paid?' ambiguity and of the DOM-coupled mobile sell.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Moves the record of truth to the party that moves the money; UI surfaces stop inferring state from each other's DOM.

recommended_fixes.title: Programmatic sell: expose OST_PREDICTION_API.sellPosition(positionId) (Rail A → /play/predict/cashout; Rail B → 'not sellable, settles on-chain') and have mobile, desk and modal call it; remove .prediction-cashout-btn scraping, text-regex net parsing and the 'Locked until close' desktop branch (or lock both — one product decision)
recommended_fixes.rationale: ost-predict-mobile.js:921-951 clicks a hidden button matched by signature; fails for optimistic tickets and un-rendered desks.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Replaces cross-surface DOM coupling with a function call on the rail that owns the position; no retry loops or timing heuristics.

recommended_fixes.title: Zero-poll predict page: resolve positions from a PredictionLedger alarm at closeAt+10s (per round, idempotent), push results + round rollover + odds over the WebSocket, and delete the /btc/round, resolutions, markets and balance polls while the socket is open (keep one catch-up GET on reconnect)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Directive: worker must not be the hot path; the socket and price.tick publish already exist (index.js:1878-1893, docs/realtime.js:243-252). Current predict surfaces burn >1k req/user/hour.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the polls instead of lengthening their intervals; settlement no longer depends on a client asking.

recommended_fixes.title: One odds function: export serverComputeBtcOdds's formula as a shared snippet used by prediction-pro, prediction-modal (replace 0.10), fast-markets (replace vol/momentum) and the chart; show the SERVER entry price on the ticket before confirm and reject the open if it moved more than a user-set tolerance (server-side maxEntry parameter)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Users are quoted one price and filled at another with no bound.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Aligns the displayed model with the pricing model and adds a server-enforced bound; does not smooth or fudge displayed numbers.

recommended_fixes.title: Bound PlayLedger tail exposure: server-side per-position max payout (e.g. min(shares, K×stake) or a per-round house liability cap) and raise the entry floor in the last N seconds, or switch Rail A to pari-mutuel like the program
recommended_fixes.rationale: 1000× shares at 0.1c with no matching book is a solvency risk the on-chain rail avoids by construction.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Limits exposure in the ledger that pays, not in the UI that displays it.

recommended_fixes.title: Delete workers/ost-api/src/native-market.js and docs/ost-onchain-bet.js (and its index.html script tag); fix the false 'internal-key gated' header comment in prediction-ledger.js
recommended_fixes.rationale: Dead/wrong duplicates invite misdirected fixes and wrong-program transactions.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Removes the source of confusion rather than annotating it.

recommended_fixes.title: Rail B claim path: decide onChainTicket from the ticket record (onChain && onChainOpenAt), not from wallet availability; if the wallet is unavailable, refuse the claim with a clear reason instead of raking and paying from another pool
recommended_fixes.rationale: prediction-extras.js:592-594 routes escrowed tickets to credits when disconnected.
recommended_fixes.root_not_mask: Ties payout rail to where the money actually is; the failure becomes visible and retryable instead of paid from the wrong pool.
